export interface WizardSession {
  sessionId: string;
  companyId: string;
  currentStep: number;
  totalSteps: number;
  entryPath: "MANUAL" | "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE" | "MICROSOFT_365" | "ODOO" | "ERPNEXT";
  draftPayload: Record<string, any>;
  completedSteps: number[];
  status: "IN_PROGRESS" | "DRAFT_READY" | "COMPLETED" | "ABANDONED";
}

export interface IOnboardingWizardService {
  createSession(params: { companyId: string; entryPath: string; initialDraft?: Record<string, any> }): Promise<WizardSession>;
  getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<WizardSession | null>;
  saveStepDraft(sessionId: string, step: number, stepPayload: Record<string, any>): Promise<WizardSession>;
  prefillDraftFromConnectedSource(sessionId: string, discoveredData: Record<string, any>): Promise<WizardSession>;
  updateDraft(sessionId: string, updatedDraft: Record<string, any>): Promise<WizardSession>;
  activateOrganization(sessionId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; companyId: string; dashboardUrl: string }>;
}

export class OnboardingWizardService implements IOnboardingWizardService {
  private mathEngine: MathRulesQAEngine;
  private tenantPolicyManager: TenantPolicyManager;

  constructor(options?: {
    mathEngine?: MathRulesQAEngine;
    tenantPolicyManager?: TenantPolicyManager;
  }) {
    this.mathEngine = options?.mathEngine ?? new MathRulesQAEngine();
    this.tenantPolicyManager = options?.tenantPolicyManager ?? TenantPolicyManager.getInstance();
  }

  /**
   * Initializes a new Onboarding Wizard session for an organization.
   */
  public async createSession(params: {
    companyId: string;
    entryPath: string;
    initialDraft?: Record<string, any>;
  }): Promise<WizardSession> {
    if (!params.companyId || params.companyId.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new Error("WIZARD_VALIDATION_ERROR: companyId is required to start onboarding.");
    }

    const validPaths = ["MANUAL", "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE", "MICROSOFT_365", "ODOO", "ERPNEXT"];
    const normalizedPath = params.entryPath.toUpperCase();
    if (!validPaths.includes(normalizedPath)) {
      throw new Error(`WIZARD_VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid entry path '${params.entryPath}'. Must be one of: ${validPaths.join(", ")}`);
    }

    const sessionId = `wiz_${params.companyId}_${Date.now()}`;
    const record = await WizardSessionRepo.createSession({
      sessionId,
      companyId: params.companyId,
      entryPath: normalizedPath as any,
      totalSteps: 6,
      initialDraft: params.initialDraft || {},
    });

    return this.mapRecord(record);
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves an existing session by ID.
   */
  public async getSession(sessionId: string): Promise<WizardSession | null> {
    const record = await WizardSessionRepo.getSession(sessionId);
    return record ? this.mapRecord(record) : null;
  }

  /**
   * Saves and validates step-by-step progress for an active wizard session.
   * Enforces core business invariants per step.
   */
  public async saveStepDraft(
    sessionId: string,
    step: number,
    stepPayload: Record<string, any>
  ): Promise<WizardSession> {
    if (step < 1 || step > 6) {
      throw new Error(`WIZARD_VALIDATION_ERROR: Step must be between 1 and 6, received ${step}.`);
    }

    const session = await WizardSessionRepo.getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`WIZARD_NOT_FOUND: Session '${sessionId}' does not exist.`);
    }

    if (session.status === "COMPLETED") {
      throw new Error(`WIZARD_ALREADY_COMPLETED: Session '${sessionId}' is already activated and cannot be edited.`);
    }

    const currentDraft = { ...session.draft_payload };

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // STEP-SPECIFIC VALIDATION AND ENFORCEMENT
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    switch (step) {
      case 1: {
        // Step 1: Company Profile
        if (!stepPayload.companyName || stepPayload.companyName.trim().length === 0) {
          throw new Error("STEP_1_VALIDATION: 'companyName' is required.");
        }
        currentDraft.step1_profile = {
          ...currentDraft.step1_profile,
          ...stepPayload,
          companyName: stepPayload.companyName,
          taxId: stepPayload.taxId || null,
          jurisdiction: stepPayload.jurisdiction || "US",
          reportingCurrency: stepPayload.reportingCurrency || "USD",
          businessDescription: stepPayload.businessDescription || "Autonomous treasury operations on Arc L1",
          adminEmail: stepPayload.adminEmail || currentDraft.step1_profile?.adminEmail,
        };
        break;
      }

      case 2: {
        // Step 2: Mathematical Rules Q&A
        if (Array.isArray(stepPayload.answers) && stepPayload.answers.length > 0) {
          const evalResults = this.mathEngine.evaluateAnswers(stepPayload.answers);
          await this.mathEngine.persistQAResponses(session.company_id, evalResults);
          currentDraft.step2_math_rules = {
            rawAnswers: stepPayload.answers,
            derivedParameters: evalResults.reduce((acc, r) => {
              acc[r.derivedParameterName] = r.derivedValue;
              return acc;
            }, {} as Record<string, number>),
          };
        } else if (stepPayload.derivedParameters) {
          currentDraft.step2_math_rules = stepPayload;
        }
        break;
      }

      case 3: {
        // Step 3: Declared Policies for all Agent Actions
        currentDraft.step3_declared_policies = {
          costCenterRules: Array.isArray(stepPayload.costCenterRules) ? stepPayload.costCenterRules : [],
          anomalyTolerances: stepPayload.anomalyTolerances || {
            maxPriceHikePercentage: 15.0,
            flagUnregisteredVendors: true,
            requireThreeWayMatch: true,
          },
          reviewTriggers: Array.isArray(stepPayload.reviewTriggers) ? stepPayload.reviewTriggers : [],
          investmentPolicies: stepPayload.investmentPolicies || {
            targetAllocationRatio: 0.80,
            minSweepThresholdUsdc: 50.0,
            hysteresisBandUsdc: 25.0,
          },
        };
        break;
      }

      case 4: {
        // Step 4: Operating Accounts & Per-Account Policies
        if (!Array.isArray(stepPayload.accounts) || stepPayload.accounts.length === 0) {
          throw new Error("STEP_4_VALIDATION: At least one operating account must be configured in Step 4.");
        }

        const validRoles: AccountRole[] = ["TREASURY_RESERVE", "PAYROLL", "OPEX_DEV", "OPEX_GROWTH", "OPEX_LEGAL", "TAX_ESCROW", "DEFI_DISPATCH"];
        const seenIds = new Set<string>();

        const validatedAccounts = stepPayload.accounts.map((acc: any) => {
          if (!acc.accountId || !acc.name || !acc.role) {
            throw new Error(`STEP_4_VALIDATION: Account requires 'accountId', 'name', and 'role'. Received: ${JSON.stringify(acc)}`);
          }
          if (seenIds.has(acc.accountId)) {
            throw new Error(`STEP_4_VALIDATION: Duplicate accountId '${acc.accountId}' detected.`);
          }
          seenIds.add(acc.accountId);

          if (!validRoles.includes(acc.role)) {
            throw new Error(`STEP_4_VALIDATION: Invalid role '${acc.role}' for account '${acc.accountId}'. Valid roles: ${validRoles.join(", ")}`);
          }

          return {
            accountId: acc.accountId,
            name: acc.name,
            role: acc.role,
            minOperatingFloorUsdc: Number(acc.minOperatingFloorUsdc ?? (acc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 100.0 : 50.0)),
            safetyBufferRatio: Number(acc.safetyBufferRatio ?? (acc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 1.25 : 1.20)),
            perTxCapUsdc: Number(acc.perTxCapUsdc ?? 500.0),
            dailyCapUsdc: Number(acc.dailyCapUsdc ?? 5000.0),
            weeklyCapUsdc: Number(acc.weeklyCapUsdc ?? 25000.0),
            monthlyCapUsdc: Number(acc.monthlyCapUsdc ?? 100000.0),
            authorizedCategories: Array.isArray(acc.authorizedCategories) ? acc.authorizedCategories : ["GENERAL_OPEX"],
            maxAutonomousSweepUsdc: Number(acc.maxAutonomousSweepUsdc ?? (acc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 0.0 : 1000.0)),
            excludeFromWaterfall: acc.role === "PAYROLL" ? true : Boolean(acc.excludeFromWaterfall),
            walletAddress: acc.walletAddress || null,
          };
        });

        currentDraft.step4_accounts = validatedAccounts;
        break;
      }

      case 5: {
        // Step 5: Recurring Liabilities (Strictly user-attached to Step 4 accounts)
        if (!currentDraft.step4_accounts || currentDraft.step4_accounts.length === 0) {
          throw new Error("STEP_5_VALIDATION_ERROR: Cannot configure liabilities before configuring accounts in Step 4.");
        }

        const validAccountIds = new Set<string>(currentDraft.step4_accounts.map((a: any) => a.accountId));
        const liabilitiesList = Array.isArray(stepPayload.liabilities) ? stepPayload.liabilities : [];

        const validatedLiabilities = liabilitiesList.map((liab: any) => {
          if (!liab.title || !liab.accountId || !liab.vendorId || liab.amountUsdc === undefined) {
            throw new Error(`STEP_5_VALIDATION_ERROR: Liability requires 'title', 'accountId', 'vendorId', and 'amountUsdc'.`);
          }

          // Strict Invariant 2: User must attach each liability to an account finalized in Step 4
          if (!validAccountIds.has(liab.accountId)) {
            throw new Error(
              `LIABILITY_ATTACHMENT_ERROR (Invariant 2): Liability '${liab.title}' references account '${liab.accountId}', which was not declared in Step 4. Available accounts: [${Array.from(validAccountIds).join(", ")}]`
            );
          }

          const amountNum = Number(liab.amountUsdc);
          if (isNaN(amountNum) || amountNum <= 0) {
            throw new Error(`STEP_5_VALIDATION_ERROR: Liability amount must be positive. Received: ${liab.amountUsdc}`);
          }

          const validRails = [
            "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
            "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY",
            "MODULAR_SESSION_KEYS",
            "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION",
            "GATEWAY_X402",
            "FIAT_PAYOUT",
          ];
          const rawRail = liab.preferredPaymentRail || (liab.fiatDetails ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT");
          const rail = rawRail === "MODULAR_SESSION_KEYS" ? "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY" : rawRail;
          if (!validRails.includes(rawRail)) {
            throw new Error(`STEP_5_VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid payment rail '${rawRail}'. Must be one of: ${validRails.join(", ")}`);
          }

          const fiatDetails = liab.fiatDetails || (liab.paymentRailConfig?.beneficiaryBank ? liab.paymentRailConfig.beneficiaryBank : undefined);
          const subMethod = liab.preferredSubMethod || fiatDetails?.paymentSubMethod || (fiatDetails?.cardToken ? "PUSH_TO_CARD" : (rail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" ? "FEDWIRE" : undefined));

          return {
            title: liab.title,
            accountId: liab.accountId,
            vendorId: liab.vendorId,
            vendorName: liab.vendorName || liab.vendorId,
            category: (liab.category as LiabilityCategory) || "SAAS",
            amountUsdc: amountNum,
            dueDate: liab.dueDate ? new Date(liab.dueDate).toISOString() : new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86400 * 1000).toISOString(),
            frequencyCron: liab.frequencyCron || "0 0 1 * *",
            payoutAddress: liab.payoutAddress || null,
            serviceUrl: liab.serviceUrl || liab.cryptoDetails?.serviceEndpointUrl || null,
            poReference: liab.poReference || null,
            preferredPaymentRail: rail,
            preferredSubMethod: subMethod,
            fiatDetails: fiatDetails || null,
            cryptoDetails: liab.cryptoDetails || null,
            paymentRailConfig: {
              ...(liab.paymentRailConfig || {}),
              subMethod,
              beneficiaryBank: fiatDetails,
            },
            disbursalRules: liab.disbursalRules || {
              autoPayThresholdUsdc: 500,
              requireThreeWayMatch: true,
              preFlightLeadTimeHours: 48,
            },
            waterfallOverride: liab.waterfallOverride || null,
          };
        });

        currentDraft.step5_liabilities = validatedLiabilities;
        break;
      }

      case 6: {
        // Step 6: Review, Disbursal Rules, Waterfall & Finalization
        currentDraft.step6_review = {
          waterfallConditions: stepPayload.waterfallConditions || {
            requireHumanApprovalForNonOperational: true,
            strictPayrollExclusion: true,
          },
          disbursalSettings: stepPayload.disbursalSettings || {
            defaultAutoPayCeilingUsdc: 500.0,
            requireThreeWayMatch: true,
            preFlightStagingHours: 48,
          },
          cfoConfirmation: Boolean(stepPayload.cfoConfirmation),
        };
        break;
      }
    }

    const nextStep = Math.min(step + 1, 6);
    const newStatus = step === 6 || (currentDraft.step4_accounts && currentDraft.step5_liabilities)
      ? "DRAFT_READY"
      : "IN_PROGRESS";

    const updated = await WizardSessionRepo.updateStepDraft({
      sessionId,
      currentStep: nextStep,
      draftPayload: currentDraft,
      completedStep: step,
      status: newStatus,
    });

    return this.mapRecord(updated);
  }

  /**
   * Path B: Pre-populates the wizard draft from connected SaaS, Cloud, or ERP sources.
   * Extracts candidate cost centers and discovered liabilities for user review.
   */
  public async prefillDraftFromConnectedSource(
    sessionId: string,
    discoveredData: Record<string, any>
  ): Promise<WizardSession> {
    const session = await WizardSessionRepo.getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`WIZARD_NOT_FOUND: Session '${sessionId}' does not exist.`);
    }

    const currentDraft = { ...session.draft_payload };

    // 1. Ingest Discovered Cost Centers into Candidate Step 4 Accounts
    if (Array.isArray(discoveredData.costCenters) && discoveredData.costCenters.length > 0) {
      currentDraft.step4_accounts = discoveredData.costCenters.map((cc: any) => ({
        accountId: cc.accountId || cc.id,
        name: cc.name,
        role: cc.role || "OPEX_DEV",
        minOperatingFloorUsdc: cc.monthlyCommittedSpend ? Math.max(50.0, cc.monthlyCommittedSpend * 0.1) : 50.0,
        safetyBufferRatio: cc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 1.25 : 1.20,
        perTxCapUsdc: 2500.0,
        dailyCapUsdc: 15000.0,
        weeklyCapUsdc: 50000.0,
        monthlyCapUsdc: 200000.0,
        authorizedCategories: cc.categories || ["INFRASTRUCTURE", "SAAS", "GENERAL_OPEX"],
        maxAutonomousSweepUsdc: cc.role === "PAYROLL" ? 0.0 : 5000.0,
        excludeFromWaterfall: cc.role === "PAYROLL",
        walletAddress: null,
      }));
    }

    // 2. Ingest Discovered Liabilities
    if (Array.isArray(discoveredData.invoices) && discoveredData.invoices.length > 0) {
      currentDraft.step5_liabilities = discoveredData.invoices.map((inv: any) => ({
        title: inv.title || `Invoice ${inv.invoiceNumber || inv.id || "SAAS"}`,
        accountId: inv.costCenter || (currentDraft.step4_accounts ? currentDraft.step4_accounts[0]?.accountId : "acc_general_ops"),
        vendorId: inv.supplierId || inv.vendorId || "vendor_discovered",
        vendorName: inv.supplierName || inv.vendorName || "Discovered Vendor",
        category: inv.category || "SAAS",
        amountUsdc: Number(inv.amountUsdc || inv.amount || 100.0),
        dueDate: inv.dueDate ? new Date(inv.dueDate).toISOString() : new Date(Date.now() + 14 * 86400 * 1000).toISOString(),
        frequencyCron: inv.frequencyCron || "0 0 1 * *",
        payoutAddress: inv.payoutAddress || null,
        serviceUrl: inv.serviceUrl || null,
        poReference: inv.purchaseOrderNumber || inv.poReference || null,
        preferredPaymentRail: inv.serviceUrl ? "GATEWAY_X402" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
        paymentRailConfig: {},
        disbursalRules: {
          autoPayThresholdUsdc: 500,
          requireThreeWayMatch: true,
          preFlightLeadTimeHours: 48,
        },
      }));
    }

    // 3. Synthesize Initial Math Q&A Parameters
    const highestBill = discoveredData.invoices?.reduce((max: number, inv: any) => Math.max(max, Number(inv.amountUsdc || 0)), 1000) || 1000;
    currentDraft.step2_math_rules = {
      derivedParameters: {
        single_tx_human_gate_threshold_usdc: highestBill * 1.25,
        aggregate_company_daily_cap_usdc: highestBill * 5,
        max_price_variance_percent: 10,
        target_yield_allocation_ratio: 0.80,
        min_sweep_threshold_usdc: 50.0,
        hysteresis_band_usdc: 25.0,
      },
    };

    currentDraft.connectedSources = discoveredData.connectedApps || [session.entry_path];

    const updated = await WizardSessionRepo.updateStepDraft({
      sessionId,
      currentStep: 4, // Land user on Step 4 to review and customize candidate accounts
      draftPayload: currentDraft,
      status: "DRAFT_READY",
    });

    return this.mapRecord(updated);
  }

  /**
   * Updates the full draft payload directly.
   */
  public async updateDraft(
    sessionId: string,
    updatedDraft: Record<string, any>
  ): Promise<WizardSession> {
    const session = await WizardSessionRepo.getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`WIZARD_NOT_FOUND: Session '${sessionId}' does not exist.`);
    }

    const updated = await WizardSessionRepo.updateStepDraft({
      sessionId,
      currentStep: session.current_step,
      draftPayload: updatedDraft,
    });

    return this.mapRecord(updated);
  }

  /**
   * Finalizes the onboarding flow and activates the organization.
   * Atomically provisions all accounts, liabilities, vendor registries, policies, and ledger vouchers.
   */
  public async activateOrganization(
    sessionId: string
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; companyId: string; dashboardUrl: string }> {
    const session = await WizardSessionRepo.getSession(sessionId);
    if (!session) {
      throw new Error(`WIZARD_NOT_FOUND: Session '${sessionId}' does not exist.`);
    }

    const draft = session.draft_payload;
    const companyId = session.company_id;

    if (!draft.step4_accounts || draft.step4_accounts.length === 0) {
      throw new Error("ACTIVATION_FAILED: No operating accounts found in wizard draft. Step 4 must be completed.");
    }

    const accounts: any[] = draft.step4_accounts;
    const liabilities: any[] = draft.step5_liabilities || [];
    const profileData = draft.step1_profile || { companyName: companyId };
    const declaredPolicies = draft.step3_declared_policies || {};
    const mathRules = draft.step2_math_rules || {};

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // ATOMIC TRANSACTION: PROVISION ORGANIZATION ASSETS
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    await DbClient.withTransaction(async () => {
      // 1. Provision Multi-Tenant IAM Organization in tenants table
      const existingTenant = await TenantRepo.getTenantById(companyId);
      if (!existingTenant) {
        await TenantRepo.createTenant({
          tenant_id: companyId,
          slug: profileData.slug || companyId.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/g, "-"),
          name: profileData.companyName || companyId,
          legal_name: profileData.legalName || profileData.companyName || companyId,
          country: profileData.country || "US",
          status: "ACTIVE",
          settings: {
            baseCurrency: "USDC",
            defaultReserveRatio: 1.20,
            primaryEntryPath: session.entry_path,
          },
        });
      }

      // 1b. If user credentials provided in draft, provision user and OWNER membership
      const adminEmail = profileData.adminEmail || profileData.userEmail || draft.userEmail;
      if (adminEmail) {
        let user = await UserRepo.getUserByEmail(adminEmail);
        if (!user) {
          const rawPass = profileData.adminPassword || "WelcomeBizArc2026!";
          const hash = await PasswordHasher.hashPassword(rawPass);
          user = await UserRepo.createUser({
            email: adminEmail,
            password_hash: hash,
            full_name: profileData.adminName || profileData.contactName || "Primary Administrator",
          });
        }
        await TenantMembershipRepo.addMember({
          tenant_id: companyId,
          user_id: user.user_id,
          role: "OWNER",
        });
      }

      // 2. Provision Company Profile in PostgreSQL
      const profileRecord: CompanyProfileRecord = {
        company_id: companyId,
        company_name: profileData.companyName,
        business_description: profileData.businessDescription || "Autonomous enterprise treasury on Arc L1",
        connected_apps: draft.connectedSources || [session.entry_path],
        discovered_cost_centers: accounts.map((a) => ({
          accountId: a.accountId,
          name: a.name,
          role: a.role,
          allocatedMonthlySpendUsdc: a.dailyCapUsdc ? a.dailyCapUsdc * 20 : 5000,
        })),
        inferred_policies: {
          mathematicalRules: mathRules.derivedParameters || {},
          declaredPolicies: declaredPolicies,
        },
        activation_status: "ACTIVATED",
      };
      await CompanyProfileRepo.upsertProfile(profileRecord);

      // 3. Provision Step 4 Operating Accounts
      for (const acc of accounts) {
        const deterministicWallet: `0x${string}` = acc.walletAddress && acc.walletAddress.startsWith("0x")
          ? acc.walletAddress
          : (`0x${crypto.createHash("sha256").update(`${companyId}:${acc.accountId}`).digest("hex").slice(0, 40)}` as `0x${string}`);

        await TreasuryAccountsRepo.upsertAccount({
          account_id: acc.accountId,
          company_id: companyId,
          name: acc.name,
          role: acc.role,
          wallet_address: deterministicWallet,
          chain_id: 5042002, // Arc Testnet
          min_operating_floor_usdc: acc.minOperatingFloorUsdc,
          safety_buffer_ratio: acc.safetyBufferRatio,
          is_active: true,
          per_tx_cap_usdc: acc.perTxCapUsdc,
          daily_cap_usdc: acc.dailyCapUsdc,
          weekly_cap_usdc: acc.weeklyCapUsdc,
          monthly_cap_usdc: acc.monthlyCapUsdc,
          authorized_categories: acc.authorizedCategories,
          max_autonomous_sweep_usdc: acc.maxAutonomousSweepUsdc,
          exclude_from_waterfall: acc.excludeFromWaterfall,
          account_declared_policies: acc.accountDeclaredPolicies || {},
        });
      }

      // 4. Register Vendors & Provision Step 5 Liabilities with Unified Fiat/Crypto Settings
      for (const liab of liabilities) {
        let bankAccountId: string | undefined;
        const isFiat = liab.preferredPaymentRail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" || !!liab.fiatDetails;

        // 4a. Register Bank Account if Fiat Details provided
        if (isFiat) {
          const fiat = liab.fiatDetails || liab.paymentRailConfig?.beneficiaryBank;
          if (fiat) {
            const subMethod = liab.preferredSubMethod || fiat.paymentSubMethod || (fiat.cardToken ? "PUSH_TO_CARD" : "FEDWIRE");
            const bankRecord = await VendorBankRepo.createBankAccount({
              vendor_id: liab.vendorId,
              account_holder_name: fiat.accountHolderName || liab.vendorName || liab.vendorId,
              iban_account_number: fiat.ibanOrAccountNumber || (fiat.accountNumber || "N/A"),
              routing_swift: fiat.routingOrSwift || fiat.routingNumber || (subMethod === "PUSH_TO_CARD" ? "CARD_OCT" : "021000018"),
              bank_name: fiat.bankName,
              bank_country: fiat.bankCountry || "US",
              payment_sub_method: subMethod,
              card_token: fiat.cardToken || null,
              card_last4: fiat.cardLast4 || (fiat.ibanOrAccountNumber && fiat.ibanOrAccountNumber.length === 16 ? fiat.ibanOrAccountNumber.slice(-4) : null),
              card_network: fiat.cardNetwork || null,
              is_verified: true,
              verified_by_admin: "ONBOARDING_WIZARD",
            });
            bankAccountId = bankRecord.bank_account_id;
          }
        }

        // 4b. Determine Verified Payout Address for Vendor Master
        let payoutAddr = liab.payoutAddress;
        if (!payoutAddr || typeof payoutAddr !== "string" || !payoutAddr.startsWith("0x") || payoutAddr.length !== 42) {
          payoutAddr = liab.cryptoDetails?.walletAddress || null;
        }

        // Register in Vendor Master Registry
        await VendorMasterRepo.registerVendor({
          vendor_id: liab.vendorId,
          company_id: companyId,
          name: liab.vendorName || liab.vendorId,
          verified_payout_address: payoutAddr && payoutAddr.startsWith("0x") ? (payoutAddr as `0x${string}`) : null,
          verified_by_admin: "ONBOARDING_WIZARD",
          last_verified_at: new Date(),
          change_lock: true,
        });

        // 3c. Persist to VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo
        await VendorPaymentPreferenceRepo.setPreference({
          vendor_id: liab.vendorId,
          preferred_rail: liab.preferredPaymentRail || (isFiat ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT"),
          preferred_sub_method: liab.preferredSubMethod || null,
          crypto_wallet_address: liab.cryptoDetails?.walletAddress || (payoutAddr && payoutAddr.startsWith("0x") ? payoutAddr : null),
          crypto_chain_id: liab.cryptoDetails?.chainId ?? 5042,
          crypto_token_symbol: liab.cryptoDetails?.tokenSymbol || "USDC",
          bank_account_id: bankAccountId || null,
          service_endpoint_url: liab.serviceUrl || liab.cryptoDetails?.serviceEndpointUrl || null,
          session_key_id: liab.paymentRailConfig?.sessionKeyId || liab.cryptoDetails?.sessionKeyId || null,
          configuration_payload: {
            disbursalRules: liab.disbursalRules,
            fiatDetails: liab.fiatDetails,
          },
        });

        // Compute Document Hashes
        const poHash = liab.poReference
          ? keccak256(stringToHex(`PO:${liab.poReference}:${liab.amountUsdc}`))
          : null;
        const invHash = keccak256(stringToHex(`INV:${liab.title}:${liab.amountUsdc}:${Date.now()}`));

        const updatedConfig = {
          ...(liab.paymentRailConfig || {}),
          subMethod: liab.preferredSubMethod,
          bankAccountId,
          serviceUrl: liab.serviceUrl || liab.cryptoDetails?.serviceEndpointUrl,
          sessionKeyId: liab.paymentRailConfig?.sessionKeyId || liab.cryptoDetails?.sessionKeyId,
          beneficiaryBank: liab.fiatDetails || liab.paymentRailConfig?.beneficiaryBank,
        };

        await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
          company_id: companyId,
          account_id: liab.accountId,
          vendor_id: liab.vendorId,
          title: liab.title,
          category: liab.category,
          amount_usdc: liab.amountUsdc,
          due_date: new Date(liab.dueDate),
          frequency_cron: liab.frequencyCron || "0 0 1 * *",
          payout_address: isFiat && !liab.payoutAddress?.startsWith("0x") ? (bankAccountId || liab.vendorId) : payoutAddr,
          source_po_hash: poHash,
          source_invoice_hash: invHash,
          status: "SCHEDULED",
          preferred_payment_rail: liab.preferredPaymentRail || (isFiat ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT"),
          payment_rail_config: updatedConfig,
          disbursal_rules: liab.disbursalRules || {},
          waterfall_override: liab.waterfallOverride || null,
        });

        if (liab.preferredPaymentRail === "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY") {
          const sessionKeyId = liab.paymentRailConfig?.sessionKeyId || `session_${liab.vendorId}`;
          const maxCycleUsdc = Number(liab.paymentRailConfig?.maxAmountPerCycleUsdc || liab.amountUsdc * 2 || 1000.0);
          const cycleDuration = Number(liab.paymentRailConfig?.cycleDurationSeconds || 30 * 86400);
          const validUntil = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 365 * 86400;
          await SessionKeyRepo.upsertSessionKey({
            session_key_id: sessionKeyId,
            account_id: liab.accountId,
            allowed_recipient: payoutAddr as `0x${string}`,
            max_amount_per_cycle_usdc: maxCycleUsdc,
            cycle_duration_seconds: cycleDuration,
            current_cycle_spent_usdc: 0,
            valid_until_timestamp: validUntil,
            public_key_hex: `0x${crypto.createHash("sha256").update(`${companyId}:${sessionKeyId}`).digest("hex")}`,
            is_active: true,
          });
        }
      }

      // 4. Record Genesis Voucher in Master System Journal
      const primaryAccount = accounts[0].accountId;
      await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
        account_id: primaryAccount,
        company_id: companyId,
        action_type: "GENESIS_ONBOARDING",
        debit_account: `${companyId}:TREASURY_EQUITY`,
        credit_account: `${companyId}:${primaryAccount}`,
        amount_usdc: 0.0,
        document_ref: `GENESIS_${companyId}_${Date.now()}`,
      });

      // 5. Append Audit Log
      await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
        account_id: primaryAccount,
        action_type: "ORGANIZATION_ONBOARDING_ACTIVATED",
        amount_usdc: 0.0,
        is_autonomous: true,
        reason: `Onboarding completed successfully via path '${session.entry_path}'. ${accounts.length} accounts and ${liabilities.length} liabilities provisioned.`,
        pre_state_snapshot: { status: "IN_PROGRESS" },
        post_state_snapshot: { status: "ACTIVATED", companyId, accountsCount: accounts.length, liabilitiesCount: liabilities.length },
        actor_agent: "OnboardingWizardService",
      });

      // 6. Mark Wizard Session Completed
      await WizardSessionRepo.updateStatus(sessionId, "COMPLETED");
    });

    // Invalidate Multi-Tenant Policy Cache
    await this.tenantPolicyManager.invalidateCache(companyId);

    return {
      success: true,
      companyId,
      dashboardUrl: `/dashboard/${companyId}`,
    };
  }

  private mapRecord(record: WizardSessionRecord): WizardSession {
    return {
      sessionId: record.session_id,
      companyId: record.company_id,
      currentStep: record.current_step,
      totalSteps: record.total_steps,
      entryPath: record.entry_path,
      draftPayload: record.draft_payload || {},
      completedSteps: Array.isArray(record.completed_steps) ? record.completed_steps : [],
      status: record.status,
    };
  }
}


------------------------------------------------------------
File: intakeDiscoveryAgent.ts

/**
 * IntakeDiscoveryAgent (Section 4.4 & Section 6 of complete-analysis.md).
 * Automatically ingests documents, invoices, and SaaS schedules from:
 * 1. Google Workspace MCP Client (Gmail, Drive)
 * 2. Microsoft 365 MCP Client (OneDrive, Excel)
 * 3. Top 10 Major Enterprise Vendor Connectors (AWS, GitHub, Datadog, GCP, Azure, OpenAI, Stripe, Snowflake, Twilio, Figma)
 * 4. ERP Integrations (Odoo, ERPNext)
 *
 * Normalizes tags & dimensions, infers suggested account roles (Step 4 proposals),
 * validates counterparties against VendorMasterRepo (Rule 3 Payee Verification),
 * evaluates stealth price creep against contract baselines, and prepares draft pre-fill payloads.
 */

import { McpAppConnector, McpAggregatedFinancialData } from "../connectors/mcpAppConnector.js";
import { VendorBillingAggregator, Top10VendorAggregatedData } from "../connectors/vendorBillingAggregator.js";
import { SessionErpSyncService, ErpSyncResult } from "../connectors/sessionErpSyncService.js";
import { VendorMasterRepo, VendorMasterRecord } from "../database/repos/vendorMasterRepo.js";
import { OnboardingWizardService } from "./onboardingWizardService.js";
import { MasterJournalRepo } from "../database/repos/masterJournalRepo.js";
import { IVendorTransport } from "../connectors/vendorBillingTypes.js";
import { IGoogleWorkspaceMcpTransport } from "../connectors/googleWorkspaceMcpClient.js";
import { IMicrosoft365McpTransport } from "../connectors/microsoft365McpClient.js";

import { VendorBankRepo } from "../database/repos/vendorBankRepo.js";

export interface DiscoveredCostCenterCandidate {
  tag: string;
  name: string;
  suggestedRole: "OPEX_INFRA" | "OPEX_DEV" | "OPEX_GROWTH" | "OPEX_AI" | "OPEX_SUPPORT" | "OPEX_DESIGN" | "OPEX_PRODUCT" | "TREASURY_RESERVE";
  dimensionSource: string;
  sourceSystem: string;
}

export interface DiscoveredLiabilityCandidate {
  invoiceId: string;
  vendorName: string;
  vendorId: string;
  amountUsdc: number;
  dueDate: string;
  payoutAddress: string;
  poNumber?: string;
  costCenterTag: string;
  optimalRail: "DISBURSAL_VAULT" | "MODULAR_SESSION_KEY" | "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION" | "GATEWAY_X402" | "FIAT_PAYOUT";
  payeeVerified: boolean;
  stealthCreepDetected: boolean;
  stealthCreepClause?: string;
  beneficiaryBank?: any;
}

export interface IntakeSynthesisResult {
  companyId: string;
  totalCommittedMonthlySpendUsdc: number;
  discoveredCostCenters: DiscoveredCostCenterCandidate[];
  discoveredLiabilities: DiscoveredLiabilityCandidate[];
  connectedSources: string[];
  stealthCreepAlerts: Array<{
    vendorName: string;
    billedAmountUsdc: number;
    baselineAmountUsdc: number;
    clause: string;
  }>;
}

export class IntakeDiscoveryAgent {
  private companyId: string;
  private mcpConnector: McpAppConnector;
  private vendorAggregator: VendorBillingAggregator;

  constructor(options: {
    companyId: string;
    googleTransport?: IGoogleWorkspaceMcpTransport;
    microsoftTransport?: IMicrosoft365McpTransport;
    vendorTransports?: Partial<Record<string, IVendorTransport>>;
  }) {
    this.companyId = options.companyId;
    this.mcpConnector = new McpAppConnector({
      companyId: this.companyId,
      googleTransport: options.googleTransport,
      microsoftTransport: options.microsoftTransport,
    });
    this.vendorAggregator = new VendorBillingAggregator(this.companyId, options.vendorTransports);
  }

  /**
   * Synthesizes financial data across connected workspace apps, ERPs, and top 10 vendors.
   */
  public async synthesizeAllSources(): Promise<IntakeSynthesisResult> {
    const connectedSources: string[] = [];
    const costCenterMap = new Map<string, DiscoveredCostCenterCandidate>();
    const liabilities: DiscoveredLiabilityCandidate[] = [];
    const stealthCreepAlerts: Array<{
      vendorName: string;
      billedAmountUsdc: number;
      baselineAmountUsdc: number;
      clause: string;
    }> = [];

    // 1. Gather Workspace Documents (Google Workspace & Microsoft 365 MCP)
    try {
      const workspaceData: McpAggregatedFinancialData = await this.mcpConnector.aggregateAllCompanyAppData();
      connectedSources.push(...workspaceData.connectedApps);

      for (const tag of workspaceData.extractedCostCenterTags) {
        if (!costCenterMap.has(tag)) {
          costCenterMap.set(tag, {
            tag,
            name: tag,
            suggestedRole: this.inferRoleFromTag(tag),
            dimensionSource: "Workspace Document Extraction (Gmail / OneDrive)",
            sourceSystem: "WORKSPACE_MCP",
          });
        }
      }

      for (const inv of workspaceData.discoveredInvoices) {
        const payoutAddr = inv.payoutAddress || "0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000";
        const isVerified = await this.verifyPayee(payoutAddr, inv.vendorName);
        liabilities.push({
          invoiceId: (inv as any).invoiceId || inv.documentId || `INV-${Date.now()}`,
          vendorName: inv.vendorName,
          vendorId: `vnd_${inv.vendorName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "_")}`,
          amountUsdc: inv.amountUsdc,
          dueDate: inv.dueDate,
          payoutAddress: payoutAddr,
          poNumber: inv.poNumber,
          costCenterTag: inv.costCenterTag || "Core Platform",
          optimalRail: "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
          payeeVerified: isVerified,
          stealthCreepDetected: false,
        });
      }

      // Check contract baseline commitments against invoices for stealth price creep
      for (const contract of workspaceData.discoveredContracts) {
        if (contract.stealthPriceCreepClause) {
          const matchingInvs = workspaceData.discoveredInvoices.filter((i) =>
            i.vendorName.toLowerCase().includes(contract.counterparty.toLowerCase().split(" ")[0])
          );
          for (const inv of matchingInvs) {
            if (inv.amountUsdc > contract.committedMonthlySpendUsdc * 1.05) {
              stealthCreepAlerts.push({
                vendorName: contract.counterparty,
                billedAmountUsdc: inv.amountUsdc,
                baselineAmountUsdc: contract.committedMonthlySpendUsdc,
                clause: contract.stealthPriceCreepClause,
              });
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn(`[IntakeDiscoveryAgent] Workspace MCP synthesis notice:`, err.message);
    }

    // 2. Gather Top 10 Major Enterprise Vendor Billing Data
    try {
      const vendorData: Top10VendorAggregatedData = await this.vendorAggregator.aggregateAllVendors();
      if (vendorData.vendors.length > 0) {
        connectedSources.push(`Top 10 Enterprise Vendors (${vendorData.vendors.length} connected)`);
      }

      for (const cc of vendorData.aggregatedCostCenters) {
        if (!costCenterMap.has(cc.tag)) {
          costCenterMap.set(cc.tag, {
            tag: cc.tag,
            name: cc.tag,
            suggestedRole: cc.suggestedRole,
            dimensionSource: cc.dimensionSource,
            sourceSystem: "VENDOR_BILLING_API",
          });
        }
      }

      for (const inv of vendorData.aggregatedInvoices) {
        const isVerified = await this.verifyPayee(inv.payoutAddress, inv.poNumber);
        liabilities.push({
          invoiceId: inv.invoiceId,
          vendorName: inv.poNumber.split("-")[2] || "Enterprise Vendor",
          vendorId: `vnd_${inv.invoiceId.split("-")[2]?.toLowerCase() || "vendor"}`,
          amountUsdc: inv.amountUsdc,
          dueDate: inv.dueDate,
          payoutAddress: inv.payoutAddress,
          poNumber: inv.poNumber,
          costCenterTag: inv.costCenterTag,
          optimalRail: "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
          payeeVerified: isVerified,
          stealthCreepDetected: false,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn(`[IntakeDiscoveryAgent] Vendor aggregator synthesis notice:`, err.message);
    }

    // 3. Gather ERP Sync Data (Odoo / ERPNext)
    try {
      const odooSync: ErpSyncResult = await SessionErpSyncService.syncOdoo(this.companyId);
      if (odooSync.connected) {
        connectedSources.push("Odoo ERP");
        for (const cc of odooSync.discoveredCostCenters) {
          costCenterMap.set(cc.name, {
            tag: cc.name,
            name: cc.name,
            suggestedRole: cc.role as any,
            dimensionSource: "Odoo Analytic Accounts",
            sourceSystem: "ODOO",
          });
        }
        if (Array.isArray(odooSync.discoveredLiabilities)) {
          for (const l of odooSync.discoveredLiabilities) {
            const vendorId = `vnd_${l.vendorName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "_")}`;
            const isVerified = await this.verifyPayee(vendorId, l.vendorName);
            liabilities.push({
              invoiceId: l.invoiceId,
              vendorName: l.vendorName,
              vendorId,
              amountUsdc: l.amountUsdc,
              dueDate: l.dueDate,
              payoutAddress: `BANK_${vendorId.toUpperCase()}`,
              poNumber: l.poNumber,
              costCenterTag: l.costCenterTag,
              optimalRail: "FIAT_PAYOUT",
              payeeVerified: isVerified,
              stealthCreepDetected: false,
            });
          }
        }
      }

      const erpNextSync: ErpSyncResult = await SessionErpSyncService.syncErpNext(this.companyId);
      if (erpNextSync.connected) {
        connectedSources.push("ERPNext");
        for (const cc of erpNextSync.discoveredCostCenters) {
          costCenterMap.set(cc.name, {
            tag: cc.name,
            name: cc.name,
            suggestedRole: cc.role as any,
            dimensionSource: "ERPNext Cost Center Hierarchy",
            sourceSystem: "ERPNEXT",
          });
        }
        if (Array.isArray(erpNextSync.discoveredLiabilities)) {
          for (const l of erpNextSync.discoveredLiabilities) {
            const vendorId = `vnd_${l.vendorName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "_")}`;
            const isVerified = await this.verifyPayee(vendorId, l.vendorName);
            liabilities.push({
              invoiceId: l.invoiceId,
              vendorName: l.vendorName,
              vendorId,
              amountUsdc: l.amountUsdc,
              dueDate: l.dueDate,
              payoutAddress: `BANK_${vendorId.toUpperCase()}`,
              poNumber: l.poNumber,
              costCenterTag: l.costCenterTag,
              optimalRail: "FIAT_PAYOUT",
              payeeVerified: isVerified,
              stealthCreepDetected: false,
            });
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn(`[IntakeDiscoveryAgent] ERP synthesis notice:`, err.message);
    }

    const totalCommittedMonthlySpendUsdc = Math.round(
      liabilities.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.amountUsdc, 0) * 100
    ) / 100;

    await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
      account_id: `acc_${this.companyId}_discovery`,
      company_id: this.companyId,
      action_type: "INTAKE_DISCOVERY_SYNTHESIZED",
      debit_account: "INTAKE_DISCOVERY",
      credit_account: "SYSTEM_LEDGER",
      amount_usdc: 0,
      document_ref: `DISCOVERY:SYNTHESIS:${this.companyId}:${Date.now()}`,
    });

    return {
      companyId: this.companyId,
      totalCommittedMonthlySpendUsdc,
      discoveredCostCenters: Array.from(costCenterMap.values()),
      discoveredLiabilities: liabilities,
      connectedSources,
      stealthCreepAlerts,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Pre-populates an onboarding wizard session draft from synthesized intake discoveries.
   */
  public async prefillWizardSession(sessionId: string): Promise<any> {
    const intakeResult = await this.synthesizeAllSources();

    const draftCostCenters = intakeResult.discoveredCostCenters.map((cc, idx) => ({
      accountId: `acc_${this.companyId}_${idx + 1}`,
      name: cc.name,
      role: cc.suggestedRole,
      tag: cc.tag,
      dimensionSource: cc.dimensionSource,
    }));

    const draftInvoices = intakeResult.discoveredLiabilities.map((l) => ({
      invoiceId: l.invoiceId,
      vendorName: l.vendorName,
      amountUsdc: l.amountUsdc,
      dueDate: l.dueDate,
      costCenterTag: l.costCenterTag,
      payoutAddress: l.payoutAddress,
      poNumber: l.poNumber,
      optimalRail: l.optimalRail,
    }));

    const wizardService = new OnboardingWizardService();
    return await wizardService.prefillDraftFromConnectedSource(sessionId, {
      costCenters: draftCostCenters,
      invoices: draftInvoices,
      connectedSources: intakeResult.connectedSources,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Rule 3 Payee Verification against VendorMasterRepo and VendorBankRepo.
   */
  private async verifyPayee(addressOrVendorId?: string, vendorName?: string): Promise<boolean> {
    if (addressOrVendorId && addressOrVendorId.startsWith("0x")) {
      const existing = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorByAddress(addressOrVendorId);
      if (existing) return true;
    }

    if (addressOrVendorId) {
      const byId = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorById(addressOrVendorId);
      if (byId) return true;
      const bankById = await VendorBankRepo.getVerifiedBankAccount(addressOrVendorId);
      if (bankById) return true;
    }

    if (vendorName) {
      const byName = await VendorMasterRepo.getVendorByName(vendorName);
      if (byName) return true;
      const byNameId = `vnd_${vendorName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "_")}`;
      const bankByNameId = await VendorBankRepo.getVerifiedBankAccount(byNameId);
      if (bankByNameId) return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  /**
   * Infers role from normalized tag names.
   */
  private inferRoleFromTag(
    tag: string
  ): "OPEX_INFRA" | "OPEX_DEV" | "OPEX_GROWTH" | "OPEX_AI" | "OPEX_SUPPORT" | "OPEX_DESIGN" | "OPEX_PRODUCT" | "TREASURY_RESERVE" {
    const lower = tag.toLowerCase();
    if (lower.includes("infra") || lower.includes("cloud") || lower.includes("cluster") || lower.includes("compute")) {
      return "OPEX_INFRA";
    }
    if (lower.includes("ai") || lower.includes("inference") || lower.includes("gpt") || lower.includes("model")) {
      return "OPEX_AI";
    }
    if (lower.includes("marketing") || lower.includes("growth") || lower.includes("sms") || lower.includes("carrier")) {
      return "OPEX_GROWTH";
    }
    if (lower.includes("design") || lower.includes("figma") || lower.includes("ui") || lower.includes("ux")) {
      return "OPEX_DESIGN";
    }
    if (lower.includes("product")) {
      return "OPEX_PRODUCT";
    }
    if (lower.includes("support")) {
      return "OPEX_SUPPORT";
    }
    return "OPEX_DEV";
  }
}

File: teamService.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
import { UserRepo, SafeUserRecord } from "../database/repos/userRepo.js";
import { TenantRepo, TenantRecord } from "../database/repos/tenantRepo.js";
import {
  TenantMembershipRepo,
  TenantRole,
  TenantMemberDetail,
  TenantMembershipRecord,
} from "../database/repos/tenantMembershipRepo.js";
import {
  TenantInvitationRepo,
  TenantInvitationRecord,
} from "../database/repos/tenantInvitationRepo.js";
import { UserSessionRepo } from "../database/repos/userSessionRepo.js";
import { PasswordHasher } from "../security/passwordHasher.js";

export class TeamService {
  /**
   * List all team members of a tenant with user profiles and assigned roles.
   */
  public static async getMembers(tenantId: string): Promise<TenantMemberDetail[]> {
    return TenantMembershipRepo.listMembers(tenantId);
  }

  /**
   * Creates an invitation to join an organization with a specific role.
   */
  public static async inviteMember(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    invitedByUserId: string;
    email: string;
    role: TenantRole;
  }): Promise<{ invitation: TenantInvitationRecord; inviteToken: string; inviteUrl: string }> {
    const email = params.email.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (!email || !email.includes("@")) {
      throw new Error("INVALID_EMAIL: A valid email address is required.");
    }

    // Check if target user is already a member
    const existingUser = await UserRepo.getUserByEmail(email);
    if (existingUser) {
      const existingMembership = await TenantMembershipRepo.getMembership(params.tenantId, existingUser.user_id);
      if (existingMembership && existingMembership.status === "ACTIVE") {
        throw new Error("USER_ALREADY_MEMBER: User is already an active member of this organization.");
      }
    }

    const tenant = await TenantRepo.getTenantById(params.tenantId);
    if (!tenant) {
      throw new Error("TENANT_NOT_FOUND: Organization does not exist.");
    }

    // Generate random invite token (valid for 7 days)
    const rawToken = PasswordHasher.generateSecureToken("inv", 32);
    const tokenHash = PasswordHasher.hashToken(rawToken);
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400 * 1000);

    const invitation = await TenantInvitationRepo.createInvitation({
      tenant_id: params.tenantId,
      email,
      role: params.role,
      invite_token_hash: tokenHash,
      invited_by_user_id: params.invitedByUserId,
      expires_at: expiresAt,
    });

    const inviteUrl = `/invite/accept?token=${rawToken}`;
    return { invitation, inviteToken: rawToken, inviteUrl };
  }

  /**
   * Accepts an invitation:
   * - If user doesn't exist, provisions user account with provided fullName and password
   * - Adds user to tenant with specified role
   * - Marks invitation as accepted
   * - Issues new session token
   */
  public static async acceptInvitation(params: {
    rawToken: string;
    password?: string;
    fullName?: string;
  }): Promise<{
    user: SafeUserRecord;
    tenant: TenantRecord;
    sessionToken: string;
    role: TenantRole;
    permissions: string[];
  }> {
    if (!params.rawToken) {
      throw new Error("TOKEN_REQUIRED: Invite token is required.");
    }

    const tokenHash = PasswordHasher.hashToken(params.rawToken);
    const invitation = await TenantInvitationRepo.getByTokenHash(tokenHash);

    if (!invitation || invitation.status !== "PENDING") {
      throw new Error("INVALID_INVITATION: Invitation is invalid, revoked, or already accepted.");
    }

    if (new Date(invitation.expires_at).getTime() < Date.now()) {
      throw new Error("INVITATION_EXPIRED: Invitation has expired.");
    }

    const tenant = await TenantRepo.getTenantById(invitation.tenant_id);
    if (!tenant || tenant.status === "SUSPENDED") {
      throw new Error("TENANT_UNAVAILABLE: Organization is unavailable.");
    }

    let user = await UserRepo.getUserByEmail(invitation.email);

    if (!user) {
      // New user signup via invite
      if (!params.password || params.password.length < 8) {
        throw new Error("PASSWORD_REQUIRED: A password of at least 8 characters is required for new accounts.");
      }
      if (!params.fullName || params.fullName.trim().length === 0) {
        throw new Error("NAME_REQUIRED: Full name is required for new accounts.");
      }

      const passwordHash = await PasswordHasher.hashPassword(params.password);
      user = await UserRepo.createUser({
        email: invitation.email,
        password_hash: passwordHash,
        full_name: params.fullName.trim(),
        status: "ACTIVE",
      });
    }

    // Add membership
    await TenantMembershipRepo.addMember({
      tenant_id: invitation.tenant_id,
      user_id: user.user_id,
      role: invitation.role,
      status: "ACTIVE",
    });

    // Mark invitation accepted
    await TenantInvitationRepo.acceptInvitation(invitation.invitation_id);

    // Issue session token
    const rawSessionToken = PasswordHasher.generateSecureToken("session_user", 32);
    const sessionTokenHash = PasswordHasher.hashToken(rawSessionToken);
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 86400 * 1000);

    await UserSessionRepo.createSession({
      user_id: user.user_id,
      active_tenant_id: tenant.tenant_id,
      token_hash: sessionTokenHash,
      expires_at: expiresAt,
    });

    const safeUser = UserRepo.toSafeUser(user);
    const permissions = TenantMembershipRepo.getPermissionsForRole(invitation.role);

    return {
      user: safeUser,
      tenant,
      sessionToken: rawSessionToken,
      role: invitation.role,
      permissions,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Promotes or demotes a team member.
   * Enforces that at least 1 OWNER remains.
   */
  public static async updateMemberRole(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    targetUserId: string;
    newRole: TenantRole;
    actorRole: TenantRole;
  }): Promise<TenantMembershipRecord> {
    if (params.actorRole !== "OWNER") {
      throw new Error("FORBIDDEN: Only organization Owners can change member roles.");
    }

    const currentMembership = await TenantMembershipRepo.getMembership(params.tenantId, params.targetUserId);
    if (!currentMembership) {
      throw new Error("MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND: User is not a member of this organization.");
    }

    // If demoting an OWNER, ensure they are not the sole remaining OWNER
    if (currentMembership.role === "OWNER" && params.newRole !== "OWNER") {
      const ownerCount = await TenantMembershipRepo.countOwners(params.tenantId);
      if (ownerCount <= 1) {
        throw new Error("SOLE_OWNER_DEMOTION: Cannot demote the sole remaining Owner of the organization.");
      }
    }

    const updated = await TenantMembershipRepo.updateRole(params.tenantId, params.targetUserId, params.newRole);
    if (!updated) {
      throw new Error("UPDATE_FAILED: Could not update member role.");
    }
    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Removes a member from an organization.
   * Enforces that the sole remaining OWNER cannot be removed.
   */
  public static async removeMember(params: {
    tenantId: string;
    targetUserId: string;
    actorRole: TenantRole;
  }): Promise<boolean> {
    if (params.actorRole !== "OWNER") {
      throw new Error("FORBIDDEN: Only organization Owners can remove team members.");
    }

    const currentMembership = await TenantMembershipRepo.getMembership(params.tenantId, params.targetUserId);
    if (!currentMembership) {
      throw new Error("MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND: Member does not exist.");
    }

    if (currentMembership.role === "OWNER") {
      const ownerCount = await TenantMembershipRepo.countOwners(params.tenantId);
      if (ownerCount <= 1) {
        throw new Error("SOLE_OWNER_REMOVAL: Cannot remove the sole remaining Owner of the organization.");
      }
    }

    return TenantMembershipRepo.removeMember(params.tenantId, params.targetUserId);
  }

  /**
   * Lists pending invitations for a tenant.
   */
  public static async listPendingInvitations(tenantId: string): Promise<TenantInvitationRecord[]> {
    return TenantInvitationRepo.listPendingForTenant(tenantId);
  }

  /**
   * Revokes a pending invitation.
   */
  public static async revokeInvitation(tenantId: string, invitationId: string, actorRole: TenantRole): Promise<boolean> {
    if (actorRole !== "OWNER") {
      throw new Error("FORBIDDEN: Only organization Owners can revoke invitations.");
    }
    return TenantInvitationRepo.revokeInvitation(invitationId, tenantId);
  }
}

File: treasurySentinelService.ts
------------------------------------------------------------
import { keccak256, stringToHex } from "viem";
import { AGENT_REGISTRY, AgentPersonaType } from "../types/agents.js";
import { StandardizedPermissionRequest, SPROption, SPRActionType } from "../types/sprs.js";
import { PolicyLoader } from "../config/policyLoader.js";
import { TenantPolicyManager } from "../config/tenantPolicyManager.js";
import { TreasuryAccountsRepo } from "../database/repos/treasuryAccountsRepo.js";
import { PermissionRequestRepo } from "../database/repos/permissionRequestRepo.js";
import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService } from "../contracts/centralTreasuryYieldVaultService.js";
import { CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI } from "../contracts/artifacts.js";
import { ArcTransactionExecutor } from "../foundation/wallets/arcTransactionExecutor.js";
import { AccountIntelligenceService } from "./accountIntelligenceService.js";
import { LedgerWitnessService } from "./ledgerWitnessService.js";
import { AuthorizationGate } from "../security/authorizationGate.js";
import { ReasonBearingIntentPayload } from "../agents/policyComplianceLlmAgent.js";

export interface BalanceMutationEvent {
  accountId: string;
  amountUsdc: number;
  currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: number;
  origin: "EXTERNAL_REVENUE" | "INTERNAL_SETTLEMENT" | "FAUCET_DRIP" | "DISBURSAL" | "USYC_RECALL" | string;
  txHash?: `0x${string}`;
  from?: `0x${string}`;
  to?: `0x${string}`;
  timestamp?: Date;
  forceImmediate?: boolean;
}

export interface SentinelEvaluationResult {
  accountId: string;
  liquidBalanceUsdc: number;
  targetReserveUsdc: number;
  safeToInvestUsdc: number;
  action: "SWEEP" | "RECALL" | "NONE" | "SPRS_REQUIRED";
  actionAmountUsdc: number;
  branch: "INSIDE_RULES" | "OUTSIDE_RULES" | "FILTERED_INTERNAL" | "PROTECTED_ACCOUNT" | "BELOW_HYSTERESIS";
  reason: string;
  encodedTx?: `0x${string}`;
  txHash?: `0x${string}`;
  clearanceCode?: string;
  sprs?: StandardizedPermissionRequest;
  witnessed?: boolean;
  timeHorizonSeconds?: number;
}

export class TreasurySentinelService {
  public readonly persona: AgentPersonaType = "TreasurySentinelAgent";
  public readonly erc8004Id = AGENT_REGISTRY.TreasurySentinelAgent.erc8004Id; // 101
  public readonly canSignTransactions = AGENT_REGISTRY.TreasurySentinelAgent.canSignTransactions; // true
  public readonly canWriteLedger = AGENT_REGISTRY.TreasurySentinelAgent.canWriteLedger; // false

  private accountIntelligenceService: AccountIntelligenceService;
  private vaultService: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService;
  private witnessAgent: LedgerWitnessService;
  private executor?: ArcTransactionExecutor;

  // Concurrency lock manager (D10.4)
  private accountLocks: Set<string> = new Set();

  // Debounce manager (D10.2)
  private debounceTimers: Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout> = new Map();
  private pendingDebounceEvents: Map<string, BalanceMutationEvent> = new Map();
  private debounceMs: number;

  constructor(options?: {
    intelService?: AccountIntelligenceService;
    vaultService?: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService;
    witnessAgent?: LedgerWitnessService;
    debounceMs?: number;
    vaultAddress?: `0x${string}`;
    executor?: ArcTransactionExecutor;
  }) {
    const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
    const vaultAddr = options?.vaultAddress ?? (profile.investment_rules?.target_vault as `0x${string}`) ?? "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555";
    this.vaultService = options?.vaultService ?? new CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService(vaultAddr);
    this.accountIntelligenceService = options?.intelService ?? new AccountIntelligenceService();
    this.witnessAgent = options?.witnessAgent ?? new LedgerWitnessService();
    this.executor = options?.executor;
    this.debounceMs = options?.debounceMs ?? 5000;
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // D10.4 CONCURRENCY ACCOUNT LOCK MANAGEMENT
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  public isAccountLocked(accountId: string): boolean {
    return this.accountLocks.has(accountId);
  }

  public acquireAccountLock(accountId: string): boolean {
    if (this.accountLocks.has(accountId)) {
      return false;
    }
    this.accountLocks.add(accountId);
    return true;
  }

  public releaseAccountLock(accountId: string): void {
    this.accountLocks.delete(accountId);
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // D10.3 INTERNAL-SETTLEMENT FILTERING
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  public isInternalSettlement(event: BalanceMutationEvent): boolean {
    if (
      event.origin === "INTERNAL_SETTLEMENT" ||
      event.origin === "USYC_RECALL" ||
      event.origin === "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP" ||
      event.origin === "DISBURSAL_STAGING"
    ) {
      return true;
    }

    const { profile } = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile();
    const vaultAddr = ((profile.investment_rules?.target_vault as string) || "").toLowerCase();
    const disbursalAddr = "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555".toLowerCase();

    if (event.from && (event.from.toLowerCase() === vaultAddr || event.from.toLowerCase() === disbursalAddr)) {
      return true;
    }
    if (event.to && (event.to.toLowerCase() === vaultAddr || event.to.toLowerCase() === disbursalAddr)) {
      return true;
    }

    return false;
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // D10.1 & D10.2 BALANCE EVENT INGESTION & DEBOUNCE
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  public async onBalanceMutation(
    event: BalanceMutationEvent
  ): Promise<SentinelEvaluationResult> {
    if (this.isInternalSettlement(event)) {
      return {
        accountId: event.accountId,
        liquidBalanceUsdc: event.currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
        targetReserveUsdc: 0,
        safeToInvestUsdc: 0,
        action: "NONE",
        actionAmountUsdc: 0,
        branch: "FILTERED_INTERNAL",
        reason: `Filtered internal settlement event from origin '${event.origin}' to prevent feedback loop.`,
      };
    }

    if (event.forceImmediate) {
      return this.executeEvaluation(event.accountId, event.currentLiquidBalanceUsdc);
    }

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      if (this.debounceTimers.has(event.accountId)) {
        clearTimeout(this.debounceTimers.get(event.accountId)!);
      }

      this.pendingDebounceEvents.set(event.accountId, event);

      const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
          const pending = this.pendingDebounceEvents.get(event.accountId) || event;
          this.debounceTimers.delete(event.accountId);
          this.pendingDebounceEvents.delete(event.accountId);
          const result = await this.executeEvaluation(pending.accountId, pending.currentLiquidBalanceUsdc);
          resolve(result);
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      }, this.debounceMs);

      this.debounceTimers.set(event.accountId, timer);
    });
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // D10.5 - D10.9 CORE EVALUATION & POLICY COMPLIANCE
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  public async evaluateAccount(
    accountId: string,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: number
  ): Promise<SentinelEvaluationResult> {
    return this.executeEvaluation(accountId, currentLiquidBalanceUsdc);
  }

  private async executeEvaluation(
    accountId: string,
    currentLiquidBalanceUsdc: number
  ): Promise<SentinelEvaluationResult> {
    if (!this.acquireAccountLock(accountId)) {
      throw new Error(`[TreasurySentinelService] Concurrency lock failed: Account '${accountId}' is currently being evaluated.`);
    }

    try {
      const accountRecord = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
      if (!accountRecord) {
        throw new Error(`[TreasurySentinelService] Account '${accountId}' not found in registry.`);
      }

      const companyId = accountRecord.company_id || "default_org";
      let profile: any;
      try {
        profile = await TenantPolicyManager.getInstance().getActiveProfile(companyId);
      } catch {
        profile = PolicyLoader.getActiveProfile().profile;
      }
      const opPolicy = profile.operating_accounts.find((a: any) => a.account_id === accountId);
      const invRules = profile.investment_rules;
      const spendingLimits = profile.spending_limits;

      // Check explicit policy configuration: an account only suppresses sweeps if its policy declares max_autonomous_sweep_limit <= 0
      const sweepLimit = opPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit ?? (accountRecord as any).max_autonomous_sweep_usdc;
      if (sweepLimit !== undefined && sweepLimit <= 0) {
        return {
          accountId,
          liquidBalanceUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
          targetReserveUsdc: 0,
          safeToInvestUsdc: 0,
          action: "NONE",
          actionAmountUsdc: 0,
          branch: "PROTECTED_ACCOUNT",
          reason: `Account '${accountId}' policy explicitly disables autonomous sweeps under strict corporate protection (max_autonomous_sweep_limit <= 0). All funds remain liquid.`,
        };
      }

      const intel = await this.accountIntelligenceService.getAccountIntelligence(accountId, {
        overrideLiquidBalance: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
      });

      const targetReserveUsdc = parseFloat(intel.solvencyMetrics.requiredReserveUsdc);
      const timeHorizonSeconds = intel.solvencyMetrics.timeHorizonSeconds;

      const rawSurplus = Math.max(
        0,
        currentLiquidBalanceUsdc - (targetReserveUsdc + invRules.invest_hysteresis_band_usdc)
      );

      if (rawSurplus < invRules.min_sweep_amount_usdc) {
        const recallThreshold = targetReserveUsdc - invRules.recall_hysteresis_band_usdc;
        if (currentLiquidBalanceUsdc < recallThreshold) {
          const recallAmount = Number((targetReserveUsdc - currentLiquidBalanceUsdc).toFixed(6));
          const recallAmountRaw = BigInt(Math.floor(recallAmount * 1_000_000));

          // D10.9 & D10D16: Submit Reason-Bearing Intent to PolicyComplianceAgent
          const intent: ReasonBearingIntentPayload = {
            proposedAction: "AUTONOMOUS_RECALL",
            accountId,
            amountUsdc: recallAmount.toFixed(6),
            declaredReason: `Liquid balance ($${currentLiquidBalanceUsdc.toFixed(6)}) dropped below recall threshold ($${recallThreshold.toFixed(6)}). Pre-funding operating reserve floor ($${targetReserveUsdc.toFixed(6)}) from USYC yield vault on Arc L1.`,
            currentLiquid: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc.toFixed(6),
            targetReserve: targetReserveUsdc.toFixed(6),
            safeToInvest: "0.000000",
          };

          const authResult = await AuthorizationGate.requestAuthorization({
            actionType: intent.proposedAction,
            accountId: intent.accountId,
            amountUsdc: intent.amountUsdc,
            declaredReason: intent.declaredReason,
          });

          if (!authResult.isAuthorized) {
            if (authResult.sprsRequestId) {
              return {
                accountId,
                liquidBalanceUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
                targetReserveUsdc,
                safeToInvestUsdc: 0,
                action: "SPRS_REQUIRED",
                actionAmountUsdc: recallAmount,
                branch: "OUTSIDE_RULES",
                reason: authResult.reason,
                timeHorizonSeconds,
              };
            }
            return {
              accountId,
              liquidBalanceUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
              targetReserveUsdc,
              safeToInvestUsdc: 0,
              action: "NONE",
              actionAmountUsdc: 0,
              branch: "OUTSIDE_RULES",
              reason: `Autonomous deficit recall rejected by PolicyComplianceAgent: ${authResult.reason}`,
              timeHorizonSeconds,
            };
          }

          const execution = await (this.executor ?? new ArcTransactionExecutor()).execute({
            targetContract: this.vaultService.getAddress(),
            abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
            functionName: "recallForAccount",
            args: [CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId), recallAmountRaw],
            idempotencyKey: `recall:${accountId}:${recallAmountRaw}:${Date.now()}`,
          });

          const docRef = `RECALL_INTENT_${accountId}_${Date.now()}`;
          await this.witnessAgent.witnessTransaction({
            accountId,
            actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_RECALL",
            amountUsdc: recallAmount,
            documentRef: docRef,
            txHash: execution.txHash,
            counterpartyAddress: accountRecord.wallet_address,
            reason: `Confirmed Arc recall from USYC Yield Vault (Clearance: ${authResult.clearanceCode})`,
          });

          await this.witnessAgent.recordAccountAuditLog({
            accountId,
            actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_RECALL",
            amountUsdc: recallAmount,
            isAutonomous: true,
            txHash: execution.txHash,
            reason: `Autonomous deficit recall of $${recallAmount.toFixed(6)} USDC from USYC Yield Vault (Clearance: ${authResult.clearanceCode})`,
            preStateSnapshot: { liquidUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc },
            postStateSnapshot: {
              liquidUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc + recallAmount,
              recalledUsdc: recallAmount,
              targetReserveUsdc,
              clearanceCode: authResult.clearanceCode,
            },
          });

          const encodedTx = this.vaultService.encodeRecallForAccount(
            accountId,
            recallAmountRaw
          );

          return {
            accountId,
            liquidBalanceUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
            targetReserveUsdc,
            safeToInvestUsdc: 0,
            action: "RECALL",
            actionAmountUsdc: recallAmount,
            branch: "INSIDE_RULES",
            reason: `Liquid balance $${currentLiquidBalanceUsdc} dropped below recall threshold $${recallThreshold}. Clearance ${authResult.clearanceCode} issued.`,
            txHash: execution.txHash,
            encodedTx,
            clearanceCode: authResult.clearanceCode,
            witnessed: true,
            timeHorizonSeconds,
          };
        }

        return {
          accountId,
          liquidBalanceUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
          targetReserveUsdc,
          safeToInvestUsdc: 0,
          action: "NONE",
          actionAmountUsdc: 0,
          branch: "BELOW_HYSTERESIS",
          reason: `Surplus $${rawSurplus.toFixed(6)} is below minimum sweep threshold $${invRules.min_sweep_amount_usdc} USDC. Micro-sweep suppressed.`,
          timeHorizonSeconds,
        };
      }

      const sweepAmount = rawSurplus;

      // D10.9 & D10D16: Submit Reason-Bearing Intent to PolicyComplianceAgent
      const sweepIntent: ReasonBearingIntentPayload = {
        proposedAction: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
        accountId,
        amountUsdc: sweepAmount.toFixed(6),
        declaredReason: `Operational surplus of $${sweepAmount.toFixed(6)} USDC detected above target reserve $${targetReserveUsdc.toFixed(6)} USDC (hysteresis band $${invRules.invest_hysteresis_band_usdc} USDC). Sweeping idle cash to USYC Yield Vault on Arc L1 for 5.1% yield while retaining required liquidity horizon reserve.`,
        currentLiquid: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc.toFixed(6),
        targetReserve: targetReserveUsdc.toFixed(6),
        safeToInvest: rawSurplus.toFixed(6),
      };

      const authResult = await AuthorizationGate.requestAuthorization({
        actionType: sweepIntent.proposedAction,
        accountId: sweepIntent.accountId,
        amountUsdc: sweepIntent.amountUsdc,
        declaredReason: sweepIntent.declaredReason,
      });

      if (authResult.isAuthorized && authResult.clearanceCode) {
        const amountBigInt = BigInt(Math.floor(sweepAmount * 1_000_000));

        const execution = await (this.executor ?? new ArcTransactionExecutor()).execute({
          targetContract: this.vaultService.getAddress(),
          abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
          functionName: "sweepFromAccount",
          args: [CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId), accountRecord.wallet_address, amountBigInt],
          idempotencyKey: `sweep:${accountId}:${amountBigInt}:${Date.now()}`,
        });

        const docRef = `SWEEP_INTENT_${accountId}_${Date.now()}`;

        await this.witnessAgent.witnessTransaction({
          accountId,
          actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
          amountUsdc: sweepAmount,
          documentRef: docRef,
          txHash: execution.txHash,
          counterpartyAddress: this.vaultService.getAddress(),
          reason: `Confirmed Arc sweep to USYC Yield Vault (Clearance: ${authResult.clearanceCode})`,
        });

        await this.witnessAgent.recordAccountAuditLog({
          accountId,
          actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
          amountUsdc: sweepAmount,
          isAutonomous: true,
          txHash: execution.txHash,
          reason: `Autonomous surplus sweep of $${sweepAmount.toFixed(6)} USDC to USYC Yield Vault (Clearance: ${authResult.clearanceCode})`,
          preStateSnapshot: { liquidUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc },
          postStateSnapshot: {
            liquidUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc - sweepAmount,
            sweptUsdc: sweepAmount,
            targetReserveUsdc,
            clearanceCode: authResult.clearanceCode,
          },
        });

        const encodedTx = this.vaultService.encodeSweepFromAccount(
          accountId,
          accountRecord.wallet_address,
          amountBigInt
        );

        return {
          accountId,
          liquidBalanceUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
          targetReserveUsdc,
          safeToInvestUsdc: sweepAmount,
          action: "SWEEP",
          actionAmountUsdc: sweepAmount,
          branch: "INSIDE_RULES",
          reason: `Autonomous surplus sweep qualified ($${sweepAmount.toFixed(6)} USDC) inside policy limits. Clearance: ${authResult.clearanceCode}`,
          txHash: execution.txHash,
          encodedTx,
          clearanceCode: authResult.clearanceCode,
          witnessed: true,
          timeHorizonSeconds,
        };
      } else {
        const requestId = authResult.sprsRequestId || `SPRS-SWEEP-${accountId}-${Date.now()}`;

        const options: SPROption[] = [
          {
            action: "APPROVE",
            label: "Approve High-Value Sweep",
          },
          {
            action: "REJECT",
            label: "Reject Sweep & Retain Liquid Cash",
          },
        ];

        const singleTxLimit = (spendingLimits as any)?.per_transaction_limit_usdc ?? 5000;
        const maxSweepLimit = opPolicy?.max_autonomous_sweep_limit ?? singleTxLimit;

        const sprsPayload: StandardizedPermissionRequest = {
          requestId,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          action: "HIGH_VALUE_SWEEP_EXEMPTION" as SPRActionType,
          reason: `High-value surplus sweep ($${sweepAmount.toFixed(6)} USDC) exceeds autonomous limit ($${maxSweepLimit} USDC). Human authorization required. Declared rationale: ${sweepIntent.declaredReason}`,
          amountUsdc: sweepAmount.toFixed(6),
          affectedAccounts: [
            {
              accountId: intel.metadata.accountId,
              role: intel.metadata.role,
              chain: intel.metadata.chain,
              address: intel.metadata.address,
              currentLiquidBalance: intel.balances.liquidUsdc,
              currentInvestedUsyc: intel.balances.investedUsycUsdcEquivalent,
              totalEffectiveBalance: intel.balances.totalEffectiveUsdc,
              committedLiabilities30d: intel.liabilities.dueNext30DaysUsdc,
              unencumberedBalance: intel.solvencyMetrics.unencumberedFreeCashUsdc,
              usycRecallAmount: "0.000000",
              postTxLiquidBalance: (currentLiquidBalanceUsdc - sweepAmount).toFixed(6),
              postTxInvestedUsyc: (parseFloat(intel.balances.investedUsycUsdcEquivalent) + sweepAmount).toFixed(6),
            },
          ],
          associatedRecords: {
            idempotencyKey: keccak256(stringToHex(`${accountId}|${sweepAmount}|${requestId}`)),
          },
          options,
          status: "PENDING",
        };

        if (!authResult.sprsRequestId) {
          await PermissionRequestRepo.createRequest({
            request_id: requestId,
            action_type: "HIGH_VALUE_SWEEP_EXEMPTION",
            reason: sprsPayload.reason,
            amount_usdc: sweepAmount,
            status: "PENDING",
            payload: sprsPayload as any,
          });
        }

        await this.witnessAgent.recordAccountAuditLog({
          accountId,
          actionType: "SPRS_EMITTED",
          amountUsdc: sweepAmount,
          isAutonomous: true,
          permissionRequestId: requestId,
          reason: `Emitted high-value sweep permission request ${requestId}`,
          preStateSnapshot: { liquidUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc },
          postStateSnapshot: { status: "AWAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL" },
        });

        return {
          accountId,
          liquidBalanceUsdc: currentLiquidBalanceUsdc,
          targetReserveUsdc,
          safeToInvestUsdc: sweepAmount,
          action: "SPRS_REQUIRED",
          actionAmountUsdc: sweepAmount,
          branch: "OUTSIDE_RULES",
          reason: `High-value sweep ($${sweepAmount.toFixed(6)} USDC) requires human gate approval.`,
          sprs: sprsPayload,
          timeHorizonSeconds,
        };
      }
    } finally {
      this.releaseAccountLock(accountId);
    }
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // HUMAN GATE RESOLUTION (D12 -> D11)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  public async resolveSweepDecision(params: {
    requestId: string;
    decision: "APPROVE" | "REJECT";
    adminInstructions?: string;
  }): Promise<{
    requestId: string;
    status: "APPROVED" | "REJECTED";
    actionExecuted: boolean;
    txHash?: `0x${string}`;
    encodedTx?: `0x${string}`;
  }> {
    const sprs = await PermissionRequestRepo.getRequestById(params.requestId);
    if (!sprs) {
      throw new Error(`[TreasurySentinelService] Permission request '${params.requestId}' not found.`);
    }

    const accountId =
      sprs.payload?.affectedAccounts?.[0]?.accountId ||
      sprs.payload?.affected_accounts?.[0]?.account_id ||
      sprs.payload?.accountId ||
      sprs.payload?.account_id ||
      "acc_engineering";
    const amountUsdc = sprs.amount_usdc;

    if (params.decision === "APPROVE") {
      await PermissionRequestRepo.updateStatus({
        requestId: params.requestId,
        status: "APPROVED",
        adminInstruction: params.adminInstructions ?? "Approved by administrator.",
      });

      const accountRecord = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
      const amountBigInt = BigInt(Math.floor(amountUsdc * 1_000_000));
      const walletAddress =
        (accountRecord?.wallet_address ||
         sprs.payload?.affected_accounts?.[0]?.address) as `0x${string}` | undefined;
      if (!walletAddress) {
        throw new Error(`Cannot execute approved sweep ${params.requestId}: no registered account wallet.`);
      }

      const execution = await (this.executor ?? new ArcTransactionExecutor()).execute({
        targetContract: this.vaultService.getAddress(),
        abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
        functionName: "sweepFromAccount",
        args: [CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId), walletAddress, amountBigInt],
        idempotencyKey: `approved-sweep:${params.requestId}`,
      });

      const docRef = `SPRS_APPROVED_SWEEP_${params.requestId}`;

      await this.witnessAgent.witnessTransaction({
        accountId,
        actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
        amountUsdc,
        documentRef: docRef,
        txHash: execution.txHash,
        counterpartyAddress: this.vaultService.getAddress(),
        isAutonomous: false,
        permissionRequestId: params.requestId,
        reason: `Administrator-approved sweep confirmed on Arc as ${execution.txHash}`,
      });

      await this.witnessAgent.recordAccountAuditLog({
        accountId,
        actionType: "SWEEP_APPROVED_AND_EXECUTED",
        amountUsdc,
        isAutonomous: false,
        txHash: execution.txHash,
        permissionRequestId: params.requestId,
        reason: `Administrator approved high-value sweep of $${amountUsdc.toFixed(6)} USDC`,
        preStateSnapshot: { status: "AWAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL" },
        postStateSnapshot: { status: "EXECUTED", amountUsdc },
      });

      const encodedTx = this.vaultService.encodeSweepFromAccount(
        accountId,
        walletAddress,
        amountBigInt
      );

      return {
        requestId: params.requestId,
        status: "APPROVED",
        actionExecuted: true,
        txHash: execution.txHash,
        encodedTx,
      };
    } else {
      await PermissionRequestRepo.updateStatus({
        requestId: params.requestId,
        status: "REJECTED",
        adminInstruction: params.adminInstructions ?? "Rejected by administrator.",
      });

      await this.witnessAgent.recordAccountAuditLog({
        accountId,
        actionType: "SWEEP_REJECTED",
        amountUsdc,
        isAutonomous: false,
        permissionRequestId: params.requestId,
        reason: `Administrator rejected high-value sweep: ${params.adminInstructions ?? "No reason given"}`,
        preStateSnapshot: { status: "AWAITING_HUMAN_APPROVAL" },
        postStateSnapshot: { status: "REJECTED" },
      });

      return {
        requestId: params.requestId,
        status: "REJECTED",
        actionExecuted: false,
      };
    }
  }
}

File: fiatFundingService.ts
