        const result = await this.fiatFundingService.createFiatOnRampSession({
          ...body,
          amountUsdc,
        });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, data: result });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/funding/fiat/wire-instructions" && method === "GET") {
      try {
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const accountId = url.searchParams.get("accountId") || "acc_primary";
        const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
        if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
          return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Account '${accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
        }
        const currency = (url.searchParams.get("currency") as "USD" | "EUR") || "USD";
        const instructions = await this.fiatFundingService.getFiatWireInstructions({ accountId, currency });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, data: instructions });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/funding/fiat/deposit-reconcile" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const accountId = body.accountId || body.targetAccountId;
        if (accountId) {
          const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
          if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
            return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Account '${accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
          }
        }
        const depositReference = body.depositReference || body.wireReference;
        const amountUsdc = Number(body.amountUsdc ?? body.amountUsd ?? 0);
        const result = await this.fiatFundingService.recordFiatDeposit({
          ...body,
          accountId,
          depositReference,
          amountUsdc,
        });
        this.broadcastSseEvent("deposit:confirmed", { accountId, amountUsdc, depositReference, result });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, data: result });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/disbursals/fiat" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        if (body.accountId) {
          const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(body.accountId);
          if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
            return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Account '${body.accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
          }
        }
        const router = new UniversalPaymentRouter();
        const result = await router.routeAndExecute({
          intent: {
            intentId: body.intentId || `INTENT_FIAT_${Date.now()}`,
            primaryAccountId: body.accountId,
            vendorId: body.vendorId,
            vendorName: body.vendorName || body.vendorId,
            amountUsdc: Number(body.amountUsdc),
            beneficiaryBank: body.beneficiaryBank,
            declaredReason: body.declaredReason || "Vendor traditional bank settlement via Rail 5",
            invoiceId: body.invoiceId,
          },
          overrideRail: "FIAT_PAYOUT",
          adminSignature: body.adminSignature,
          clearanceCode: body.clearanceCode,
          sprsRequestId: body.sprsRequestId,
        });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/payments" && method === "GET") {
      try {
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const accountIdFilter = url.searchParams.get("accountId") || undefined;
        const railFilter = url.searchParams.get("rail")?.toUpperCase() || undefined;
        const limit = url.searchParams.get("limit") ? parseInt(url.searchParams.get("limit")!, 10) : 50;

        const [journalEntries, fiatPayouts, swaps] = await Promise.all([
          MasterJournalRepo.getEntriesByCompany(companyId, limit),
          FiatPayoutRepo.getPayoutsByCompany(companyId, limit),
          TokenSwapRepo.getSwapsByCompany(companyId, limit),
        ]);

        type UnifiedPaymentItem = {
          id: string;
          companyId: string;
          accountId: string;
          rail: "ARC_L1" | "MODULAR_SESSION_KEYS" | "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION" | "GATEWAY_X402" | "FIAT_PAYOUT" | "TOKEN_SWAP" | string;
          type: "DISBURSAL" | "PAYOUT" | "SWAP" | "TRANSFER" | "SETTLEMENT";
          amountUsdc: string;
          recipient: string;
          status: "SETTLED" | "COMPLETED" | "PENDING" | "PROCESSING" | "INITIATED" | "FAILED" | "ESCALATED" | string;
          txHash?: string | null;
          reference?: string | null;
          timestamp: string;
          details?: Record<string, any>;
        };

        const unified: UnifiedPaymentItem[] = [];

        // 1. Process Master Journal Entries (Rails 1, 2, 3, 4)
        for (const j of journalEntries) {
          const act = (j.action_type || "").toUpperCase();
          let rail = "ARC_L1";
          let pType: UnifiedPaymentItem["type"] = "DISBURSAL";

          if (act.includes("FIAT")) {
            rail = "FIAT_PAYOUT";
            pType = "PAYOUT";
          } else if (act.includes("SESSION")) {
            rail = "MODULAR_SESSION_KEYS";
            pType = "DISBURSAL";
          } else if (act.includes("GATEWAY") || act.includes("X402")) {
            rail = "GATEWAY_X402";
            pType = "SETTLEMENT";
          } else if (act.includes("ERC3009")) {
            rail = "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION";
            pType = "DISBURSAL";
          } else if (act.includes("SWAP")) {
            rail = "TOKEN_SWAP";
            pType = "SWAP";
          } else if (act.includes("INTERNAL") || act.includes("TRANSFER")) {
            rail = "ARC_L1";
            pType = "TRANSFER";
          }

          unified.push({
            id: j.sequence_id ? `jnl_${j.sequence_id}` : `jnl_${j.document_ref}`,
            companyId: j.company_id || companyId,
            accountId: j.account_id,
            rail,
            type: pType,
            amountUsdc: Number(j.amount_usdc || 0).toFixed(6),
            recipient: j.credit_account,
            status: "SETTLED",
            reference: j.document_ref,
            txHash: j.current_hash,
            timestamp: j.timestamp ? new Date(j.timestamp).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
            details: {
              debitAccount: j.debit_account,
              actionType: j.action_type,
              previousHash: j.previous_hash,
            },
          });
        }

        // 2. Process Fiat Payouts (Rail 5)
        for (const f of fiatPayouts) {
          unified.push({
            id: `fiat_${f.payout_id}`,
            companyId: f.company_id || companyId,
            accountId: f.account_id,
            rail: "FIAT_PAYOUT",
            type: "PAYOUT",
            amountUsdc: Number(f.amount_usdc || 0).toFixed(6),
            recipient: f.vendor_id,
            status: f.status,
            reference: f.circle_payout_ref || f.invoice_ref || f.payout_id,
            txHash: f.burn_tx_hash || null,
            timestamp: f.created_at ? new Date(f.created_at).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
            details: {
              subMethod: f.sub_method,
              feeUsdc: Number(f.fee_usdc || 0).toFixed(6),
              imadOmadTrace: f.imad_omad_trace,
              beneficiaryBankId: f.beneficiary_bank_id,
            },
          });
        }

        // 3. Process Swaps
        for (const s of swaps) {
          unified.push({
            id: `swap_${s.swap_id}`,
            companyId: s.company_id || companyId,
            accountId: s.account_id,
            rail: "TOKEN_SWAP",
            type: "SWAP",
            amountUsdc: Number(s.to_amount || s.from_amount || 0).toFixed(6),
            recipient: `${s.to_token} on ${s.to_chain}`,
            status: s.status === "COMPLETED" ? "SETTLED" : (s.status as any),
            reference: s.swap_id,
            txHash: s.tx_hash || null,
            timestamp: s.created_at ? new Date(s.created_at).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
            details: {
              fromChain: s.from_chain,
              fromToken: s.from_token,
              fromAmount: s.from_amount,
              toChain: s.to_chain,
              toToken: s.to_token,
              toAmount: s.to_amount,
              realizedRate: s.realized_rate,
              routeAggregator: s.route_aggregator,
            },
          });
        }

        let filtered = unified;
        if (accountIdFilter) {
          filtered = filtered.filter((p) => p.accountId === accountIdFilter);
        }
        if (railFilter) {
          filtered = filtered.filter((p) => p.rail.toUpperCase().includes(railFilter));
        }

        filtered.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());
        const paginated = filtered.slice(0, limit);

        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
          success: true,
          companyId,
          count: paginated.length,
          total: filtered.length,
          data: paginated,
          rails: {
            rail1: "ARC_L1 (DisbursalVaultRail)",
            rail2: "MODULAR_SESSION_KEYS (ModularSessionKeyRail / CCTP)",
            rail3: "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION (Erc3009AuthorizationRail)",
            rail4: "GATEWAY_X402 (GatewayX402Rail Nanopayments)",
            rail5: "FIAT_PAYOUT (FiatPayoutRail Circle Mint ACH/Wire)",
          },
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // CATEGORY 8: ONBOARDING WIZARD & MATH RULES QA APIS
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (pathname === "/api/onboarding/discovery" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req).catch(() => ({}));
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const jobId = `job_disc_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;

        const jobEntry: {
          jobId: string;
          companyId: string;
          status: "PENDING" | "RUNNING" | "COMPLETED" | "FAILED";
          progress: number;
          result?: any;
          error?: string;
          createdAt: number;
          completedAt?: number;
        } = {
          jobId,
          companyId,
          status: "RUNNING",
          progress: 10,
          createdAt: Date.now(),
        };
        this.discoveryJobs.set(jobId, jobEntry);
        await DiscoveryJobRepo.createJob({ jobId, companyId, status: "RUNNING", progress: 10 }).catch(() => {});

        // Run asynchronous intake discovery background job without blocking HTTP response
        (async () => {
          try {
            const agent = new IntakeDiscoveryAgent({ companyId });
            jobEntry.progress = 35;
            await DiscoveryJobRepo.updateJob(jobId, { progress: 35 }).catch(() => {});
            const result = await agent.synthesizeAllSources();
            jobEntry.status = "COMPLETED";
            jobEntry.progress = 100;
            (jobEntry as any).result = result;
            (jobEntry as any).completedAt = Date.now();
            await DiscoveryJobRepo.updateJob(jobId, { status: "COMPLETED", progress: 100, result }).catch(() => {});
            this.broadcastSseEvent("discovery:completed", { jobId, companyId, totalSpend: result.totalCommittedMonthlySpendUsdc });
          } catch (jobErr: any) {
            jobEntry.status = "FAILED";
            jobEntry.progress = 100;
            (jobEntry as any).error = jobErr.message;
            (jobEntry as any).completedAt = Date.now();
            await DiscoveryJobRepo.updateJob(jobId, { status: "FAILED", progress: 100, error: jobErr.message }).catch(() => {});
            this.broadcastSseEvent("discovery:failed", { jobId, companyId, error: jobErr.message });
          }
        })();

        return this.sendJson(req, res, 202, {
          success: true,
          jobId,
          status: "RUNNING",
          progress: 10,
          message: "Intake discovery background job initiated across MCP, ERPs, and vendor connectors.",
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname.startsWith("/api/onboarding/discovery") && method === "GET") {
      const parts = pathname.split("/");
      const jobId = parts[4]; // /api/onboarding/discovery/:jobId
      const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));

      if (!jobId) {
        const tenantJobs = Array.from(this.discoveryJobs.values())
          .filter((j) => j.companyId === companyId)
          .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, count: tenantJobs.length, jobs: tenantJobs });
      }

      let job: any = this.discoveryJobs.get(jobId);
      if (!job) {
        const dbJob = await DiscoveryJobRepo.getJob(jobId).catch(() => null);
        if (dbJob) {
          job = {
            jobId: dbJob.job_id,
            companyId: dbJob.company_id,
            status: dbJob.status,
            progress: dbJob.progress,
            result: dbJob.result,
            error: dbJob.error,
            createdAt: dbJob.created_at ? new Date(dbJob.created_at).getTime() : Date.now(),
          };
        }
      }
      if (!job) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 404, { success: false, error: `Discovery job '${jobId}' not found.` });
      }
      if (job.companyId !== companyId) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Discovery job does not belong to active tenant.` });
      }

      return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
        success: true,
        ...job,
      });
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/onboarding/session" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const result = await this.orchestrator.onboardingMachine.startOnboarding({ ...body, companyId });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname.startsWith("/api/onboarding/session/") && method === "GET") {
      const parts = pathname.split("/");
      const sessionId = parts[4];
      try {
        const session = await WizardSessionRepo.getSession(sessionId);
        if (!session) {
          return this.sendJson(req, res, 404, { success: false, error: `Wizard session '${sessionId}' not found.` });
        }
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, session });
      } catch (err: any) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/onboarding/step" && method === "POST") {
      const body = await this.parseBody(req);
      try {
        const result = await this.orchestrator.onboardingMachine.submitStep(
          body.sessionId,
          body.step,
          body.payload
        );
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/onboarding/activate" && method === "POST") {
      const body = await this.parseBody(req);
      try {
        const result = await this.orchestrator.onboardingMachine.activateOrganization(body.sessionId);
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/onboarding/qa/questions" && method === "GET") {
      const category = url.searchParams.get("category") as any;
      try {
        const questions = category
          ? this.mathEngine.getQuestionsByCategory(category)
          : this.mathEngine.getAllQuestions();
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, count: questions.length, questions });
      } catch (err: any) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/onboarding/qa/evaluate" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const results = this.mathEngine.evaluateAnswers(body.answers || []);
        if (body.persist !== false) {
          await this.mathEngine.persistQAResponses(companyId, results, {
            accountId: body.accountId,
            liabilityId: body.liabilityId,
          });
        }
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, companyId, results });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // CATEGORY 9: ERP SYNCHRONIZATION & MODEL CONTEXT PROTOCOL (MCP) APIS
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (pathname === "/api/integrations/erp/sync" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const systemType = body.systemType || "ERPNEXT";

        const checkpoint = await ErpSyncRepo.recordSyncCheckpoint({
          companyId,
          systemType,
          entityType: "PAYMENT_ENTRY",
          lastSyncedDocumentId: body.invoiceId || `PAY_${Date.now()}`,
          status: "SUCCESS",
          threeWayMatchVerified: true,
          txHash: body.txHash,
          invoiceId: body.invoiceId,
        });

        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
          success: true,
          companyId,
          systemType,
          checkpoint,
          status: "SYNCED",
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/integrations/erp/status" && method === "GET") {
      try {
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const checkpoint = await ErpSyncRepo.getLatestSyncCheckpoint(companyId);
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, status: checkpoint || { status: "DISCONNECTED" } });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/integrations/mcp/extract" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const connector = new McpAppConnector({
          companyId,
          googleAppsConnected: true,
          microsoftAppsConnected: true,
        });
        const mcpData = await connector.aggregateAllCompanyAppData();
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, companyId, extracted: mcpData });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/integrations/connectors" && method === "GET") {
      try {
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const tokens = await TenantOAuthRepo.listTokensByCompany(companyId);
        const tokenMap = new Map(tokens.map((t) => [t.provider, t]));

        const KNOWN_PROVIDERS = [
          { provider: "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE", name: "Google Workspace (Drive & Gmail MCP)", category: "MCP" },
          { provider: "MICROSOFT_365", name: "Microsoft 365 (OneDrive & Excel MCP)", category: "MCP" },
          { provider: "ERPNEXT_KEY", name: "ERPNext Accounting", category: "ERP" },
          { provider: "ODOO_SESSION", name: "Odoo Enterprise", category: "ERP" },
          { provider: "AWS_STS_ROLE", name: "AWS Cloud Infrastructure Billing", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "STRIPE_RESTRICTED", name: "Stripe Billing & Subscriptions", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "GITHUB_ENTERPRISE", name: "GitHub Enterprise", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "OPENAI_ADMIN", name: "OpenAI Platform & APIs", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "DATADOG_API", name: "Datadog Cloud Monitoring", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT", name: "Google Cloud Platform", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "AZURE_SERVICE_PRINCIPAL", name: "Microsoft Azure Cloud", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "FIGMA_ADMIN", name: "Figma Enterprise", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "SNOWFLAKE_JWT", name: "Snowflake Data Cloud", category: "SAAS" },
          { provider: "TWILIO_AUTH", name: "Twilio Communications", category: "SAAS" },
        ];

        const connectors = KNOWN_PROVIDERS.map((p) => {
          const t = tokenMap.get(p.provider);
          return {
            provider: p.provider,
            name: p.name,
            category: p.category,
            status: t ? "CONNECTED" : "DISCONNECTED",
            connectedAt: t?.created_at,
            scope: t?.token_scope,
            hasRefreshToken: Boolean(t?.refresh_token_encrypted),
          };
        });

        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, companyId, count: connectors.length, data: connectors });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/integrations/credentials" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const provider = body.provider;
        const accessToken = body.accessToken || body.apiKey || body.token;

        if (!provider || !accessToken) {
          return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: "VALIDATION_ERROR: 'provider' and 'accessToken' (or 'apiKey') are required." });
        }

        const record = await TenantOAuthRepo.storeToken({
          company_id: companyId,
          provider,
          access_token_encrypted: accessToken,
          refresh_token_encrypted: body.refreshToken || null,
          token_scope: body.scope || null,
          expires_at: body.expiresAt ? new Date(body.expiresAt) : null,
          session_metadata: body.metadata || {},
        });

        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
          success: true,
          companyId,
          provider: record.provider,
          status: "CONNECTED",
          message: `Credentials stored successfully for ${record.provider}.`,
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/integrations/oauth/callback" && (method === "GET" || method === "POST")) {
      try {
        const body = method === "POST" ? await this.parseBody(req).catch(() => ({})) : {};
        const code = url.searchParams.get("code") || body.code;
        const provider = url.searchParams.get("provider") || body.provider || "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE";
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId") || body.companyId);

        if (!code) {
          return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: "Missing authorization 'code'." });
        }

        const stored = await TenantOAuthRepo.storeToken({
          company_id: companyId,
          provider,
          access_token_encrypted: code,
          token_scope: url.searchParams.get("scope") || body.scope || "default",
          session_metadata: { oauthCodeFlow: true, timestamp: Date.now() },
        });

        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
          success: true,
          companyId,
          provider: stored.provider,
          status: "CONNECTED",
          message: `OAuth callback completed successfully for ${stored.provider}.`,
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname.startsWith("/api/integrations/connectors/") && method === "DELETE") {
      try {
        const parts = pathname.split("/");
        const provider = parts[4];
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));

        if (!provider) {
          return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: "Missing 'provider'." });
        }

        const deleted = await TenantOAuthRepo.deleteToken(companyId, provider);
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
          success: true,
          companyId,
          provider,
          disconnected: deleted,
          status: "DISCONNECTED",
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // CATEGORY 10: SYSTEM GOVERNANCE, CIRCUIT BREAKERS & POLICIES APIS
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (pathname === "/api/governance/readiness" && method === "GET") {
      try {
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const report = await this.productionReadinessService.auditProductionReadiness();
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, companyId, report });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/governance/circuit-breaker" && method === "POST") {
      if (auth.role === "AUDITOR_VIEWER") {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: "FORBIDDEN: Read-only Auditor role cannot trigger circuit breaker." });
      }
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const reason = body.reason || "Manual emergency shutdown triggered by administrator.";
        ProductionReadinessService.triggerCircuitBreaker(reason);
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
          success: true,
          circuitBreaker: {
            active: true,
            reason,
            triggeredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/governance/circuit-breaker/disarm" && method === "POST") {
      if (auth.role === "AUDITOR_VIEWER") {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: "FORBIDDEN: Read-only Auditor role cannot disarm circuit breaker." });
      }
      try {
        ProductionReadinessService.disarmCircuitBreaker();
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
          success: true,
          circuitBreaker: {
            active: false,
            disarmedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          },
        });
      } catch (err: any) {
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 400, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/governance/policies" && method === "GET") {
      try {
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const policies = await TenantPolicyManager.getInstance().getActiveProfile(companyId);
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, companyId, policies });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/governance/policies" && method === "PUT") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const updated = await TenantPolicyManager.getInstance().mutatePolicy(companyId, (current) => ({
          ...current,
          spending_limits: body.spendingLimits || body.spending_limits || current.spending_limits,
          investment_rules: body.investmentRules || body.investment_rules || current.investment_rules,
          declared_policies: body.declaredPolicies || body.declared_policies || current.declared_policies,
        }));
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, companyId, policies: updated });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // CATEGORY 12: WEBHOOKS & EXTERNAL EVENT INGRESS APIS
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    if ((pathname === "/api/webhooks/ingest" || pathname === "/api/invoices/inbound") && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        if (body.accountId) {
          const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(body.accountId);
          if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
            return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Account '${body.accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
          }
        }
        const result = await this.orchestrator.onInboundInvoice({ ...body, companyId });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/events/balance-mutation" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        if (body.accountId) {
          const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(body.accountId);
          if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
            return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Account '${body.accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
          }
        }
        const result = await this.orchestrator.onBalanceMutation({ ...body, companyId });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/disbursal/trigger-due" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const liability = body.liability;
        if (liability?.accountId) {
          const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(liability.accountId);
          if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
            return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Liability account '${liability.accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
          }
        }
        const result = await this.orchestrator.onDueLiabilityDisbursal(liability);
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/payments/ad-hoc" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        if (body.accountId) {
          const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(body.accountId);
          if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
            return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Account '${body.accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
          }
        }
        const result = await this.orchestrator.onAdHocPaymentRequest({ ...body, companyId });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/disbursals/manual" && method === "POST") {
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const sourceAccountId = body.sourceAccountId || body.accountId;
        if (sourceAccountId) {
          const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(sourceAccountId);
          if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
            return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Source account '${sourceAccountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
          }
        }
        const result = await this.manualDisbursalService.executeManualDisbursal({
          companyId,
          sourceAccountId,
          vendorId: body.vendorId,
          vendorName: body.vendorName || body.vendorId,
          amountUsdc: Number(body.amountUsdc),
          paymentRail: body.paymentRail,
          fiatDetails: body.fiatDetails,
          cryptoDetails: body.cryptoDetails,
          declaredReason: body.declaredReason || "Manual payment initiated by user",
          invoiceId: body.invoiceId,
          poReference: body.poReference,
          category: body.category,
          adminSignature: body.adminSignature,
          clearanceCode: body.clearanceCode,
        });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, result.success ? 200 : 400, result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname.startsWith("/api/accounts/") && pathname.endsWith("/funding-options") && method === "GET") {
      const parts = pathname.split("/");
      const accountId = parts[3];
      try {
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
        if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
          return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Account '${accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
        }
        const result = await this.accountFundingService.getFundingOptions(accountId);
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, data: result });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if (pathname.startsWith("/api/accounts/") && pathname.endsWith("/fund") && method === "POST") {
      const parts = pathname.split("/");
      const accountId = parts[3];
      try {
        const body = await this.parseBody(req);
        const companyId = resolveTenantId(body.companyId || url.searchParams.get("companyId"));
        const acc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
        if (!acc || (acc.company_id && acc.company_id !== companyId)) {
          return this.sendJson(req, res, 403, { success: false, error: `FORBIDDEN: Account '${accountId}' does not belong to active tenant.` });
        }
        const methodRaw = (body.method || "").toUpperCase();
        let method = methodRaw;
        if (methodRaw === "CARD" || methodRaw === "CARD_ONRAMP") method = "FIAT_CARD_ONRAMP";
        else if (methodRaw === "ACH") method = "FIAT_ACH";
        else if (methodRaw === "FEDWIRE" || methodRaw === "WIRE") method = "FIAT_FEDWIRE";
        else if (methodRaw === "SEPA") method = "FIAT_SEPA";
        else if (methodRaw === "CRYPTO" || methodRaw === "NATIVE" || methodRaw === "ARC") method = "CRYPTO_ARC_NATIVE";

        const result = await this.accountFundingService.initiateFundingSession({
          accountId,
          method: method as any,
          amountUsdc: Number(body.amountUsdc),
          userEmail: body.userEmail,
          sourceChain: body.sourceChain,
          sourceToken: body.sourceToken,
        });
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, data: result });
      } catch (err: any) {
        const status = err.message.startsWith("FORBIDDEN") ? 403 : 400;
        return this.sendJson(req, res, status, { success: false, error: err.message });
      }
    }

    if ((pathname === "/api/webhooks/circle" || pathname === "/api/webhooks/circle-mint") && method === "POST") {
      const body = await this.parseBody(req);
      const eventType = body.type || body.eventType;

      if (eventType === "payout.paid" || eventType === "payouts.complete") {
        const payoutId = body.data?.id || body.payoutId;
        if (payoutId) {
          await FiatPayoutRepo.confirmPayoutSettlement(payoutId);
        }
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, event: eventType, status: "SETTLED" });
      } else if (eventType === "transfer.complete" || eventType === "payments.paid" || eventType === "deposits.complete") {
        const trackingMemo = body.data?.trackingMemo || body.trackingMemo || body.data?.reference || `MINT_${Date.now()}`;
        const amount = parseFloat(body.data?.amount?.amount || body.amountUsdc || body.amount || "0");
        const accountId = body.accountId || body.data?.accountId || "acc_primary";
        if (amount > 0) {
          await this.accountFundingService.reconcileDeposit({
            accountId,
            amountUsdc: amount,
            depositReference: trackingMemo,
            method: "FIAT_FEDWIRE",
            sourceInstitution: "Circle Mint Webhook",
          });

          try {
            await this.orchestrator.yieldMachine.recalculateForAccount(accountId);
          } catch {}
        }
        return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, event: eventType, status: "DEPOSIT_RECONCILED", accountId, amountUsdc: amount });
      }

      return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, { success: true, received: true });
    }

    if (pathname === "/api/webhooks/bank" && method === "POST") {
      const body = await this.parseBody(req);
      const status = body.status || "SETTLED";
      const trackingMemo = body.trackingMemo || body.transactionId || `BANK_WIRE_${Date.now()}`;
      const amount = parseFloat(body.amountUsdc || body.amount || "0");
      const accountId = body.accountId || "acc_primary";

      if (status === "SETTLED" && amount > 0) {
        await this.fiatFundingService.recordFiatDeposit({
          accountId,
          amountUsdc: amount,
          depositReference: trackingMemo,
          sourceBank: body.sourceBank || "Commercial Partner Bank",
        });

        try {
          await this.orchestrator.yieldMachine.recalculateForAccount(accountId);
        } catch {}
      }

      return this.sendJson(req, res, 200, {
        success: true,
        eventId: body.eventId || `EV_${Date.now()}`,
        status: "RECONCILED",
        trackingMemo,
      });
    }

    return this.sendJson(req, res, 404, { error: "NOT_FOUND", pathname });
  }
}


================================================================================

import { DbClient } from "../database/dbClient.js";
import { ILlmEngine, createLlmEngine } from "../llm/llmEngine.js";
import { LlmMessage } from "../llm/types.js";
import { VectorMemoryService } from "../memory/vectorMemoryService.js";
import {
  AssembledAgentContext,
  CompactionEpisode,
  ContextEvent,
  DeterministicFinancialAnchors,
} from "./types.js";

export class ContinuousContextManager {
  private llmEngine: ILlmEngine;
  private vectorMemory: VectorMemoryService;
  private compactionThreshold: number;

  constructor(
    llmEngine?: ILlmEngine,
    vectorMemory?: VectorMemoryService,
    compactionThreshold: number = 10
  ) {
    this.llmEngine = llmEngine || createLlmEngine();
    this.vectorMemory = vectorMemory || new VectorMemoryService(this.llmEngine);
    this.compactionThreshold = compactionThreshold;
  }

  /**
   * Publishes an event to the shared living blackboard context stream.
   * Auto-triggers background rolling compaction if threshold is reached.
   */
  public async recordEvent(event: ContextEvent): Promise<number> {
    const res = await DbClient.query(
      `INSERT INTO agent_continuous_context 
        (session_id, agent_id, agent_name, event_type, role, content, tool_calls, tool_call_id, metadata, is_compacted)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, FALSE)
       RETURNING event_seq;`,
      [
        event.sessionId,
        event.agentId,
        event.agentName,
        event.eventType,
        event.role,
        event.content,
        event.toolCalls ? JSON.stringify(event.toolCalls) : null,
        event.toolCallId || null,
        JSON.stringify(event.metadata || {}),
      ]
    );

    const eventSeq = parseInt(res.rows[0].event_seq, 10);

    // Check if background compaction is warranted
    const uncompactedCount = await this.getUncompactedCount(event.sessionId);
    if (uncompactedCount >= this.compactionThreshold) {
      // Trigger rolling compaction asynchronously
      await this.performDualStreamCompaction(event.sessionId);
    }

    return eventSeq;
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves hot uncompacted events for active working memory.
   */
  public async getHotEvents(sessionId: string, limit: number = 25): Promise<ContextEvent[]> {
    const res = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT id, session_id, event_seq, agent_id, agent_name, event_type, role, content, 
              tool_calls, tool_call_id, metadata, is_compacted, created_at
       FROM agent_continuous_context
       WHERE session_id = $1 AND is_compacted = FALSE
       ORDER BY event_seq ASC
       LIMIT $2;`,
      [sessionId, limit]
    );

    return res.rows.map(this.mapRowToContextEvent);
  }

  /**
   * Retrieves the latest deterministic financial anchors and compacted episodes.
   */
  public async getLatestCompactedEpisode(sessionId: string): Promise<CompactionEpisode | null> {
    const res = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT id, session_id, episode_index, start_seq, end_seq, narrative_summary, 
              deterministic_anchors, created_at
       FROM agent_context_compaction_episodes
       WHERE session_id = $1
       ORDER BY episode_index DESC
       LIMIT 1;`,
      [sessionId]
    );

    if (res.rows.length === 0) return null;
    const row = res.rows[0];
    return {
      id: row.id,
      sessionId: row.session_id,
      episodeIndex: row.episode_index,
      startSeq: parseInt(row.start_seq, 10),
      endSeq: parseInt(row.end_seq, 10),
      narrativeSummary: row.narrative_summary,
      deterministicAnchors: row.deterministic_anchors,
      createdAt: row.created_at,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Performs Dual-Stream Rolling Compaction:
   * Stream A: Narrative Strategic Synthesis
   * Stream B: Invariable Deterministic Financial Anchors (6-decimal figures & hashes)
   */
  public async performDualStreamCompaction(sessionId: string): Promise<CompactionEpisode | null> {
    const uncompactedRes = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT id, session_id, event_seq, agent_id, agent_name, event_type, role, content, 
              tool_calls, tool_call_id, metadata
       FROM agent_continuous_context
       WHERE session_id = $1 AND is_compacted = FALSE
       ORDER BY event_seq ASC;`,
      [sessionId]
    );

    if (uncompactedRes.rows.length === 0) return null;

    const eventsToCompact: ContextEvent[] = uncompactedRes.rows.map(this.mapRowToContextEvent);
    const startSeq = eventsToCompact[0].eventSeq || 1;
    const endSeq = eventsToCompact[eventsToCompact.length - 1].eventSeq || startSeq;

    // Get previous episode index
    const episodeIndexRes = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT COALESCE(MAX(episode_index), 0) + 1 AS next_index
       FROM agent_context_compaction_episodes
       WHERE session_id = $1;`,
      [sessionId]
    );
    const nextEpisodeIndex = parseInt(episodeIndexRes.rows[0].next_index, 10);

    // Stream A: Narrative Synthesis
    const narrativeSummary = await this.synthesizeNarrative(eventsToCompact);

    // Stream B: Deterministic Financial Anchors (Strict 6-decimal & hashes)
    const deterministicAnchors = await this.extractDeterministicAnchors(eventsToCompact);

    // Embed episode into Vector Store for long-term semantic retrieval (Tier 3)
    const episodeContent = `EPISODE #${nextEpisodeIndex} SUMMARY: ${narrativeSummary}\nFINANCIAL STATE: Liquid=${deterministicAnchors.liquidCashUsdc} USDC, Invested=${deterministicAnchors.investedYieldUsdc} USDC, SafeToInvest=${deterministicAnchors.safeToInvestUsdc} USDC.`;
    const embedding = await this.llmEngine.embedText(episodeContent);
    const embeddingSql = `[${embedding.join(",")}]`;

    // Insert Compaction Episode
    const episodeRes = await DbClient.query(
      `INSERT INTO agent_context_compaction_episodes
        (session_id, episode_index, start_seq, end_seq, narrative_summary, deterministic_anchors, embedding)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::vector)
       RETURNING id, created_at;`,
      [
        sessionId,
        nextEpisodeIndex,
        startSeq,
        endSeq,
        narrativeSummary,
        JSON.stringify(deterministicAnchors),
        embeddingSql,
      ]
    );

    // Ingest into Enterprise Vector Memory collection 'episodic_memory'
    await this.vectorMemory.ingestDocument({
      collection: "episodic_memory",
      documentId: `EPISODE-${sessionId}-${nextEpisodeIndex}`,
      title: `Compacted Episode #${nextEpisodeIndex} (Seq ${startSeq}-${endSeq})`,
      content: episodeContent,
      metadata: {
        sessionId,
        episodeIndex: nextEpisodeIndex,
        startSeq,
        endSeq,
        deterministicAnchors,
      },
    });

    // Mark events as compacted
    await DbClient.query(
      `UPDATE agent_continuous_context
       SET is_compacted = TRUE
       WHERE session_id = $1 AND event_seq >= $2 AND event_seq <= $3;`,
      [sessionId, startSeq, endSeq]
    );

    return {
      id: episodeRes.rows[0].id,
      sessionId,
      episodeIndex: nextEpisodeIndex,
      startSeq,
      endSeq,
      narrativeSummary,
      deterministicAnchors,
      createdAt: episodeRes.rows[0].created_at,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Assembles multi-tiered prompt context for an agent executing a cognitive task.
   */
  public async assembleAgentContext(
    sessionId: string,
    agentId: number,
    agentName: string,
    systemInstruction: string,
    currentTask: string
  ): Promise<AssembledAgentContext> {
    // 1. Semantic Memory Retrieval (Tier 3)
    const memoryResults = await this.vectorMemory.queryRelevantMemory(
      currentTask,
      ["company_bylaws", "msas", "erp_pos", "episodic_memory"],
      4
    );
    const relevantMemorySnippets = memoryResults.map(
      (m) => `[Source: ${m.collection} | ${m.title}]: ${m.content.trim()}`
    );

    // 2. Latest Episodic Summary & Invariant Anchors (Tier 2)
    const latestEpisode = await this.getLatestCompactedEpisode(sessionId);

    // 3. Hot Working Events (Tier 1)
    const hotEvents = await this.getHotEvents(sessionId, 20);

    // Build Messages array
    const messages: LlmMessage[] = [];

    // System prompt includes role, corporate ground truth, and mathematical invariants
    let fullSystemPrompt = `${systemInstruction.trim()}
YOU ARE AGENT ID #${agentId}: ${agentName}.
You operate within the BizArc Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarm on Arc L1 (USDC native gas, sub-second finality).
All financial arithmetic MUST be exact 6-decimal USDC. Never invent, approximate, or silently round numbers.
Model outputs are suggestions for deterministic tools; never bypass smart contract or database guardrails.`;

    if (latestEpisode) {
      fullSystemPrompt += `\n\n--- PREVIOUS EPISODE NARRATIVE (EPISODE #${latestEpisode.episodeIndex}) ---
${latestEpisode.narrativeSummary}
LOCKED FINANCIAL ANCHORS:
- Liquid Cash: ${latestEpisode.deterministicAnchors.liquidCashUsdc} USDC
- Invested Yield (USYC): ${latestEpisode.deterministicAnchors.investedYieldUsdc} USDC
- Available Balance: ${latestEpisode.deterministicAnchors.availableBalanceUsdc} USDC
- Safe-to-Invest: ${latestEpisode.deterministicAnchors.safeToInvestUsdc} USDC
- Invariant Check: ${latestEpisode.deterministicAnchors.invariantCheckPassed ? "PASSED" : "FAILED"}`;
    }

    if (relevantMemorySnippets.length > 0) {
      fullSystemPrompt += `\n\n--- ENTERPRISE VECTOR MEMORY RETRIEVAL (ENTERPRISE TRUTH) ---
${relevantMemorySnippets.join("\n\n")}`;
    }

    messages.push({ role: "system", content: fullSystemPrompt });

    // Append hot events as chat history
    for (const ev of hotEvents) {
      const msg: LlmMessage = {
        role: ev.role,
        content: `[Seq ${ev.eventSeq} | ${ev.agentName} | ${ev.eventType}]: ${ev.content}`,
      };
      if (ev.toolCalls) msg.tool_calls = ev.toolCalls;
      if (ev.toolCallId) msg.tool_call_id = ev.toolCallId;
      messages.push(msg);
    }

    // Append current user task
    messages.push({
      role: "user",
      content: `CURRENT TASK: ${currentTask}`,
    });

    return {
      systemPrompt: fullSystemPrompt,
      messages,
      relevantMemorySnippets,
      activeAnchors: latestEpisode ? latestEpisode.deterministicAnchors : null,
    };
  }

  private async getUncompactedCount(sessionId: string): Promise<number> {
    const res = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM agent_continuous_context WHERE session_id = $1 AND is_compacted = FALSE;`,
      [sessionId]
    );
    return parseInt(res.rows[0].cnt, 10);
  }

  private async synthesizeNarrative(events: ContextEvent[]): Promise<string> {
    const rawEvents = events
      .map((e) => `[Seq #${e.eventSeq}] ${e.agentName} (${e.eventType}): ${e.content}`)
      .join("\n");

    try {
      const response = await this.llmEngine.chatCompletion([
        {
          role: "system",
          content:
            "You are the BizArc Continuous Context Compaction Engine. Synthesize the provided agent events into a dense, factual semantic narrative stream preserving key decisions, account IDs, amounts, and operational state mutations. Output only the narrative synthesis.",
        },
        { role: "user", content: `Synthesize these swarm events:\n${rawEvents}` },
      ]);
      if (response && response.content && response.content.trim().length > 0) {
        return response.content.trim();
      }
    } catch {
      // Fallback to deterministic synthesis if LLM engine call is unavailable
    }

    const summaryPoints: string[] = [];
    for (const ev of events) {
      if (ev.eventType === "TASK_INITIATED" || ev.eventType === "TOOL_RESULT" || ev.eventType === "STATE_MUTATION") {
        summaryPoints.push(`${ev.agentName} ${ev.eventType.toLowerCase()}: ${ev.content.slice(0, 140)}`);
      }
    }
    if (summaryPoints.length === 0) {
      return `Agents performed ${events.length} routine context evaluations and data checks.`;
    }
    return `During sequence ${events[0].eventSeq}-${events[events.length - 1].eventSeq}: ${summaryPoints.join("; ")}.`;
  }

  private async extractDeterministicAnchors(
    events: ContextEvent[]
  ): Promise<DeterministicFinancialAnchors> {
    // Read current state from dynamic records and database
    const stiRes = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT liquid_cash_usdc, invested_yield_usdc, available_balance_usdc, 
              target_reserve_usdc, safe_to_invest_usdc
       FROM dynamic_safe_to_invest
       ORDER BY record_id DESC
       LIMIT 1;`
    );

    let liquid = "100000.000000";
    let invested = "50000.000000";
    let available = "150000.000000";
    let reserve = "20000.000000";
    let safeToInvest = "30000.000000";

    if (stiRes.rows.length > 0) {
      const r = stiRes.rows[0];
      // Format exact 6-decimal representation from PostgreSQL NUMERIC without IEEE 754 float contamination
      const formatExact6 = (val: any): string => {
        if (val === null || val === undefined) return "0.000000";
        const str = String(val);
        const [intPart, decPart = ""] = str.split(".");
        return `${intPart}.${decPart.padEnd(6, "0").slice(0, 6)}`;
      };
      liquid = formatExact6(r.liquid_cash_usdc);
      invested = formatExact6(r.invested_yield_usdc);
      available = formatExact6(r.available_balance_usdc);
      reserve = formatExact6(r.target_reserve_usdc);
      safeToInvest = formatExact6(r.safe_to_invest_usdc);
    }

    // Read active liabilities
    const liaRes = await DbClient.query(
      `SELECT liability_id, vendor_id, amount_usdc, due_date
       FROM account_liabilities
       WHERE status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'AWAITING_APPROVAL')
       ORDER BY due_date ASC
       LIMIT 10;`
    );

    const pendingLiabilities = liaRes.rows.map((r: any) => ({
      liabilityId: r.liability_id,
      vendorId: r.vendor_id,
      amountUsdc: Number(r.amount_usdc).toFixed(6),
      dueDate: new Date(r.due_date).toISOString(),
    }));

    // Extract tx hashes and doc hashes mentioned in event metadata
    const recentTxHashes: string[] = [];
    const documentHashes: string[] = [];

    for (const ev of events) {
      if (ev.metadata?.txHash && !recentTxHashes.includes(ev.metadata.txHash)) {
        recentTxHashes.push(ev.metadata.txHash);
      }
      if (ev.metadata?.docHash && !documentHashes.includes(ev.metadata.docHash)) {
        documentHashes.push(ev.metadata.docHash);
      }
    }

    // Invariant check: Available == Liquid + Invested (exact 6-decimal integer check)
    const liquidRaw = Math.round(parseFloat(liquid) * 1e6);
    const investedRaw = Math.round(parseFloat(invested) * 1e6);
    const availableRaw = Math.round(parseFloat(available) * 1e6);
    const invariantCheckPassed = liquidRaw + investedRaw === availableRaw;

    return {
      liquidCashUsdc: liquid,
      investedYieldUsdc: invested,
      availableBalanceUsdc: available,
      targetReserveUsdc: reserve,
      safeToInvestUsdc: safeToInvest,
      pendingLiabilities,
      recentTxHashes,
      documentHashes,
      invariantCheckPassed,
    };
  }

  private mapRowToContextEvent(row: any): ContextEvent {
    return {
      id: row.id,
      sessionId: row.session_id,
      eventSeq: parseInt(row.event_seq, 10),
      agentId: row.agent_id,
      agentName: row.agent_name,
      eventType: row.event_type,
      role: row.role,
      content: row.content,
      toolCalls: row.tool_calls || undefined,
      toolCallId: row.tool_call_id || undefined,
      metadata: row.metadata || {},
      isCompacted: row.is_compacted,
      createdAt: row.created_at,
    };
  }
}

import { LlmMessage, LlmRole, LlmToolCall } from "../llm/types.js";

export type ContextEventType =
  | "TASK_INITIATED"
  | "AGENT_REASONING"
  | "TOOL_CALLED"
  | "TOOL_RESULT"
  | "STATE_MUTATION"
  | "INVARIANT_CHECK"
  | "SYSTEM_INTERRUPT"
  | "HUMAN_ESCALATION";

export interface ContextEvent {
  id?: string;
  sessionId: string;
  eventSeq?: number;
  agentId: number;
  agentName: string;
  eventType: ContextEventType;
  role: LlmRole;
  content: string;
  toolCalls?: LlmToolCall[];
  toolCallId?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
  isCompacted?: boolean;
  createdAt?: Date;
}

export interface DeterministicFinancialAnchors {
  liquidCashUsdc: string;
  investedYieldUsdc: string;
  availableBalanceUsdc: string;
  targetReserveUsdc: string;
  safeToInvestUsdc: string;
  pendingLiabilities: Array<{
    liabilityId: string;
    vendorId: string;
    amountUsdc: string;
    dueDate: string;
  }>;
  recentTxHashes: string[];
  documentHashes: string[];
  invariantCheckPassed: boolean;
}

export interface CompactionEpisode {
  id?: string;
  sessionId: string;
  episodeIndex: number;
  startSeq: number;
  endSeq: number;
  narrativeSummary: string;
  deterministicAnchors: DeterministicFinancialAnchors;
  createdAt?: Date;
}

export interface AssembledAgentContext {
  systemPrompt: string;
  messages: LlmMessage[];
  relevantMemorySnippets: string[];
  activeAnchors: DeterministicFinancialAnchors | null;
}

export class ToolRegistry {
  private vectorMemory: VectorMemoryService;
  private dynamicRecords: DynamicRecordsService;
  private accountIntelligence: AccountIntelligenceService;
  private complianceAgent?: PolicyComplianceLlmAgent;
  private onboardingService: EnterpriseOnboardingService;
  private predictiveRefunder: PredictiveRefunderService;
  private witnessService: LedgerWitnessService;
  private vaultService: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService;
  private assetAggregator: UnifiedAssetAggregatorService;
  private disbursalRouter: DisbursalRouterService;
  private erpReconciliation: ErpReconciliationService;
  private unifiedOperationalState: UnifiedOperationalStateService;
  private productionReadiness: ProductionReadinessService;
  private tokenSwapService: TokenSwapService;
  private fiatFundingService: FiatFundingService;
  private liabilitySettingsService: LiabilitySettingsService;
  private manualDisbursalService: ManualDisbursalService;
  private accountFundingService: AccountFundingService;
  private executedIdempotencyKeys: Set<string> = new Set();
  private executor?: ArcTransactionExecutor;

  constructor(
    vectorMemory?: VectorMemoryService,
    dynamicRecords?: DynamicRecordsService,
    accountIntelligence?: AccountIntelligenceService,
    complianceAgent?: PolicyComplianceLlmAgent,
    onboardingService?: EnterpriseOnboardingService,
    predictiveRefunder?: PredictiveRefunderService,
    witnessService?: LedgerWitnessService,
    vaultService?: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService,
    assetAggregator?: UnifiedAssetAggregatorService,
    disbursalRouter?: DisbursalRouterService,
    erpReconciliation?: ErpReconciliationService,
    unifiedOperationalState?: UnifiedOperationalStateService,
    productionReadiness?: ProductionReadinessService
  ) {
    this.vectorMemory = vectorMemory || new VectorMemoryService();
    this.dynamicRecords = dynamicRecords || new DynamicRecordsService();
    this.accountIntelligence = accountIntelligence || new AccountIntelligenceService();
    this.complianceAgent = complianceAgent;
    this.onboardingService = onboardingService || new EnterpriseOnboardingService();
    this.predictiveRefunder = predictiveRefunder || new PredictiveRefunderService();
    this.witnessService = witnessService || new LedgerWitnessService();
    this.vaultService = vaultService || new CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService("0x4444444444444444444444444444444444444444");
    this.assetAggregator = assetAggregator || new UnifiedAssetAggregatorService({ dynamicRecords: this.dynamicRecords });
    this.erpReconciliation = erpReconciliation || new ErpReconciliationService();
    this.productionReadiness = productionReadiness || new ProductionReadinessService(this.witnessService, this.dynamicRecords);
    this.disbursalRouter =
      disbursalRouter ||
      new DisbursalRouterService({
        aggregator: this.assetAggregator,
        dynamicRecords: this.dynamicRecords,
        witnessService: this.witnessService,
        vaultService: this.vaultService,
        erpReconciliation: this.erpReconciliation,
      });
    this.unifiedOperationalState =
      unifiedOperationalState ||
      new UnifiedOperationalStateService({
        aggregator: this.assetAggregator,
        dynamicRecords: this.dynamicRecords,
      });
    this.tokenSwapService = new TokenSwapService();
    this.fiatFundingService = new FiatFundingService(this.dynamicRecords);
    this.liabilitySettingsService = new LiabilitySettingsService();
    this.manualDisbursalService = new ManualDisbursalService({ dynamicRecords: this.dynamicRecords, tokenSwapService: this.tokenSwapService });
    this.accountFundingService = new AccountFundingService({ dynamicRecords: this.dynamicRecords, tokenSwapService: this.tokenSwapService });
  }

  public setComplianceAgent(complianceAgent: PolicyComplianceLlmAgent): void {
    this.complianceAgent = complianceAgent;
  }
