  /**
   * Executes a tool invocation dispatched by an LLM agent.
   */
  public async executeTool(
    name: string,
    args: Record<string, any>
  ): Promise<ToolExecutionResult> {
    try {
      switch (name) {
        case "query_vector_memory": {
          const results = await this.vectorMemory.queryRelevantMemory(
            args.query,
            args.collections,
            args.topK || 4
          );
          return {
            success: true,
            data: results.map((r) => ({
              collection: r.collection,
              title: r.title,
              content: r.content.trim(),
              similarity: r.similarity,
            })),
          };
        }

        case "read_dynamic_records": {
          const horizonSeconds = (args.horizonDays || 7) * 86400;
          const sti = await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(
            args.accountId,
            horizonSeconds
          );
          const liabilities = await this.dynamicRecords.getLiabilities(args.accountId);
          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              tripartiteBalance: sti.tripartiteBalance,
              safeToInvest: sti.safeToInvestUsdc,
              targetReserve: sti.targetReserveUsdc,
              status: sti.status,
              activeLiabilitiesCount: liabilities.length,
              liabilities: liabilities.map((l) => ({
                id: l.liabilityId,
                vendor: l.vendorTitle,
                amount: l.amountUsdc,
                dueDate: l.dueDate.toISOString(),
                status: l.status,
              })),
            },
          };
        }

        case "verify_three_way_match": {
          const { invoiceId, poReference, claimedAmountUsdc, claimedPayoutAddress } = args;

          // 1. Query ERP PO from Vector Memory
          const poResults = await this.vectorMemory.queryRelevantMemory(
            `Purchase Order ${poReference}`,
            ["erp_pos"],
            1
          );

          if (poResults.length === 0) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `3-Way Match Failed: Purchase Order ${poReference} not found in enterprise records.`,
            };
          }

          const poDoc = poResults[0];
          const poAmount = poDoc.metadata?.amount_usdc;
          const poVendorId = poDoc.metadata?.vendor_id;

          // Check arithmetic equality (refuse silent rounding per Rule 5)
          const claimedAmountNum = parseFloat(claimedAmountUsdc);
          if (poAmount !== undefined && Math.abs(claimedAmountNum - poAmount) > 0.000001) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `3-Way Match Failed: Claimed amount (${claimedAmountUsdc} USDC) does not match PO approved amount (${poAmount.toFixed(6)} USDC). Silent rounding rejected.`,
            };
          }

          // 2. Check Payee Substitution against Vendor Master Registry (Rule 3)
          if (poVendorId) {
            const vendorRes = await DbClient.query(
              `SELECT verified_payout_address FROM vendor_master_registry WHERE vendor_id = $1;`,
              [poVendorId]
            );

            if (vendorRes.rows.length > 0) {
              const verifiedAddr = vendorRes.rows[0].verified_payout_address.toLowerCase();
              if (claimedPayoutAddress.toLowerCase() !== verifiedAddr) {
                return {
                  success: false,
                  error: `PAYEE SUBSTITUTION DETECTED (Rule 3 Alert): Claimed invoice payout address (${claimedPayoutAddress}) does not match immutable Vendor Master Registry address (${verifiedAddr})!`,
                };
              }
            }
          }

          // 3. Query Goods Receipt Note (GRN) / Milestone Delivery Telemetry (Rule 2)
          const grnResults = await this.vectorMemory.queryRelevantMemory(
            `Goods Receipt Note Delivery ${poReference}`,
            ["delivery_receipts", "goods_receipts"],
            1
          );

          if (grnResults.length === 0) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `3-Way Match Failed (Rule 2 Alert): Goods Receipt Note (GRN) or delivery telemetry not found for PO ${poReference}. Milestone delivery proof is unverified.`,
            };
          }

          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              matchStatus: "MATCHED",
              poReference,
              grnReference: grnResults[0].metadata?.grn_number || grnResults[0].documentId,
              approvedAmountUsdc: claimedAmountUsdc,
              verifiedPayoutAddress: claimedPayoutAddress,
              message: "3-Way Match verified cleanly across PO, Goods Receipt, and Vendor Master.",
            },
          };
        }

        case "check_vendor_master": {
          const { vendorId, payoutAddress } = args;
          const res = await DbClient.query(
            `SELECT vendor_id, name, verified_payout_address, change_lock 
             FROM vendor_master_registry 
             WHERE vendor_id = $1;`,
            [vendorId]
          );

          if (res.rows.length === 0) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `Vendor ${vendorId} not found in Vendor Master Registry.`,
            };
          }

          const vendor = res.rows[0];
          const match = vendor.verified_payout_address.toLowerCase() === payoutAddress.toLowerCase();

          return {
            success: match,
            data: {
              vendorId: vendor.vendor_id,
              name: vendor.name,
              verifiedAddress: vendor.verified_payout_address,
              claimedAddress: payoutAddress,
              isMatch: match,
            },
            error: match ? undefined : `Address ${payoutAddress} does not match verified address ${vendor.verified_payout_address}. Possible payee substitution!`,
          };
        }

        case "recalculate_safe_to_invest": {
          const sti = await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(
            args.accountId,
            args.timeHorizonSeconds
          );
          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              safeToInvestUsdc: sti.safeToInvestUsdc,
              targetReserveUsdc: sti.targetReserveUsdc,
              status: sti.status,
              tripartiteBalance: sti.tripartiteBalance,
            },
          };
        }

        case "evaluate_reason_bearing_intent": {
          if (!this.complianceAgent) {
            const { PolicyComplianceLlmAgent } = await import("../agents/policyComplianceLlmAgent.js");
            this.complianceAgent = new PolicyComplianceLlmAgent({ toolRegistry: this });
          }
          const evalResult = await this.complianceAgent.evaluateIntent({
            proposedAction: args.proposedAction,
            accountId: args.accountId,
            amountUsdc: args.amountUsdc,
            declaredReason: args.declaredReason,
            recipientAddress: args.recipientAddress,
          });

          return {
            success: evalResult.decision !== "DENY",
            data: evalResult,
            error: evalResult.decision === "DENY" ? evalResult.reason : undefined,
          };
        }

        case "plan_waterfall_allocation": {
          const candidatePlan = await this.accountIntelligence.getWaterfallCandidateAccounts(
            args.requiredAmountUsdc,
            args.balanceOverrides
          );

          return {
            success: true,
            data: candidatePlan,
          };
        }

        case "sweep_excess_liquidity": {
          const { accountId, amountUsdc, clearanceCode } = args;
          if (!clearanceCode || typeof clearanceCode !== "string") {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `GOVERNANCE_VIOLATION: Missing compliance clearanceCode. Treasury fund sweeps require prior reason-bearing intent evaluation and clearance from PolicyComplianceAgent (#104).`,
            };
          }

          const isMockTest = process.env.NODE_ENV === "test" && process.env.ENABLE_MOCKS === "true";
          if (!isMockTest) {
            const validation = await ClearanceCodeRepo.validateCode({
              code: clearanceCode,
              accountId,
              actionType: "SWEEP_EXCESS_LIQUIDITY",
              amountUsdc,
            });
            if (!validation.isValid) {
              return {
                success: false,
                error: `GOVERNANCE_VIOLATION: Invalid or consumed compliance clearanceCode ('${clearanceCode}'): ${validation.reason}`,
              };
            }
            await ClearanceCodeRepo.consumeCode(clearanceCode);
          } else if (!clearanceCode.startsWith("CLEAR-")) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `GOVERNANCE_VIOLATION: Invalid mock compliance clearanceCode ('${clearanceCode}').`,
            };
          }
          const rawAmount = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(amountUsdc);
          const numAmount = typeof amountUsdc === "number" ? amountUsdc : parseFloat(amountUsdc);

          // Real Account Wallet Lookup from TreasuryAccountsRepo
          const accountRecord = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
          if (!accountRecord) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Treasury account '${accountId}' not found in registry.`,
            };
          }
          const accountWallet = accountRecord.wallet_address as `0x${string}`;
          const vaultAddress = this.vaultService.getAddress();

          const execution = await (this.executor ??= new ArcTransactionExecutor()).execute({
            targetContract: vaultAddress,
            abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
            functionName: "sweepFromAccount",
            args: [CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId), accountWallet, rawAmount],
            idempotencyKey: `tool-sweep:${accountId}:${rawAmount}:${clearanceCode}`,
          });
          const txHash = execution.txHash;

          // Independent Ledger Witnessing: Double-Entry Voucher in Sequential Hash Chain
          const docRef = `SWEEP_${accountId}_${Date.now()}`;
          const journalEntry = await this.witnessService.recordJournalVoucher({
            accountId,
            actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
            amountUsdc: numAmount,
            documentRef: docRef,
            category: "YIELD_SWEEP",
          });

          // Immutable Account-Level Audit Logging
          await this.witnessService.recordAccountAuditLog({
            accountId,
            actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_SWEEP",
            amountUsdc: numAmount,
            isAutonomous: true,
            txHash,
            counterpartyAddress: vaultAddress,
            reason: `Autonomous surplus sweep of ${numAmount} USDC to USYC Yield Vault (Clearance: ${clearanceCode})`,
            postStateSnapshot: {
              sweptUsdc: numAmount,
              clearanceCode,
              journalHash: journalEntry.current_hash,
            },
          });

          // Dynamic Record Recalculation after sweep
          await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId);

          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              txHash,
              action: "SWEEP_TO_USYC",
              accountId,
              amountUsdc,
              vaultAddress,
              accountWallet,
              encodedFunctionCall: this.vaultService.encodeSweepFromAccount(accountId, accountWallet, rawAmount),
              journalSequenceId: journalEntry.sequence_id,
              journalHash: journalEntry.current_hash,
            },
          };
        }

        case "recall_invested_liquidity": {
          const { accountId, amountUsdc, reason } = args;
          const rawAmount = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(amountUsdc);
          const numAmount = typeof amountUsdc === "number" ? amountUsdc : parseFloat(amountUsdc);

          // Real Account Wallet Lookup from TreasuryAccountsRepo
          const accountRecord = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
          if (!accountRecord) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Treasury account '${accountId}' not found in registry.`,
            };
          }
          const accountWallet = accountRecord.wallet_address as `0x${string}`;
          const vaultAddress = this.vaultService.getAddress();

          const execution = await (this.executor ??= new ArcTransactionExecutor()).execute({
            targetContract: vaultAddress,
            abi: CentralTreasuryYieldVaultABI,
            functionName: "recallForAccount",
            args: [CentralTreasuryYieldVaultService.formatAccountId(accountId), rawAmount],
            idempotencyKey: `tool-recall:${accountId}:${rawAmount}:${reason || "EMERGENCY_RECALL"}`,
          });
          const txHash = execution.txHash;

          // Independent Ledger Witnessing: Double-Entry Voucher in Sequential Hash Chain
          const docRef = `RECALL_${accountId}_${Date.now()}`;
          const journalEntry = await this.witnessService.recordJournalVoucher({
            accountId,
            actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_RECALL",
            amountUsdc: numAmount,
            documentRef: docRef,
            category: "YIELD_RECALL",
          });

          // Immutable Account-Level Audit Logging
          await this.witnessService.recordAccountAuditLog({
            accountId,
            actionType: "AUTONOMOUS_RECALL",
            amountUsdc: numAmount,
            isAutonomous: true,
            txHash,
            counterpartyAddress: vaultAddress,
            reason: reason || `Autonomous liquidity recall of ${numAmount} USDC from USYC Yield Vault to account ${accountId}`,
            postStateSnapshot: {
              recalledUsdc: numAmount,
              journalHash: journalEntry.current_hash,
            },
          });

          // Dynamic Record Recalculation after recall
          await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(accountId);

          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              txHash,
              action: "RECALL_FROM_USYC",
              accountId,
              amountUsdc,
              reason,
              vaultAddress,
              accountWallet,
              encodedFunctionCall: this.vaultService.encodeRecallForAccount(accountId, rawAmount),
              journalSequenceId: journalEntry.sequence_id,
              journalHash: journalEntry.current_hash,
            },
          };
        }

        case "execute_disbursal": {
          const { accountId, liabilityId, amountUsdc, recipientAddress, invoiceId = "INV-DEFAULT" } = args;
          const rawAmount = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(amountUsdc);

          // Compute deterministic Keccak-256 idempotency key per DisbursalVault.sol:
          // idempotencyKey = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(vendor, invoiceId, amount))
          const idempotencyKey = DisbursalVaultService.generateIdempotencyKey(
            recipientAddress as `0x${string}`,
            invoiceId,
            rawAmount
          );

          // Strict Idempotency Check: Reject duplicate payment execution (Rule 1 & Rule 4)
          if (this.executedIdempotencyKeys.has(idempotencyKey)) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `IDEMPOTENCY DUPLICATE DETECTED: Payment with key ${idempotencyKey} has already executed! Double payment blocked.`,
            };
          }

          if (!args.vendorId) {
            return { success: false, error: "Missing required parameter 'vendorId'. Hardcoded vendor fallbacks are disabled." };
          }
          if (!args.poReference) {
            return { success: false, error: "Missing required 3-way match parameter 'poReference'. PO_DEFAULT fallback is disabled." };
          }
          if (!args.deliveryProofHash) {
            return { success: false, error: "Missing required 3-way match parameter 'deliveryProofHash' (GRN proof). Fake 0xgrn_verified fallback is disabled." };
          }

          const parsedAmount = typeof amountUsdc === "number" ? amountUsdc : parseFloat(amountUsdc);
          const router = new UniversalPaymentRouter();
          const routerResult = await router.routeAndExecute({
            intent: {
              intentId: `DISB_${liabilityId || Date.now()}`,
              primaryAccountId: accountId,
              vendorId: args.vendorId,
              vendorName: args.vendorName || args.vendorId,
              amountUsdc: parsedAmount,
              payoutAddress: recipientAddress,
              declaredReason: args.reason || "Autonomous staged liability execution via DisbursalVault.",
              invoiceId,
              poReference: args.poReference,
              deliveryProofHash: args.deliveryProofHash,
            },
            overrideRail: "DISBURSAL_VAULT",
          });

          this.executedIdempotencyKeys.add(idempotencyKey);

          // Update liability status in Record 1
          if (liabilityId) {
            await this.dynamicRecords.updateLiabilityStatus(liabilityId, "DISBURSED");
          }

          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              txHash: routerResult.txHash,
              action: "DISBURSAL_EXECUTED",
              accountId,
              liabilityId,
              amountUsdc: parsedAmount.toString(),
              recipientAddress,
              idempotencyKey,
              journalSequenceId: routerResult.journalSequenceId,
              vaultAddress: "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555",
              status: "SETTLED",
            },
          };
        }

        case "route_universal_payment": {
          const router = new UniversalPaymentRouter();
          const parsedAmount = typeof args.amountUsdc === "number" ? args.amountUsdc : parseFloat(args.amountUsdc);
          const intent = {
            intentId: args.intentId || `DISB_TOOL_${Date.now()}`,
            primaryAccountId: args.primaryAccountId,
            vendorId: args.vendorId,
            vendorName: args.vendorName || "Authorized Vendor",
            amountUsdc: parsedAmount,
            payoutAddress: args.payoutAddress,
            serviceUrl: args.serviceUrl,
            declaredReason: args.reason || "Universal payment routing execution via agent swarm.",
            invoiceId: args.invoiceId,
            poReference: args.poReference,
            deliveryProofHash: args.deliveryProofHash,
            requireThreeWayMatch: args.requireThreeWayMatch,
            beneficiaryBank: args.beneficiaryBank,
          };
          const res = await router.routeAndExecute({
            intent,
            overrideRail: args.rail,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
          });
          return {
            success: res.success,
            data: res,
            error: res.error,
          };
        }

        case "post_document_linked_gl": {
          const { accountId, documentRef, debitAccount, creditAccount, amountUsdc, txHash } = args;

          const numAmount = typeof amountUsdc === "number" ? amountUsdc : parseFloat(amountUsdc);

          // Append to master system journal using canonical SHA-256 hash chaining (Rule 1 & Rule 4)
          const entry = await MasterJournalRepo.appendEntry({
            account_id: accountId,
            action_type: "DISBURSAL_SETTLEMENT",
            debit_account: debitAccount,
            credit_account: creditAccount,
            amount_usdc: numAmount,
            document_ref: documentRef,
          });

          // Persist real ERP sync checkpoint in database (ErpSyncRepo)
          const syncId = `sync_gl_${entry.sequence_id}`;
          const syncCheckpoint = await ErpSyncRepo.upsertSyncState({
            sync_id: syncId,
            system_type: "ERPNEXT",
            account_id: accountId,
            entity_type: "PAYMENT_ENTRY",
            last_sync_timestamp: new Date(),
            last_synced_document_id: documentRef,
            sync_checkpoint_data: {
              journalSequence: entry.sequence_id,
              currentHash: entry.current_hash,
              previousHash: entry.previous_hash,
              txHash: txHash || `0x${entry.current_hash}`,
              amountUsdc: numAmount,
              debitAccount,
              creditAccount,
            },
            status: "SYNCED",
          });

          let erpSyncRes: any = null;
          try {
            erpSyncRes = await this.erpReconciliation.reconcileDisbursalPayment({
              qualification: {
                invoiceId: documentRef,
                vendorId: args.vendorId || "SYSTEM_GL",
                payoutAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
                totalRequestedUsdc: numAmount.toFixed(6),
                totalRequestedRaw: BigInt(Math.floor(numAmount * 1_000_000)),
                totalAllocatedUsdc: numAmount.toFixed(6),
                totalAllocatedRaw: BigInt(Math.floor(numAmount * 1_000_000)),
                category: "GENERAL_OPEX",
                routeType: "SINGLE_ACCOUNT",
                primaryAccountId: accountId,
                allocations: [{
                  accountId,
                  accountName: "Treasury Account",
                  accountRole: "OPERATING",
                  allocatedAmountUsdc: numAmount.toFixed(6),
                  allocatedAmountRaw: BigInt(Math.floor(numAmount * 1_000_000)),
                  requiresRecall: false,
                  recallAmountUsdc: "0.000000",
                  recallAmountRaw: 0n,
                  remainingFreeCapitalUsdc: "0.000000",
                  remainingFreeCapitalRaw: 0n,
                }],
                requiresHumanApproval: false,
                evaluationReason: "GL sync ledger alignment",
                shortfallUsdc: "0.000000",
                isQualified: true,
                idempotencyKey: `0x${entry.current_hash}`,
                reasonBearingIntent: { proposedAction: "POST_GL", accountId, amountUsdc: numAmount.toFixed(6), declaredReason: "GL sync", recipientAddress: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" },
              },
              txHash: txHash || `0x${entry.current_hash}`,
              journalHash: entry.current_hash,
              journalSequenceId: Number(entry.sequence_id),
            });
          } catch (err: any) {
            console.warn("[ToolRegistry] ERP reconciliation sync notice:", err.message);
          }

          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              journalSequence: entry.sequence_id,
              previousHash: entry.previous_hash,
              currentHash: entry.current_hash,
              documentRef: entry.document_ref,
              erpSyncStatus: erpSyncRes?.status || "SYNCED_TO_MASTER_JOURNAL_AND_ERP_STAGED",
              erpSyncId: syncCheckpoint.sync_id,
              erpConnectors: {
                odooSync: {
                  status: erpSyncRes?.odoo?.success ? "SYNCED" : "PENDING",
                  paymentId: erpSyncRes?.odoo?.paymentId,
                  error: erpSyncRes?.odoo?.error,
                },
                erpNextSync: {
                  status: erpSyncRes?.erpNext?.success ? "SYNCED" : "PENDING",
                  docType: "Payment Entry",
                  docName: erpSyncRes?.erpNext?.paymentEntryDocName,
                  error: erpSyncRes?.erpNext?.error,
                },
              },
              timestamp: entry.timestamp,
            },
          };
        }

        case "request_human_approval": {
          const { accountId, actionType, amountUsdc, reason, payload } = args;
          const reqId = `SPRS_${Date.now()}`;
          await DbClient.query(
            `INSERT INTO permission_requests (request_id, action_type, reason, amount_usdc, status, payload)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'PENDING', $5);`,
            [reqId, actionType, reason, amountUsdc, JSON.stringify(payload)]
          );

          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              requestId: reqId,
              status: "PENDING_HUMAN_SIGN_OFF",
              eip712Domain: { name: "BizArc Treasury", version: "1", chainId: 5042 },
              reason,
            },
          };
        }

        case "synthesize_policy_proposal": {
          const proposal = this.onboardingService.generatePolicyProposal({
            companyName: args.companyName,
            adminEmail: args.adminEmail || `admin@${args.companyName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")}.com`,
            erpSource: args.erpSource || "MANUAL_IMPORT",
            costCenters: args.costCenters || [],
            discoveredSuppliers: args.suppliers || [],
            discoveredLiabilities: args.invoices || [],
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: proposal,
          };
        }

        case "provision_arc_wallets": {
          const res = await this.onboardingService.provisionAccountsAndLedger({
            profile: {
              companyName: args.companyName,
              adminEmail: args.adminEmail || "admin@corp.com",
              erpSource: args.erpSource || "MANUAL_IMPORT",
              costCenters: args.costCenters || [],
              discoveredSuppliers: args.suppliers || [],
              discoveredLiabilities: args.invoices || [],
            },
            committedPolicy: args.committedPolicy || this.onboardingService.generatePolicyProposal({
              companyName: args.companyName,
              adminEmail: "admin@corp.com",
              erpSource: "MANUAL_IMPORT",
              costCenters: args.costCenters || [],
              discoveredSuppliers: args.suppliers || [],
              discoveredLiabilities: args.invoices || [],
            }).profile,
            customWallets: args.customWallets,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "generate_spending_guardrails_handoff": {
          const handoff = this.onboardingService.generateSpendingGuardrailsCommands(args.costCenters || []);
          return {

            data: handoff,
          };
        }

        case "verify_initial_funding": {
          const res = await this.onboardingService.verifyInitialFunding(args.accountId, args.minDepositUsdc ?? 1.0);
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "ingest_enterprise_documents": {
          const docs = args.documents || [];
          for (const doc of docs) {
            await this.vectorMemory.ingestDocument(doc);
          }
          return {
            success: true,
            data: { ingestedCount: docs.length },
          };
        }

        case "register_vendor": {
          const vendor = await VendorLifecycleService.registerVendor({
            vendorId: args.vendorId,
            name: args.name,
            verifiedPayoutAddress: args.verifiedPayoutAddress,
            paymentEndpointUrl: args.paymentEndpointUrl,
            payoutRail: args.payoutRail,
            taxId: args.taxId,
            authorizedCategory: args.authorizedCategory,
            verifiedByAdmin: args.verifiedByAdmin || "ONBOARDING_AGENT",
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: vendor,
          };
        }

        case "update_vendor": {
          const result = await VendorLifecycleService.proposeOrUpdateVendor({
            vendorId: args.vendorId,
            name: args.name,
            newPayoutAddress: args.newPayoutAddress,
            newPaymentEndpointUrl: args.newPaymentEndpointUrl,
            payoutRail: args.payoutRail,
            reason: args.reason,
            proposedBy: args.proposedBy,
            sprsRequestId: args.sprsRequestId,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
          });
          return {
            success: result.status === "UPDATED",
            data: result,
            error: result.status === "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL" ? result.message : undefined,
          };
        }

        case "remove_vendor": {
          const result = await VendorLifecycleService.removeVendor({
            vendorId: args.vendorId,
            reason: args.reason,
            proposedBy: args.proposedBy,
            sprsRequestId: args.sprsRequestId,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
          });
          return {
            success: result.status === "REMOVED",
            data: result,
            error: result.status === "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL" ? `Vendor removal requires Layer 2 Human Approval (SPRS ${result.sprsRequestId})` : undefined,
          };
        }

        case "add_account_liability": {
          if (
            args.proposedBy === "LiabilityRadarAgent" ||
            args.autoStage ||
            args.isVerifiedInvoice ||
            !args.frequencyCron
          ) {
            const isFiat = args.preferredPaymentRail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" || Boolean(args.bankDetails) || (Boolean(args.payoutAddress) && !args.payoutAddress.startsWith("0x"));
            const created = await LiabilityRepo.createLiability({
              company_id: args.companyId || "default_org",
              account_id: args.accountId,
              vendor_id: args.vendorId,
              title: args.title,
              category: (args.category as any) || "SAAS",
              amount_usdc: parseFloat(args.amountUsdc),
              due_date: new Date(args.dueDate || Date.now()),
              frequency_cron: args.frequencyCron || null,
              payout_address: args.payoutAddress || null,
              source_po_hash: args.poReference || null,
              source_invoice_hash: args.invoiceId || null,
              status: "SCHEDULED",
              preferred_payment_rail: args.preferredPaymentRail || (isFiat ? "FIAT_PAYOUT" : "DISBURSAL_VAULT"),
              payment_sub_method: args.preferredSubMethod || args.bankDetails?.paymentSubMethod || null,
              payment_rail_config: args.bankDetails || args.cryptoDetails || {},
            });
            return {
              success: true,
              data: {
                status: "CREATED",
                liabilityId: created.liability_id,
                liability: created,
                message: `Liability '${created.title}' staged in Dynamic Record 1.`,
              },
            };
          }

          const result = await RecurringLiabilityService.addRecurringLiability({
            spec: {
              companyId: args.companyId,
              accountId: args.accountId,
              vendorId: args.vendorId,
              title: args.title,
              category: args.category,
              amountUsdc: args.amountUsdc,
              dueDate: new Date(args.dueDate),
              frequencyCron: args.frequencyCron,
              payoutAddress: args.payoutAddress,
              poReference: args.poReference,
              preferredPaymentRail: args.preferredPaymentRail,
              preferredSubMethod: args.preferredSubMethod,
              bankDetails: args.bankDetails,
              cryptoDetails: args.cryptoDetails,
            },
            proposedBy: args.proposedBy,
            rationale: args.rationale,
            sprsRequestId: args.sprsRequestId,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
          });
          return {
            success: result.status === "CREATED",
            data: result,
            error: result.status === "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL" ? result.message : undefined,
          };
        }

        case "edit_account_liability": {
          if (args.liabilityId && (args.proposedBy === "LiabilityRadarAgent" || args.autoStage)) {
            const companyId = args.companyId || "default_org";
            const updated = await LiabilityRepo.updateLiability(args.liabilityId, companyId, {
              title: args.title,
              amount_usdc: args.amountUsdc ? parseFloat(args.amountUsdc) : undefined,
              due_date: args.dueDate ? new Date(args.dueDate) : undefined,
              frequency_cron: args.frequencyCron,
              account_id: args.accountId,
            });
            if (updated) {
              return {
                success: true,
                data: {
                  status: "UPDATED",
                  liability: updated,
                  message: `Liability '${args.liabilityId}' updated successfully in Dynamic Record 1.`,
                },
              };
            }
          }

          const result = await RecurringLiabilityService.editRecurringLiability({
            liabilityId: args.liabilityId,
            updates: {
              title: args.title,
              amountUsdc: args.amountUsdc,
              dueDate: args.dueDate ? new Date(args.dueDate) : undefined,
              frequencyCron: args.frequencyCron,
              accountId: args.accountId,
            },
            proposedBy: args.proposedBy,
            rationale: args.rationale,
            sprsRequestId: args.sprsRequestId,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
          });
          return {
            success: result.status === "UPDATED",
            data: result,
            error: result.status === "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL" ? result.message : undefined,
          };
        }

        case "remove_account_liability": {
          const result = await RecurringLiabilityService.removeRecurringLiability({
            liabilityId: args.liabilityId,
            proposedBy: args.proposedBy,
            rationale: args.rationale,
            sprsRequestId: args.sprsRequestId,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
          });
          return {
            success: result.status === "REMOVED",
            data: result,
            error: result.status === "PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL" ? result.message : undefined,
          };
        }

        case "scan_predictive_liabilities": {
          const upcoming = await this.predictiveRefunder.scanUpcomingLiabilities({
            accountId: args.accountId,
            baseLeadTimeSeconds: args.leadTimeSeconds,
          });
          const assessment = args.accountId
            ? await this.predictiveRefunder.assessAccountShortfall({
                accountId: args.accountId,
                upcomingLiabilities: upcoming,
              })
            : null;
          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              upcomingLiabilitiesCount: upcoming.length,
              upcomingLiabilities: upcoming,
              assessment,
            },
          };
        }

        case "execute_predictive_recall": {
          const shortfallRaw = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(args.shortfallUsdc);
          const result = await this.predictiveRefunder.executePredictiveRecall({
            accountId: args.accountId,
            shortfallRaw,
            reason: args.reason,
            clearanceCode: args.clearanceCode,
            sprsRequestId: args.sprsRequestId,
          });
          return {
            success: result.status === "EXECUTED",
            data: result,
            error: result.status !== "EXECUTED" ? result.message : undefined,
          };
        }

        case "get_unified_asset_distribution": {
          const distribution = await this.assetAggregator.aggregateCompanyAssets(args.balanceOverrides);
          return {
            success: true,
            data: distribution,
          };
        }

        case "qualify_disbursal_route": {
          const qualification = await this.disbursalRouter.qualifyDisbursalRoute({
            invoiceId: args.invoiceId,
            liabilityId: args.liabilityId,
            vendorId: args.vendorId,
            payoutAddress: args.payoutAddress,
            amountUsdc: args.amountUsdc,
            category: args.category,
            declaredReason: args.declaredReason,
            preferredAccountId: args.preferredAccountId,
            balanceOverrides: args.balanceOverrides,
          });
          return {
            success: qualification.isQualified,
            data: qualification,
            error: qualification.isQualified ? undefined : qualification.evaluationReason,
          };
        }

        case "execute_disbursal_route": {
          const result = await this.disbursalRouter.executeDisbursalRoute({
            qualification: args.qualification,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
            clearanceCode: args.clearanceCode,
          });
          return {
            success: result.status === "SETTLED",
            data: result,
            error: result.status !== "SETTLED" ? result.message : undefined,
          };
        }

        case "authorize_transaction_intent": {
          const result = await AuthorizationGate.authorizeTransactionIntent({
            permissionRequestId: args.permissionRequestId,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
            approverEmail: args.approverEmail,
            executionPayload: args.executionPayload,
          });
          return {
            success: result.status === "AUTHORIZED",
            data: result,
          };
        }

        case "get_unified_operational_state": {
          const state = await this.unifiedOperationalState.getUnifiedOperationalState({
            accountId: args.accountId,
            horizonDays: args.horizonDays,
            includeAuditHistoryLimit: args.includeAuditHistoryLimit,
            balanceOverrides: args.balanceOverrides,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: state,
          };
        }

        case "get_account_intelligence": {
          const intel = await this.accountIntelligence.getAccountIntelligence(args.accountId);
          return {
            success: true,
            data: intel,
          };
        }

        case "transfer_account_liquidity": {
          const { sourceAccountId, targetAccountId, amountUsdc, reason, permissionRequestId } = args;
          if (sourceAccountId === targetAccountId) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: "TRANSFER_INVALID: sourceAccountId and targetAccountId must be different.",
            };
          }

          const parsedAmount = typeof amountUsdc === "number" ? amountUsdc : parseFloat(amountUsdc);
          if (isNaN(parsedAmount) || parsedAmount <= 0) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `TRANSFER_INVALID: Amount must be a positive number, got '${amountUsdc}'.`,
            };
          }

          const sourceAcc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(sourceAccountId);
          if (!sourceAcc) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `TRANSFER_ERROR: Source account '${sourceAccountId}' not found.`,
            };
          }

          const targetAcc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(targetAccountId);
          if (!targetAcc) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `TRANSFER_ERROR: Target account '${targetAccountId}' not found.`,
            };
          }

          const tripartite = await this.dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(sourceAccountId);
          const available = parseFloat(tripartite.availableBalanceUsdc);
          if (available < parsedAmount) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY: Source account '${sourceAccountId}' has ${available} USDC available, but transfer requested ${parsedAmount} USDC.`,
            };
          }

          const rawAmount = this.dynamicRecords.parseUsdcToRaw(parsedAmount.toString());
          const execution = await (this.executor ??= new ArcTransactionExecutor()).execute({
            targetContract: ARC_CONSTANTS.USDC_PREDEPLOY,
            abi: USDC_ABI,
            functionName: "transfer",
            args: [targetAcc.wallet_address as `0x${string}`, rawAmount],
            idempotencyKey: `internal-transfer:${sourceAccountId}:${targetAccountId}:${rawAmount}:${permissionRequestId}`,
          });
          const txHash = execution.txHash;

          const debitLog = await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
            account_id: sourceAccountId,
            action_type: "INTERNAL_TRANSFER_DEBIT",
            amount_usdc: parsedAmount,
            is_autonomous: true,
            permission_request_id: permissionRequestId,
            tx_hash: txHash,
            counterparty_address: targetAcc.wallet_address,
            reason: reason || `Internal liquidity rebalancing from ${sourceAccountId} to ${targetAccountId}`,
            pre_state_snapshot: { balance: available },
            post_state_snapshot: { balance: available - parsedAmount },
            actor_agent: "AUTONOMOUS_TREASURY_ORCHESTRATOR",
          });

          await AuditLogRepo.appendAuditLog({
            account_id: targetAccountId,
            action_type: "INTERNAL_TRANSFER_CREDIT",
            amount_usdc: parsedAmount,
            is_autonomous: true,
            permission_request_id: permissionRequestId,
            tx_hash: txHash,
            counterparty_address: sourceAcc.wallet_address,
            reason: reason || `Internal liquidity received from ${sourceAccountId}`,
            pre_state_snapshot: {},
            post_state_snapshot: {},
            actor_agent: "AUTONOMOUS_TREASURY_ORCHESTRATOR",
          });

          await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(sourceAccountId);
          await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(targetAccountId);

          const sourcePostBalance = (available - parsedAmount).toFixed(6);
          const targetTripartite = await this.dynamicRecords.getTripartiteBalance(targetAccountId);
          const targetPostBalance = (parseFloat(targetTripartite.availableBalanceUsdc) + parsedAmount).toFixed(6);

          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              txHash,
              sourcePostBalance,
              targetPostBalance,
              auditLogId: Number(debitLog.log_id || 0),
            },
          };
        }

        case "convert_crypto_to_fiat_payout": {
          const { sourceAccountId, amountUsdc, beneficiaryBank, invoiceReference, vendorId, vendorName, adminSignature } = args;
          const parsedAmount = typeof amountUsdc === "number" ? amountUsdc : parseFloat(amountUsdc);
          if (isNaN(parsedAmount) || parsedAmount <= 0) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `FIAT_CONVERSION_ERROR: Amount must be positive, got '${amountUsdc}'.`,
            };
          }

          if (!beneficiaryBank || !beneficiaryBank.ibanOrAccountNumber || !beneficiaryBank.routingOrSwift) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: "FIAT_CONVERSION_ERROR: Incomplete beneficiary bank details provided.",
            };
          }

          const sourceAcc = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(sourceAccountId);
          if (!sourceAcc) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `FIAT_CONVERSION_ERROR: Source account '${sourceAccountId}' not found.`,
            };
          }

          const router = new UniversalPaymentRouter();
          const targetVendorId = vendorId || `vnd_fiat_${sourceAccountId}`;
          const targetVendorName = vendorName || beneficiaryBank.accountHolderName || `Fiat Vendor (${targetVendorId})`;

          const disbursalResult = await router.routeAndExecute({
            intent: {
              intentId: `fiat_intent_${Date.now()}`,
              vendorId: targetVendorId,
              vendorName: targetVendorName,
              amountUsdc: parsedAmount,
              primaryAccountId: sourceAccountId,
              declaredReason: `Fiat payout of $${parsedAmount.toFixed(2)} to ${targetVendorName}`,
              beneficiaryBank: {
                accountHolderName: beneficiaryBank.accountHolderName || targetVendorName,
                ibanOrAccountNumber: beneficiaryBank.ibanOrAccountNumber,
                routingOrSwift: beneficiaryBank.routingOrSwift,
                bankCountry: beneficiaryBank.bankCountry || "US",
                bankName: beneficiaryBank.bankName,
                paymentSubMethod: beneficiaryBank.paymentSubMethod || "FEDWIRE",
                cardToken: beneficiaryBank.cardToken,
                cardLast4: beneficiaryBank.cardLast4,
                cardNetwork: beneficiaryBank.cardNetwork,
              },
              invoiceId: invoiceReference || `INV_${Date.now()}`,
            },
            adminSignature: adminSignature ? (adminSignature as `0x${string}`) : undefined,
            overrideRail: "FIAT_PAYOUT",
          });

          await this.dynamicRecords.calculateSafeToInvest(sourceAccountId);

          return {
            success: disbursalResult.success,
            data: disbursalResult,
            error: disbursalResult.error,
          };
        }

        case "get_yield_performance_metrics": {
          const { accountId, timeframe = "30D" } = args;
          const account = await TreasuryAccountsRepo.getAccountById(accountId);
          if (!account) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Account '${accountId}' does not exist.`,
            };
          }

          let sinceMs = Date.now() - 30 * 86400 * 1000;
          if (timeframe === "7D") {
            sinceMs = Date.now() - 7 * 86400 * 1000;
          } else if (timeframe === "YTD") {
            const now = new Date();
            sinceMs = new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1).getTime();
          }

          const logs = await AuditLogRepo.getAuditLogsByAccount(accountId, 100);
          let cumulativeDeposited = 0;
          let cumulativeWithdrawn = 0;

          for (const log of logs) {
            const logTime = log.timestamp ? new Date(log.timestamp).getTime() : 0;
            if (logTime >= sinceMs) {
              if (log.action_type === "SWEEP_TO_YIELD" || log.action_type === "YIELD_DEPOSIT") {
                cumulativeDeposited += log.amount_usdc;
              } else if (log.action_type === "RECALL_FROM_YIELD" || log.action_type === "YIELD_WITHDRAWAL") {
                cumulativeWithdrawn += log.amount_usdc;
              }
            }
          }

          let currentAssets = 0;
          try {
            const rawAssets = await this.vaultService.getAccountAssets(accountId);
            currentAssets = Number(rawAssets) / 1_000_000;
          } catch {
            currentAssets = 0;
          }

          const netPrincipal = Math.max(0, cumulativeDeposited - cumulativeWithdrawn);
          const netYieldAccrued = Math.max(0, currentAssets - netPrincipal);

          return {
            success: true,
            data: {
              accountId,
              timeframe,
              usdcDepositedCumulative: cumulativeDeposited.toFixed(6),
              usdcWithdrawnCumulative: cumulativeWithdrawn.toFixed(6),
              netYieldAccruedUsdc: netYieldAccrued.toFixed(6),
              currentAnnualizedApr: 0.0515,
            },
          };
        }

        case "audit_production_readiness": {
          const report = await this.productionReadiness.auditProductionReadiness(args.companyId);
          return {
            success: true,
            data: report,
          };
        }

        case "activate_production_profile": {
          const { adminEmail, reason } = args;
          if (!adminEmail || !reason) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: "Missing required parameters: adminEmail and reason are mandatory for production activation.",
            };
          }
          const activation = await this.productionReadiness.activateProductionProfile({
            adminEmail,
            reason,
            vaultAddress: args.vaultAddress,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: activation,
          };
        }

        case "trigger_emergency_circuit_breaker": {
          const { action, reason, adminEmail, clearanceCode } = args;
          if (action === "RESET") {
            if (!clearanceCode) {
              return {
                success: false,
                error: "Missing clearanceCode: Valid administrative clearance code required to disarm emergency circuit breaker.",
              };
            }
            const resetResult = await this.productionReadiness.resetCircuitBreaker(adminEmail || "cfo@bizarc.io", clearanceCode);
            return {
              success: true,
              data: resetResult,
            };
          } else {
            const tripResult = await this.productionReadiness.triggerEmergencyCircuitBreaker(reason || "Anomaly detected", adminEmail || "system@bizarc.io");
            return {
              success: true,
              data: tripResult,
            };
          }
        }

        case "replace_yield_vault_integration": {
          const { newVaultAddress, isAllowlisted } = args;
          if (!newVaultAddress) {
            return {
              success: false,
              error: "Missing newVaultAddress: Target institutional USYC vault address is required.",
            };
          }
          const migration = await this.productionReadiness.replaceYieldVaultIntegration(
            newVaultAddress,
            isAllowlisted !== false
          );
          return {
            success: true,
            data: migration,
          };
        }

        case "estimate_token_swap": {
          const res = await this.tokenSwapService.estimateSwap({
            fromChain: args.fromChain,
            fromToken: args.fromToken,
            toChain: args.toChain,
            toToken: args.toToken,
            amount: args.amount,
            slippage: args.slippage,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "execute_token_swap": {
          const res = await this.tokenSwapService.executeSwap({
            accountId: args.accountId,
            fromChain: args.fromChain,
            fromToken: args.fromToken,
            toChain: args.toChain,
            toToken: args.toToken,
            amount: args.amount,
            slippage: args.slippage,
            maxSlippageLimit: args.maxSlippageLimit,
            declaredReason: args.declaredReason,
          });
          return {
            success: res.success,
            data: res,
            error: res.error,
          };
        }

        case "create_fiat_onramp_session": {
          const res = await this.fiatFundingService.createFiatOnRampSession({
            accountId: args.accountId,
            amountUsdc: typeof args.amountUsdc === "number" ? args.amountUsdc : parseFloat(args.amountUsdc),
            userEmail: args.userEmail,
            chain: args.chain,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "get_fiat_wire_deposit_instructions": {
          const res = await this.fiatFundingService.getFiatWireInstructions({
            accountId: args.accountId,
            currency: args.currency,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "record_fiat_deposit": {
          const res = await this.fiatFundingService.recordFiatDeposit({
            accountId: args.accountId,
            amountUsdc: typeof args.amountUsdc === "number" ? args.amountUsdc : parseFloat(args.amountUsdc),
            depositReference: args.depositReference,
            sourceBank: args.sourceBank,
            senderName: args.senderName,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "configure_liability_payment_method": {
          const res = await this.liabilitySettingsService.configurePaymentMethod({
            companyId: args.companyId,
            vendorId: args.vendorId,
            liabilityId: args.liabilityId,
            preferredRail: args.preferredRail,
            preferredSubMethod: args.preferredSubMethod,
            cryptoDetails: args.cryptoDetails,
            fiatDetails: args.fiatDetails,
            disbursalRules: args.disbursalRules,
          });
          return {
            success: res.success,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "get_liability_payment_method": {
          const res = await this.liabilitySettingsService.getPaymentMethod({
            companyId: args.companyId,
            vendorId: args.vendorId,
            liabilityId: args.liabilityId,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "execute_manual_disbursal": {
          const res = await this.manualDisbursalService.executeManualDisbursal({
            companyId: args.companyId,
            sourceAccountId: args.sourceAccountId,
            vendorId: args.vendorId,
            vendorName: args.vendorName,
            amountUsdc: typeof args.amountUsdc === "number" ? args.amountUsdc : parseFloat(args.amountUsdc),
            paymentRail: args.paymentRail,
            fiatDetails: args.fiatDetails,
            cryptoDetails: args.cryptoDetails,
            declaredReason: args.declaredReason,
            invoiceId: args.invoiceId,
            poReference: args.poReference,
            category: args.category,
            adminSignature: args.adminSignature,
            clearanceCode: args.clearanceCode,
          });
          return {
            success: res.success,
            data: res,
            error: res.error,
          };
        }

        case "get_account_funding_options": {
          const res = await this.accountFundingService.getFundingOptions(args.accountId);
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        case "fund_treasury_account": {
          const res = await this.accountFundingService.initiateFundingSession({
            accountId: args.accountId,
            method: args.method,
            amountUsdc: typeof args.amountUsdc === "number" ? args.amountUsdc : parseFloat(args.amountUsdc),
            userEmail: args.userEmail,
            sourceChain: args.sourceChain,
            sourceToken: args.sourceToken,
          });
          return {
            success: true,
            data: res,
          };
        }

        default:
          return {
            success: false,
            error: `Unknown tool name: ${name}`,
          };
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Tool execution failed: ${err.message}`,
      };
    }
  }
}

# Run and deploy your AI Studio app

This contains everything you need to run your app locally.

View your app in AI Studio: https://ai.studio/apps/9127f9ba-154e-41df-8694-db6c9f8fbe1b

## Run Locally

**Prerequisites:**  Node.js


1. Install dependencies:
   `npm install`
2. Set the `GEMINI_API_KEY` in [.env.local](.env.local) to your Gemini API key
3. Run the app:
   `npm run dev`

/**
 * One coherent fictional company ("Halcyon Robotics Inc.") used across the system so numbers agree everywhere.
 * Every amount is an exact Usdc string; every balance satisfies B_E = B_L + B_Y; the journal's hash chain links.
 */
import { fromMicro, sumUsdc, toMicro } from "./money";
import type * as T from "./types";

/* Deterministic fake hex (fixtures only) */
export function hex(seed: string, bytes = 32): T.Hex {
  let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;
  let out = "";
  for (let i = 0; out.length < bytes * 2; i++) {
    const c = seed.charCodeAt(i % seed.length) + i * 31;
    h = Math.imul(h ^ c, 16777619) >>> 0;
    h ^= h >>> 13;
    out += (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
  }
  return `0x${out.slice(0, bytes * 2)}` as T.Hex;
}

export const addr = (seed: string) => hex(seed, 20);
const ago = (min: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 14, 3, 30) - min * 60_000).toISOString();

export const ACCOUNTS: T.AccountDistribution[] = SEEDS.map(s => {
  const total = sumUsdc([s.liquid, s.invested]);
  const free = toMicro(s.liquid) > toMicro(s.reserve) ? fromMicro(toMicro(s.liquid) - toMicro(s.reserve)) : "0.000000";
  return {
    accountId: s.id,
    name: s.name,
    role: s.role,
    chain: "Arc Testnet (5042002)",
    address: addr(s.id),
    liquidUsdc: s.liquid,
    investedUsyc: s.invested,
    totalEffectiveUsdc: total,
    committedLiabilities30dUsdc: s.committed,
    protectedReserveUsdc: s.reserve,
    freeCapitalUsdc: free,
    safeToInvestUsdc: s.safe,
    excludeFromWaterfall: !!s.shield,
    isActive: true,
    authorizedCategories: s.cats,
  };
});

export const TOTAL_EFFECTIVE = sumUsdc(ACCOUNTS.map(a => a.totalEffectiveUsdc));

/* ───────── Liabilities (11 Bills) ───────── */
const L = (
  n: number,
  accountId: string,
  vendorId: string,
  title: string,
  category: string,
  amountUsdc: string,
  dueDays: number,
  status: T.LiabilityStatus,
  rail: T.PaymentRail
): T.Liability => ({
  liabilityId: `0b6f1c2e-5a7d-4c1e-9d3b-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`,
  accountId,
  vendorId,
  title,
  category,
  amountUsdc,
  dueDate: inDays(dueDays),
  status,
  payoutAddress: VENDOR_BY_ID[vendorId]?.verifiedPayoutAddress ?? "Bank account on file",
  isOverdue: dueDays < 0 && status !== "SETTLED",
  rail,
});

/* ───────── SPRS (Human-In-The-Loop Approval Gates) ───────── */
const impact = (id: string, cash: string, recall: string): T.SprAccountImpact => {
  const a = ACCOUNT_BY_ID[id];
  const post = fromMicro(toMicro(cash) + toMicro(recall));
  return {
    accountId: id,
    role: a.role,
    currentLiquidBalance: cash,
    currentInvestedUsyc: a.investedUsyc,
    usycRecallAmount: recall,
    postTxLiquidBalance: post,
    postTxInvestedUsyc: fromMicro(toMicro(a.investedUsyc) - toMicro(recall)),
    unencumberedBalance: a.freeCapitalUsdc,
  };
};

/* ───────── Cryptographic Master Journal ───────── */
const GENESIS = ("0x" + "0".repeat(64)) as T.Hex;
const voucherSeeds: [string, string, string, string, string, string][] = [
  ["GENESIS", "acc_treasury", "Ledger genesis", "—", "0.000000", "ONBOARDING-GENESIS"],
  ["DEPOSIT", "acc_treasury", "Bank: Circle Mint", "acc_treasury:liquid", "250000.000000", "FEDWIRE-BIZARC-MINT-001"],
  ["SWEEP_TO_YIELD", "acc_treasury", "acc_treasury:liquid", "acc_treasury:invested", "410000.000000", "SWEEP-0001"],
  ["DEPOSIT", "acc_payroll", "Bank: Circle Mint", "acc_payroll:liquid", "96000.000000", "ACH-BIZARC-MINT-014"],
  ["DISBURSEMENT", "acc_engineering", "acc_engineering:liquid", "vendor_aws", "13980.250000", "INV-AWS-SEP"],
  ["RECALL_FROM_YIELD", "acc_engineering", "acc_engineering:invested", "acc_engineering:liquid", "12000.000000", "RECALL-0004"],
  ["FIAT_PAYOUT", "acc_legal", "acc_legal:liquid", "vendor_mofo", "4200.000000", "INV-MOFO-1987"],
  ["DISBURSEMENT", "acc_engineering", "acc_engineering:liquid", "vendor_github", "760.000000", "INV-GH-SEP"],
];

export const JOURNAL: T.JournalVoucher[] = (() => {
  const out: T.JournalVoucher[] = [];
  let prev = GENESIS;
  voucherSeeds.forEach(([type, acct, debit, credit, amt, ref], i) => {
    const cur = hex(`journal-${i}-${prev}-${ref}`);
    out.push({
      sequenceId: i + 1,
      timestamp: ago(60 * 24 * (20 - i * 2)),
      accountId: acct,
      actionType: type,
      debitAccount: debit,
      creditAccount: credit,
      amountUsdc: amt,
      documentRef: ref,
      txHash: i === 0 ? undefined : hex(`tx-${i}`),
      previousHash: prev,
      currentHash: cur,
    });
    prev = cur;
  });
  return out;
})();

import { useId, useState, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode, type InputHTMLAttributes } from "react";
import { isUsdc } from "./money";

export type Tone = "neutral" | "auto" | "gate" | "danger" | "info" | "liquid" | "invested";

export function Button({
  variant = "primary",
  loading,
  children,
  ...p
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "quiet" | "danger";
  loading?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      {...p}
      className="bz-btn"
      data-v={variant}
      disabled={p.disabled || loading}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
    >
      {loading ? "Working…" : children}
    </button>
  );
}

  </span>
);

export const Panel = ({

    {(title || actions) && (
  <section className="bz-panel" data-tone={tone}>
    {(title || actions || action) && (

        {actions ?? action}
      </header>
    )}

  </section>
);

export function Field({
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string;
  children: (id: string, describedBy: string | undefined) => ReactNode;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  const d = error || hint ? `${id}-d` : undefined;
  return (
    <div className="bz-field">
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      {children(id, d)}
      {error ? (
        <span id={d} className="bz-err" role="alert">
          {error}
        </span>
      ) : hint ? (
        <span id={d} className="bz-hint">
          {hint}
        </span>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Amount entry that refuses anything the ledger would round. Emits a string, never a number. */
export function UsdcInput({
  id,
  value,
  onChange,
  describedBy,
}: {
  id?: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string, valid: boolean) => void;
  onChange: (v: string, valid?: boolean) => void;
  describedBy?: string;
}) {
  const bad = value !== "" && !isUsdc(value);
  return (
    <div className="bz-usdc">
      <span>USDC</span>
      <input
        id={id}
        className="bz-input"
        inputMode="decimal"
        value={value}
        aria-invalid={bad}
        aria-describedby={describedBy}
        placeholder="0.000000"
        onChange={e => {
          const v = e.target.value.trim();
          onChange(v, isUsdc(v));
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export function Select<T extends string>({
  id,
  value,
  onChange,
  options,
}: {
  id?: string;
  value: T;
  onChange: (v: T) => void;
  options: { value: T; label: string }[];
}) {
  return (
    <select
      id={id}
      className="bz-input"
      value={value}
      onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value as T)}
    >
      {options.map(o => (
        <option key={o.value} value={o.value}>
          {o.label}
        </option>
      ))}
    </select>
  );
}

}: {

      {tabs.map(t => (

              }}
            >
              {t.count}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export interface Column<R> {
  key: string;
  header: string;
  align?: "r";
  render: (row: R) => ReactNode;
}

export function DataTable<R>({
  columns,
  rows,
  rowKey,
  keyExtractor,
  empty,
}: {
  columns: Column<R>[];
  rows: R[];
  rowKey?: (r: R) => string;
  keyExtractor?: (r: R) => string;
  empty?: ReactNode;
}) {
  if (!rows.length) return <>{empty ?? <EmptyState title="Nothing here yet" />}</>;
  const getKey = (r: R, i: number) =>
    typeof rowKey === "function"
      ? rowKey(r)
      : typeof keyExtractor === "function"
      ? keyExtractor(r)
      : (r as any)?.id ||
        (r as any)?.keyId ||
        (r as any)?.vendorId ||
        (r as any)?.userId ||
        (r as any)?.provider ||
        (r as any)?.accountId ||
        (r as any)?.liabilityId ||
        String(i);

  return (
    <div className="bz-tablewrap">
      <table className="bz-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {columns.map(c => (
              <th key={c.key} className={c.align}>
                {c.header}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.map((r, idx) => (
            <tr key={getKey(r, idx)}>
              {columns.map(c => (
                <td key={c.key} className={c.align}>
                  {c.render(r)}
                </td>
              ))}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export const Meter = ({

}: {

  tone?: "gate" | "danger";

  return (

      aria-valuemin={0}

/** Addresses, hashes and keys are never silently truncated: short form for scanning, full value on copy and hover. */
export function CopyChip({
  value,
  text,
  label,
}: {
  value?: string;
  text?: string;
  label?: string;
}) {
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const safeVal = value || "";
  const safeVal = value || text || "";
  const short = safeVal.length > 20 ? `${safeVal.slice(0, 8)}…${safeVal.slice(-6)}` : safeVal;
  return (
    <span className="bz-chip" title={safeVal}>
      <span className="bz-hash">{short || "—"}</span>
      {safeVal && (
        <button
          type="button"
          aria-label={`Copy ${label ?? "value"}`}
          onClick={async () => {
            await navigator.clipboard?.writeText(safeVal);
            setDone(true);
            setTimeout(() => setDone(false), 1400);
          }}
        >
          {done ? "Copied" : "Copy"}
        </button>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Rule 5 (Refuse Silent Rounding): USDC is a 6-decimal STRING end to end.
 * Never Number/parseFloat for balance mutations or transactions.
 */

export class LoudRoundingError extends Error {
  constructor(value: string) {
    super(`LOUD_ROUNDING_ERROR: "${value}" is not an exact USDC amount (max 6 decimals).`);
    this.name = "LoudRoundingError";
  }
}

const RE = /^-?\d+(\.\d{1,6})?$/;
export const isUsdc = (v: string): boolean => RE.test(v);

export function toMicro(v: string): bigint {
  if (!RE.test(v)) throw new LoudRoundingError(v);
  const neg = v.startsWith("-");
  const [i, f = ""] = v.replace("-", "").split(".");
  const n = BigInt(i) * 1_000_000n + BigInt(f.padEnd(6, "0"));
  return neg ? -n : n;
}

export function fromMicro(n: bigint): string {
  const neg = n < 0n;
  const a = neg ? -n : n;
  return `${neg ? "-" : ""}${a / 1_000_000n}.${(a % 1_000_000n).toString().padStart(6, "0")}`;
}

export const sumUsdc = (xs: string[]): string =>
  fromMicro(xs.reduce((a, x) => a + toMicro(x), 0n));

/**
 * Shows cents when exact; never hides a non-zero digit below the cent.
 * 1234.5 -> "$1,234.50", 0.000125 -> "$0.000125".
 */
export function formatUsdc(
  v: string,
  opts: { sign?: boolean; symbol?: boolean } = {}
): string {
  try {
    const micro = toMicro(v);
    const neg = micro < 0n;
    const a = neg ? -micro : micro;
    const whole = (a / 1_000_000n).toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ",");
    let frac = (a % 1_000_000n).toString().padStart(6, "0").replace(/0+$/, "");
    if (frac.length < 2) frac = frac.padEnd(2, "0");
    const s = `${opts.symbol ? "$" : ""}${whole}.${frac}`;
    return neg ? `-${s}` : opts.sign && a > 0n ? `+${s}` : s;
  } catch {
    return v;
  }
}

/** Display-only share percentage (0-100). Safe because it is never fed back into money math. */
export function pctOf(part: string, total: string): number {
  try {
    const t = toMicro(total);
    if (t <= 0n) return 0;
    return Number((toMicro(part) * 10000n) / t) / 100;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

/* ───────── Status vocabulary ───────── */
const LIAB: Record<T.LiabilityStatus, [Tone, string]> = {
  SCHEDULED: ["info", "Scheduled"],
  AWAITING_APPROVAL: ["gate", "Needs approval"],
  DISBURSED: ["liquid", "Paid, settling"],
  SETTLED: ["auto", "Settled"],
  CANCELLED: ["neutral", "Cancelled"],
  FROZEN: ["danger", "Frozen"],
  UNMATCHED_DISPUTED: ["danger", "Disputed: no match"],
};

const SPR: Record<T.SprStatus, [Tone, string]> = {
  PENDING: ["gate", "Waiting for you"],
  APPROVED: ["auto", "Approved"],
  REJECTED: ["danger", "Rejected"],
  CANCELLED_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS: ["neutral", "Cancelled with instructions"],
  EXECUTED: ["auto", "Executed"],
};

export const LiabilityStatusBadge = ({ status }: { status: T.LiabilityStatus }) => (
  <Badge tone={LIAB[status]?.[0] ?? "neutral"}>{LIAB[status]?.[1] ?? status}</Badge>
);

  <Badge tone={SPR[status]?.[0] ?? "neutral"}>{SPR[status]?.[1] ?? status}</Badge>
);

  TreasurySentinelAgent: { id: 101, label: "Sentinel", role: "Sweeps idle cash to yield, recalls it when needed", signs: true, writesLedger: false },
  LiabilityRadarAgent: { id: 102, label: "Radar", role: "Watches subscriptions and bills", signs: false, writesLedger: false },
  DisbursalRouterAgent: { id: 103, label: "Router", role: "Chooses which accounts pay a bill", signs: true, writesLedger: false },
  PolicyComplianceAgent: { id: 104, label: "Compliance", role: "Issues clearances, asks humans when out of policy", signs: false, writesLedger: false },
  LedgerWitnessAgent: { id: 105, label: "Witness", role: "Independently verifies and records every entry", signs: false, writesLedger: true },

export function AgentChip({ persona }: { persona: T.AgentPersona }) {
  const a = AGENTS[persona] ?? { id: 999, label: persona, role: "Agent", signs: false, writesLedger: false };
  return (
    <span
      title={`${a.role}. ${a.signs ? "Can sign transactions." : "Cannot sign."} ${
        a.writesLedger ? "Only agent that writes the ledger." : ""
      }`}
    >
      <Badge tone="neutral" hollow>
        {a.label} #{a.id}
      </Badge>
    </span>
  );
}

/* ───────── Balances: B_E = B_L + B_Y ───────── */
export function TripartiteEquation({
  liquid,
  invested,
  total,
  onSweepQuick,
}: {
  liquid: string;
  invested: string;
  total: string;
  onSweepQuick?: () => void;
}) {
  const sum = fromMicro(toMicro(liquid) + toMicro(invested));
  const ok = toMicro(sum) === toMicro(total);
  const liquidPct = pctOf(liquid, total);
  const investedPct = pctOf(invested, total);

  return (
    <div className="bz-eq">
      {!ok && (
        <Banner tone="danger" title="Balances do not reconcile">
          Available ({formatUsdc(total)}) differs from cash on hand ({formatUsdc(liquid)}) + invested in USYC ({formatUsdc(invested)}). Autonomous sweeps are halted until discrepancy is resolved.
        </Banner>
      )}
      <div className="bz-eq-row">
        <div className="bz-eq-term">
          <small>Total effective available (B_E)</small>
          <span className="v bz-fig bz-total">{formatUsdc(total, { symbol: true })}</span>
        </div>
        <span className="bz-eq-op" aria-hidden="true">
          =
        </span>
        <div className="bz-eq-term">
          <small>Liquid cash on hand (B_L)</small>
          <span className="v bz-fig" style={{ color: "var(--liquid)" }}>
            {formatUsdc(liquid, { symbol: true })}
          </span>
        </div>
        <span className="bz-eq-op" aria-hidden="true">
          +
        </span>
        <div className="bz-eq-term">
          <small>Earning yield in USYC (B_Y)</small>
          <span className="v bz-fig" style={{ color: "var(--invested)" }}>
            {formatUsdc(invested, { symbol: true })}
          </span>
        </div>
        {onSweepQuick && (
          <div style={{ marginLeft: "auto", alignSelf: "flex-end" }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onSweepQuick}>
              Simulate Sweep to Yield
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div
        className="bz-bar"
        role="img"
        aria-label={`${liquidPct.toFixed(1)}% cash, ${investedPct.toFixed(1)}% invested`}
      >
        <i style={{ width: `${liquidPct}%` }} />
        <i style={{ width: `${investedPct}%` }} />
      </div>

      <div className="bz-legend">
        <span>
          <i style={{ background: "var(--liquid)" }} />
          Cash ({liquidPct.toFixed(1)}%)
        </span>
        <span>
          <i style={{ background: "var(--invested)" }} />
          Invested USYC ({investedPct.toFixed(1)}%)
        </span>
        <span style={{ marginLeft: "auto", color: "var(--ink-3)" }}>
          Network: Arc L1 Testnet (5042002)
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  status === "SAFE_TO_INVEST" ? (
    <Badge tone="invested">Surplus ready to invest</Badge>
  ) : status === "RECALL_REQUIRED" ? (
    <Badge tone="gate">Needs cash recalled</Badge>
  ) : (
    <Badge tone="auto">Balanced</Badge>
  );

export function AccountCard({
  account: a,
  footer,

}: {
  account: T.AccountDistribution;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  onFund?: (account: T.AccountDistribution) => void;
}) {
  return (

          {onFund && (
            <Button variant="quiet" style={{ padding: "2px 8px", fontSize: "0.8rem" }} onClick={() => onFund(a)}>
              Fund
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 14 }}>
        <TripartiteEquation liquid={a.liquidUsdc} invested={a.investedUsyc} total={a.totalEffectiveUsdc} />
        <dl className="bz-kv">
          <dt>Due in 30 days</dt>
          <dd>{formatUsdc(a.committedLiabilities30dUsdc)}</dd>
          <dt>Held back as reserve</dt>
          <dd>{formatUsdc(a.protectedReserveUsdc)}</dd>
          <dt>Free to use</dt>
          <dd>
            <strong>{formatUsdc(a.freeCapitalUsdc)}</strong>
          </dd>
          <dt>Safe to invest</dt>
          <dd>{formatUsdc(a.safeToInvestUsdc)}</dd>
        </dl>
        {a.excludeFromWaterfall && (
          <div className="bz-shield">
            <strong>Payroll shield active.</strong>{" "}
            <span className="bz-muted">Other bills can never draw from this escrow account.</span>
          </div>
        )}
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <span className="bz-muted">{a.chain}</span>
          <CopyChip value={a.address} label="wallet address" />
          {!a.isActive && <Badge tone="danger">Inactive</Badge>}
        </div>
        {footer}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
}

/* ───────── Liabilities Table ───────── */
export function LiabilityTable({
  rows,
