}: {
  rows: T.Liability[];
  onOpen?: (l: T.Liability) => void;
}) {
  const cols: Column<T.Liability>[] = [
    {
      key: "t",
      header: "Bill & Vendor",
      render: l => (
        <>
          <button
            className="bz-btn"
            data-v="quiet"
            style={{ padding: 0, fontWeight: 600, color: "var(--ink)", textAlign: "left" }}
            onClick={() => onOpen?.(l)}
          >
            {l.title}
          </button>
          <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
            {l.vendorId.replace("vendor_", "").replace(/_/g, " ")} · {l.category}
          </div>
        </>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "d",
      header: "Due Date",
      render: l => (
        <span style={{ color: l.isOverdue ? "var(--danger)" : undefined, fontWeight: l.isOverdue ? 600 : 400 }}>
          {new Date(l.dueDate).toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
            month: "short",
            day: "numeric",
            year: "numeric",
          })}
          {l.isOverdue && " (overdue)"}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "r",
      header: "Payment Rail",
      render: l => (l.rail ? <RailBadge rail={l.rail} /> : <span className="bz-faint">Not set</span>),
    },
    {
      key: "s",
      header: "Status",
      render: l => <LiabilityStatusBadge status={l.status} />,
    },
    {
      key: "a",
      header: "Amount (USDC)",
      align: "r",
      render: l => <span className="bz-fig">{formatUsdc(l.amountUsdc)}</span>,
    },
  ];
  return <DataTable columns={cols} rows={rows} rowKey={l => l.liabilityId} />;
}

/* ───────── Human Gate: Standardized Permission Request (SPRS) ───────── */
export type SprDecision =
  | { decision: "APPROVE"; adminSignature?: string }
  | { decision: "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS"; instructions: string };

export function SprCard({
  request: r,
  onDecide,
}: {
  request: T.PermissionRequest;
  onDecide: (d: SprDecision) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"idle" | "cancel">("idle");
  const [memo, setMemo] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();
  const [approvedSig, setApprovedSig] = useState<string>();

  const run = async (d: SprDecision) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    try {
      if (d.decision === "APPROVE") {
        let signature = d.adminSignature;
        // Request cryptographic EIP-712 signature from user's connected Web3 wallet
        if (!signature && typeof window !== "undefined" && (window as any).ethereum) {
          try {
            const accounts = await (window as any).ethereum.request({ method: "eth_requestAccounts" });
            const from = accounts[0];
            const domain = {
              name: "BizArc Autonomous Treasury",
              version: "1",
              chainId: 5042,
              verifyingContract: "0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555",
            };
            const types = {
              EIP712Domain: [
                { name: "name", type: "string" },
                { name: "version", type: "string" },
                { name: "chainId", type: "uint256" },
                { name: "verifyingContract", type: "address" },
              ],
              PermissionDecision: [
                { name: "requestId", type: "string" },
                { name: "actionType", type: "string" },
                { name: "amountUsdc", type: "string" },
                { name: "decision", type: "string" },
              ],
            };
            const message = {
              requestId: r.requestId,
              actionType: r.action,
              amountUsdc: r.amountUsdc,
              decision: "APPROVE",
            };
            const msgParams = JSON.stringify({ types, domain, primaryType: "PermissionDecision", message });
            signature = await (window as any).ethereum.request({
              method: "eth_signTypedData_v4",
              params: [from, msgParams],
            });
          } catch (ethErr: any) {
            throw new Error(`Web3 wallet signing failed: ${ethErr.message}`);
          }
        }
        setApprovedSig(signature);
        await onDecide({ decision: "APPROVE", adminSignature: signature });
      } else {
        await onDecide(d);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Decision failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const t = r.targetRecipient;
  const pending = r.status === "PENDING";

  const cols: Column<T.SprAccountImpact>[] = [
    { key: "a", header: "Account", render: x => x.accountId.replace("acc_", "").replace(/_/g, " ") },
    { key: "u", header: "Recalled from USYC", align: "r", render: x => formatUsdc(x.usycRecallAmount) },
    { key: "b", header: "Cash Before", align: "r", render: x => formatUsdc(x.currentLiquidBalance) },
    { key: "p", header: "Cash After", align: "r", render: x => formatUsdc(x.postTxLiquidBalance) },
  ];

  return (
    <Panel title={SPR_ACTION_LABEL[r.action] || r.action} actions={<SprStatusBadge status={r.status} />}>
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
        <div>
          <span className="bz-fig bz-total" style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-4)" }}>
            {formatUsdc(r.amountUsdc, { symbol: true })}
          </span>
          <p className="bz-muted" style={{ margin: "8px 0 0", maxWidth: "68ch" }}>
            {r.reason}
          </p>
        </div>

        {t && (!t.isInVerifiedMaster || !t.payeeAddressMatchesHistory ? (
          <Banner tone="danger" title="Payee does not match verified records">
            {!t.isInVerifiedMaster
              ? `${t.vendorName} is not in the verified vendor directory.`
              : `The payout address for ${t.vendorName} differs from the last verified master address.`}{" "}
            Addresses printed on incoming invoices are never trusted. Approve only after out-of-band confirmation.
          </Banner>
        ) : (
          <Banner tone="auto" title="Payee verified">
            {t.vendorName} is in the verified vendor list and the payout destination matches history.
          </Banner>
        ))}

        {t && (
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", alignItems: "center" }}>
            <span className="bz-muted">Pays to:</span>
            <CopyChip value={t.payoutAddress} label="payout address" />
          </div>
        )}

        {r.affectedAccounts.length > 0 && (
          <div>
            <h4 style={{ margin: "0 0 8px", fontSize: "var(--fs-0)", color: "var(--ink-2)", textTransform: "uppercase" }}>
              Account Balance Impact
            </h4>
            <DataTable columns={cols} rows={r.affectedAccounts} rowKey={x => x.accountId} />
          </div>
        )}

        <dl className="bz-kv">
          <dt>Idempotency key</dt>
          <dd>
            <CopyChip value={r.associatedRecords.idempotencyKey} label="idempotency key" />
          </dd>
          {r.associatedRecords.purchaseOrderId && (
            <>
              <dt>Purchase order</dt>
              <dd>{r.associatedRecords.purchaseOrderId}</dd>
            </>
          )}
          {r.associatedRecords.goodsReceiptId && (
            <>
              <dt>Goods receipt</dt>
              <dd>{r.associatedRecords.goodsReceiptId}</dd>
            </>
          )}
          {r.associatedRecords.invoiceDocumentId && (
            <>
              <dt>Invoice document</dt>
              <dd>{r.associatedRecords.invoiceDocumentId}</dd>
            </>
          )}
        </dl>

        {approvedSig && (
          <Banner tone="auto" title="EIP-712 Signature Attached">
            <CopyChip value={approvedSig} label="admin signature" />
          </Banner>
        )}

        {r.adminInstructions && <Banner tone="info" title="Instructions for Agent">{r.adminInstructions}</Banner>}
        {err && <Banner tone="danger" title="Could not record decision">{err}</Banner>}

        {pending &&
          (mode === "idle" ? (
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap", paddingTop: 4 }}>
              <Button loading={busy} onClick={() => run({ decision: "APPROVE" })}>
                Approve and Sign (EIP-712)
              </Button>
              <Button variant="secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setMode("cancel")}>
                Cancel with instructions
              </Button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 10, background: "var(--sunken)", padding: 12, borderRadius: 6 }}>
              <Field
                label="What should happen instead?"
                hint="Required by Radar & Compliance. This memo is permanently written to the immutable audit log."
              >
                {(id, d) => (
                  <textarea
                    id={id}
                    aria-describedby={d}
                    className="bz-input"
                    rows={3}
                    placeholder="e.g. Reject payment until vendor accounts receivable confirms bank routing change."
                    value={memo}
                    onChange={e => setMemo(e.target.value)}
                  />
                )}
              </Field>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
                <Button
                  variant="danger"
                  loading={busy}
                  disabled={memo.trim().length < 4}
                  onClick={() => run({ decision: "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS", instructions: memo.trim() })}
                >
                  Confirm Cancellation
                </Button>
                <Button variant="quiet" onClick={() => setMode("idle")}>
                  Back
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
}

/* ───────── Routing & Waterfall ───────── */
export function WaterfallPlan({ route: q }: { route: T.RouteQualification }) {
  const rejected = q.routeType.startsWith("REJECTED");
  const cols: Column<T.WaterfallAllocation>[] = [
    {
      key: "a",
      header: "Account",
      render: x => (
        <>
          <strong>{x.accountName}</strong>
          <div className="bz-faint">{x.accountRole.replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase()}</div>
        </>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "s",
      header: "Share of bill",
      render: x => (
        <div style={{ minWidth: 120 }}>
          <Meter value={pctOf(x.allocatedAmountUsdc, q.totalRequestedUsdc)} />
          <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>
            {pctOf(x.allocatedAmountUsdc, q.totalRequestedUsdc).toFixed(1)}%
          </span>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "r",
      header: "Recalled from USYC",
      align: "r",
      render: x => (x.requiresRecall ? formatUsdc(x.recallAmountUsdc) : <span className="bz-faint">None</span>),
    },
    {
      key: "l",
      header: "Left free afterward",
      align: "r",
      render: x => formatUsdc(x.remainingFreeCapitalUsdc),
    },
    {
      key: "u",
      header: "Allocated (USDC)",
      align: "r",
      render: x => <strong className="bz-fig">{formatUsdc(x.allocatedAmountUsdc)}</strong>,
    },
  ];

  return (
    <Panel
      title={
        q.routeType === "MULTI_ACCOUNT_WATERFALL"
          ? "Split across accounts (Waterfall)"
          : q.routeType === "SINGLE_ACCOUNT"
          ? "Paid from single account"
          : "Unroutable payment"
      }
      actions={
        rejected ? (
          <Badge tone="danger">Not payable</Badge>
        ) : q.requiresHumanApproval ? (
          <Badge tone="gate" hollow>
            Needs human approval
          </Badge>
        ) : (
          <Badge tone="auto">Within policy</Badge>
        )
      }
    >
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
        <p className="bz-muted" style={{ margin: 0, maxWidth: "70ch" }}>
          {q.evaluationReason}
        </p>
        {rejected && q.shortfallUsdc && (
          <Banner tone="danger" title={`Shortfall: ${formatUsdc(q.shortfallUsdc, { symbol: true })}`}>
            No eligible account or combination can cover this bill without violating protected reserve floors.
          </Banner>
        )}
        {!rejected && <DataTable columns={cols} rows={q.allocations} rowKey={x => x.accountId} />}
        {!rejected && (
          <div className="bz-shield bz-muted">
            Corporate Payroll Escrow and Tax Escrow are excluded from cross-account draws unless paying payroll/tax directly.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
}

/* ───────── Ledger & Cryptographic Chain ───────── */
export function JournalChain({
  vouchers,
  onTamperSimulate,
  tamperedIndex,
}: {
  vouchers: T.JournalVoucher[];
  onTamperSimulate?: () => void;
  tamperedIndex?: number;
}) {
  const broken = vouchers.findIndex((v, i) => i > 0 && v.previousHash !== vouchers[i - 1].currentHash);

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <div>
          {broken >= 0 ? (
            <Banner tone="danger" title={`Chain broken at sequence #${vouchers[broken].sequenceId}`}>
              Hash mismatch detected! This voucher does not cryptographically link to #{vouchers[broken - 1].sequenceId}. Ledger Witness has flagged this block as tampered.
            </Banner>
          ) : (
            <Banner tone="auto" title="Cryptographic chain verified">
              Every entry links to the prior block. SHA-256 chain integrity intact from genesis.
            </Banner>
          )}
        </div>
        {onTamperSimulate && (
          <div style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onTamperSimulate}>
              {broken >= 0 ? "Restore Chain" : "Simulate Tamper"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <ol className="bz-chain" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
        {vouchers.map((v, i) => (
          <li key={v.sequenceId} style={{ background: tamperedIndex === i ? "var(--danger-bg)" : undefined, padding: "12px 8px" }}>
            <span className="bz-seq">#{v.sequenceId}</span>
            <div>
              <strong>{v.actionType.replace(/_/g, " ").toLowerCase()}</strong>{" "}
              <span className="bz-muted">
                {v.debitAccount} → {v.creditAccount}
              </span>
              <div className="bz-faint">
                Ref: {v.documentRef} · {new Date(v.timestamp).toLocaleString()}
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap", marginTop: 4 }}>
                <CopyChip value={v.currentHash} label="entry hash" />
                {v.txHash && <CopyChip value={v.txHash} label="transaction hash" />}
                {broken === i && <Badge tone="danger">Hash mismatch</Badge>}
              </div>
            </div>
            <span className="bz-fig" style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
              {formatUsdc(v.amountUsdc)}
            </span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ───────── Onboarding Stepper & Math Q&A ───────── */
export const WIZARD_STEPS = [
  "Company Profile",
  "Money Rules",
  "Declared Policies",
  "Treasury Accounts",
  "Recurring Bills",
  "Audit & Activation",
] as const;

export function WizardStepper({ current, completed }: { current: number; completed: number[] }) {
  return (
    <ol className="bz-steps" aria-label="Setup progress">
      {WIZARD_STEPS.map((s, i) => {
        const n = i + 1;
        const st = completed.includes(n) ? "done" : n === current ? "current" : "todo";
        return (
          <li key={s} data-s={st} aria-current={st === "current" ? "step" : undefined}>
            {n}. {s}
            {st === "done" && <span className="bz-faint"> (done)</span>}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}

export function QuestionField({
  q,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  q: T.MathQuestion;
  value: string | number | boolean | undefined;
  onChange: (v: string | number | boolean) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Field label={q.questionText} hint={q.helpText ?? q.formulaDescription}>
      {(id, d) => {
        if (q.responseType === "BOOLEAN") {
          return <Switch checked={value === true} onChange={onChange} label={value === true ? "Yes" : "No"} />;
        }
        if (q.responseType === "SELECT") {
          return (
            <Select
              id={id}
              value={String(value ?? "")}
              onChange={v => onChange(v)}
              options={[{ value: "", label: "Choose one" }, ...(q.options ?? []).map(o => ({ value: String(o.value), label: o.label }))]}
            />
          );
        }
        if (
          q.responseType === "NUMBER" &&
          /usdc|burn|floor|cap|invoice|bill|spend|budget|sweep/i.test(q.questionId + q.questionText)
        ) {
          return (
            <UsdcInput
              id={id}
              describedBy={d}
              value={String(value ?? "")}
              onChange={v => onChange(v)}
            />
          );
        }
        return (
          <TextInput
            id={id}
            aria-describedby={d}
            inputMode="decimal"
            value={String(value ?? "")}
            onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}
          />
        );
      }}
    </Field>
  );
}

export function RailPicker({
  rail,
  sub,
  onChange,
}: {
  rail: T.PaymentRail;
  sub?: T.FiatSubMethod;
  onChange: (r: T.PaymentRail, s?: T.FiatSubMethod) => void;
}) {
  const info: Record<T.PaymentRail, string> = {
    DISBURSAL_VAULT: "Onchain, from your accounts. Best for most vendors.",
    MODULAR_SESSION_KEY: "Agent pays inside a set limit, no approval each cycle.",
    ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION: "Gasless transfer from a signed authorization.",
    GATEWAY_X402: "Tiny pay-per-call charges for APIs and data.",
    FIAT_PAYOUT: "Wire, ACH, card, SEPA or SWIFT to a bank.",
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
      <fieldset className="bz-rails">
        <legend className="bz-hint" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
          How should this vendor be paid?
        </legend>
        {(Object.keys(RAIL_LABEL) as T.PaymentRail[]).map(r => (
          <label key={r} className="bz-rail">
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="rail"
              checked={rail === r}
              onChange={() => onChange(r, r === "FIAT_PAYOUT" ? sub ?? "FEDWIRE" : undefined)}
            />
            <strong>{RAIL_LABEL[r]}</strong>
            <span className="bz-muted" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
              {info[r]}
            </span>
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      {rail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" && (
        <Field label="Bank Transfer Method">
          {id => (
            <Select
              id={id}
              value={sub ?? "FEDWIRE"}
              onChange={s => onChange(rail, s)}
              options={(Object.keys(FIAT_LABEL) as T.FiatSubMethod[]).map(s => ({
                value: s,
                label: FIAT_LABEL[s],
              }))}
            />
          )}
        </Field>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ───────── Emergency Controls & Production Readiness ───────── */
export function CircuitBreaker({
  tripped,
  reason,
  onTrip,
  onReset,
}: {
  tripped: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  onTrip: (reason: string) => Promise<void>;
  onReset?: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [why, setWhy] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="bz-breaker" data-tripped={tripped}>
      <div>
        <strong>{tripped ? "Autonomous activity halted" : "Emergency Stop (Circuit Breaker)"}</strong>
        <div className="bz-muted" style={{ maxWidth: "60ch" }}>
          {tripped
            ? reason
            : "Instantly freezes all autonomous yield sweeps, waterfall payments, and session key withdrawals across all agents."}
        </div>
      </div>
      {!tripped ? (
        open ? (
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "flex-end", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
            <Field label="Reason (saved to immutable audit log)">
              {id => (
                <TextInput
                  id={id}
                  placeholder="e.g. Unusual spike in model API billing"
                  value={why}
                  onChange={e => setWhy(e.target.value)}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
            <Button
              variant="danger"
              loading={busy}
              disabled={why.trim().length < 4}
              onClick={async () => {
                setBusy(true);
                try {
                  await onTrip(why.trim());
                } finally {
                  setBusy(false);
                  setOpen(false);
                }
              }}
            >
              Halt Swarm
            </Button>
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
            Stop All Agents
          </Button>
        )
      ) : onReset ? (
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={onReset}>
          Resume Swarm Operations
        </Button>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ReadinessPillars({
  pillars,

}: {

          {overallScore.toFixed(1)} / 100

      }
    >
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 14 }}>
        {pillars.map(p => (
          <div key={p.pillar} style={{ display: "grid", gap: 4 }}>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", gap: 8 }}>
              <strong>{p.pillar}</strong>
              {p.isReady ? <Badge tone="auto">Ready</Badge> : <Badge tone="danger">Blocked</Badge>}
            </div>

            <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
              {p.details}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
}

import React, { Component, useState, type ErrorInfo, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { TreasuryProvider, useTreasury } from "./context/TreasuryContext";
import { Sidebar } from "./components/Sidebar";
import { TopHeader } from "./components/TopHeader";
import { OverviewView } from "./views/OverviewView";
import { ApprovalsView } from "./views/ApprovalsView";
import { AccountsView } from "./views/AccountsView";
import { LiabilitiesView } from "./views/LiabilitiesView";
import { LedgerView } from "./views/LedgerView";
import { AgentsView } from "./views/AgentsView";
import { OnboardingView } from "./views/OnboardingView";
import { TeamView } from "./views/TeamView";
import { IntegrationsView } from "./views/IntegrationsView";
import { ApiKeysView } from "./views/ApiKeysView";
import { VendorsView } from "./views/VendorsView";
import { LiabilityDetailModal } from "./components/LiabilityDetailModal";
import { AddLiabilityModal } from "./components/AddLiabilityModal";
import { SweepModal } from "./components/SweepModal";
import { FundModal } from "./components/FundModal";
import { TransferModal } from "./components/TransferModal";
import { AccountConfigModal } from "./components/AccountConfigModal";
import { AuthModal } from "./components/AuthModal";
import { TenantSwitcherModal } from "./components/TenantSwitcherModal";
import { AdHocDisbursalModal } from "./components/AdHocDisbursalModal";
import { DisputeModal } from "./components/DisputeModal";
import { TokenSwapModal } from "./components/TokenSwapModal";
import { Button, Banner } from "./primitives";
import type * as T from "./types";

interface ErrorBoundaryProps {
  children: ReactNode;
}

interface ErrorBoundaryState {
  hasError: boolean;
  error?: Error;
}

class ErrorBoundary extends Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {
  constructor(props: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo) {
    console.error("ErrorBoundary caught an error:", error, errorInfo);
  }

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return (
        <div style={{ padding: 32, maxWidth: 640, margin: "40px auto", fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)" }}>
          <Banner tone="danger" title="An error occurred rendering this view">
            <p style={{ margin: "8px 0" }}>{this.state.error?.message || "Unknown error occurred"}</p>
            <Button onClick={() => window.location.reload()}>Reload Page</Button>
          </Banner>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

function AppContent() {
  const { activeView, theme } = useTreasury();

  // Modals state
  const [inspectingLiability, setInspectingLiability] = useState<T.Liability | null>(null);
  const [showAddBillModal, setShowAddBillModal] = useState(false);
  const [showSweepModal, setShowSweepModal] = useState(false);
  const [showTransferModal, setShowTransferModal] = useState(false);
  const [fundingAccount, setFundingAccount] = useState<T.AccountDistribution | null>(null);
  const [configuringAccount, setConfiguringAccount] = useState<T.AccountDistribution | null | undefined>(undefined);
  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);
  const [showTenantSwitcherModal, setShowTenantSwitcherModal] = useState(false);
  const [showAdHocDisbursalModal, setShowAdHocDisbursalModal] = useState(false);
  const [disputingLiability, setDisputingLiability] = useState<T.Liability | null | undefined>(undefined);
  const [showTokenSwapModal, setShowTokenSwapModal] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="bz" data-theme={theme} style={{ display: "flex", minHeight: "100vh" }}>
      {/* 260px Sticky Navigation Sidebar */}
      <Sidebar
        onOpenTenantSwitcher={() => setShowTenantSwitcherModal(true)}
        onOpenAuthModal={() => setShowAuthModal(true)}
      />

      {/* Main Viewport */}
      <div style={{ flex: 1, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", minWidth: 0 }}>
        <TopHeader
          onOpenAddBill={() => setShowAddBillModal(true)}
          onOpenSweepModal={() => setShowSweepModal(true)}
          onOpenPayVendor={() => setShowAdHocDisbursalModal(true)}
          onOpenTokenSwap={() => setShowTokenSwapModal(true)}
          onOpenTenantSwitcher={() => setShowTenantSwitcherModal(true)}
        />

        <main style={{ flex: 1, padding: "24px 32px 64px", maxWidth: 1200, width: "100%", margin: "0 auto" }}>
          {activeView === "overview" && (
            <OverviewView
              onOpenLiability={l => setInspectingLiability(l)}
              onOpenSweepModal={() => setShowSweepModal(true)}
              onOpenFundModal={a => setFundingAccount(a)}
            />
          )}

          {activeView === "approvals" && <ApprovalsView />}

          {activeView === "accounts" && (
            <AccountsView
              onOpenFundModal={a => setFundingAccount(a)}
              onOpenTransferModal={() => setShowTransferModal(true)}
              onOpenCreateAccount={() => setConfiguringAccount(null)}
              onOpenConfigAccount={a => setConfiguringAccount(a)}
            />
          )}

          {activeView === "bills" && (
            <LiabilitiesView
              onOpenLiability={l => setInspectingLiability(l)}
              onOpenAddBill={() => setShowAddBillModal(true)}
              onOpenDispute={l => setDisputingLiability(l || null)}
            />
          )}

          {activeView === "vendors" && <VendorsView />}

          {activeView === "ledger" && <LedgerView />}

          {activeView === "agents" && <AgentsView />}

          {activeView === "integrations" && <IntegrationsView />}

          {activeView === "team" && <TeamView />}

          {activeView === "api-keys" && <ApiKeysView />}

          {activeView === "onboarding" && <OnboardingView />}
        </main>
      </div>

      {/* Interactive Modals */}
      {inspectingLiability && (
        <LiabilityDetailModal
          liability={inspectingLiability}
          onClose={() => setInspectingLiability(null)}
        />
      )}

      {showAddBillModal && (
        <AddLiabilityModal onClose={() => setShowAddBillModal(false)} />
      )}

      {showSweepModal && (
        <SweepModal onClose={() => setShowSweepModal(false)} />
      )}

      {fundingAccount && (
        <FundModal account={fundingAccount} onClose={() => setFundingAccount(null)} />
      )}

      {showTransferModal && (
        <TransferModal onClose={() => setShowTransferModal(false)} />
      )}

      {configuringAccount !== undefined && (
        <AccountConfigModal
          account={configuringAccount}
          onClose={() => setConfiguringAccount(undefined)}
          onSaved={() => setConfiguringAccount(undefined)}
        />
      )}

      {showAuthModal && (
        <AuthModal onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)} />
      )}

      {showTenantSwitcherModal && (
        <TenantSwitcherModal onClose={() => setShowTenantSwitcherModal(false)} />
      )}

      {showAdHocDisbursalModal && (
        <AdHocDisbursalModal onClose={() => setShowAdHocDisbursalModal(false)} />
      )}

      {disputingLiability !== undefined && (
        <DisputeModal
          liability={disputingLiability}
          onClose={() => setDisputingLiability(undefined)}
        />
      )}

      {showTokenSwapModal && (
        <TokenSwapModal onClose={() => setShowTokenSwapModal(false)} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function App() {
  return (
    <ErrorBoundary>
      <TreasuryProvider>
        <AppContent />
      </TreasuryProvider>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { AccountCard, SafeToInvestBadge } from "../domain";

export function AccountsView({
  onOpenFundModal,

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { SprCard, WaterfallPlan, type SprDecision } from "../domain";
import { Panel, Tabs, Banner, EmptyState } from "../primitives";
import { ROUTE_WATERFALL, ROUTE_REJECTED } from "../fixtures";
import { formatUsdc } from "../money";

export function ApprovalsView() {
  const { pendingSprs, decidedSprs, decideSpr } = useTreasury();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"pending" | "waterfall" | "history">("pending");
  const [waterfallMode, setWaterfallMode] = useState<"qualified" | "rejected">("qualified");

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 20 }}>
      <header>
        <h2 style={{ font: "600 var(--fs-4)/1.1 var(--font-figure)", margin: 0 }}>
          Standardized Permission Requests (SPRS)
        </h2>
        <p className="bz-muted" style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", maxWidth: "75ch" }}>
          Human approval gates for actions outside policy boundaries: invoice anomalies, payee substitutions, single-transaction threshold exemptions, and cross-account draws.
        </p>
      </header>

      <Tabs
        value={tab}
        onChange={setTab}
        tabs={[
          { id: "pending", label: "Pending Approvals", count: pendingSprs.length },
          { id: "waterfall", label: "Multi-Account Waterfall Simulation" },
          { id: "history", label: "Approval History", count: decidedSprs.length },
        ]}
      />

      {tab === "pending" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          {pendingSprs.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              title="All caught up"
              children="No pending approvals. Autonomous agents are operating within designated policy caps."
            />
          ) : (
            <>
              <Banner tone="info" title="Human-in-the-Loop Safeguards Active">
                Approvals require an EIP-712 administrative signature from an authorized CFO wallet. Cancellations require a mandatory rationale saved to the immutable audit trail.
              </Banner>
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
                {pendingSprs.map(spr => (
                  <SprCard
                    key={spr.requestId}
                    request={spr}
                    onDecide={async (d: SprDecision) => {
                      if (d.decision === "APPROVE") {
                        await decideSpr(spr.requestId, "APPROVE", undefined, d.adminSignature);
                      } else {
                        await decideSpr(spr.requestId, "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS", d.instructions);
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === "waterfall" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-0)", color: "var(--ink-2)", fontWeight: 600 }}>
              Test Scenario:
            </span>
            <button
              className="bz-btn"
              data-v={waterfallMode === "qualified" ? "primary" : "secondary"}
              style={{ padding: "4px 12px", fontSize: "0.85rem" }}
              onClick={() => setWaterfallMode("qualified")}
            >
              Multi-Account Waterfall (AWS $14,210.50)
            </button>
            <button
              className="bz-btn"
              data-v={waterfallMode === "rejected" ? "primary" : "secondary"}
              style={{ padding: "4px 12px", fontSize: "0.85rem" }}
              onClick={() => setWaterfallMode("rejected")}
            >
              Rejected Route (Shortfall $127,419.75)
            </button>
          </div>

          <WaterfallPlan
            route={waterfallMode === "qualified" ? ROUTE_WATERFALL : ROUTE_REJECTED}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === "history" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          {decidedSprs.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState title="No historical decisions yet" />
          ) : (
            decidedSprs.map(spr => (
              <SprCard
                key={spr.requestId}
                request={spr}
                onDecide={async () => {}}
              />
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Panel, Button, Badge, DataTable, CopyChip, Banner, Field, TextInput, Select } from "../primitives";
import { VENDORS } from "../fixtures";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function VendorsView() {
  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState<T.Vendor[]>(VENDORS);
  const [showAddVendor, setShowAddVendor] = useState(false);
  const [newVendorName, setNewVendorName] = useState("");
  const [newVendorCategory, setNewVendorCategory] = useState("INFRASTRUCTURE");
  const [newVendorAddress, setNewVendorAddress] = useState("");
  const [newVendorRail, setNewVendorRail] = useState<T.PaymentRail>("DISBURSAL_VAULT");
  const [bannerMsg, setBannerMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleAddVendor = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newVendorName) return;

    const newVendor: T.Vendor = {
      vendorId: `vendor_${newVendorName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "_")}`,
      name: newVendorName,
      verifiedPayoutAddress: newVendorAddress ? (newVendorAddress as T.Hex) : undefined,
      changeLock: true,
      verifiedByAdmin: "s.connor@halcyon.ai",
      lastVerifiedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      authorizedCategory: newVendorCategory,
      preferredRail: newVendorRail,
      banks: [],
      openLiabilities: 0,
      trailing30dUsdc: "0.000000",
    };

    setVendors([newVendor, ...vendors]);
    setBannerMsg(`Vendor '${newVendorName}' registered with immutable changeLock protection.`);
    setNewVendorName("");
    setNewVendorAddress("");
    setShowAddVendor(false);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 24 }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <div>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-3)", fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, color: "var(--ink)" }}>
            Vendor Master Registry & Verified Beneficiary Banking
          </h1>
          <p className="bz-faint" style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>
            Maintain verified payout addresses and banking credentials to prevent payee substitution attacks (Rule 3).
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setShowAddVendor(true)}>
          + Add Verified Vendor
        </Button>
      </div>

      {bannerMsg && (
        <Banner tone="auto">
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", width: "100%" }}>
            <span>{bannerMsg}</span>
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={() => setBannerMsg(null)} style={{ padding: "2px 8px" }}>
              Dismiss
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Banner>
      )}

      <Panel
        title="Verified Vendors Master"
        action={<Badge tone="neutral">{vendors.length} Vendors Registered</Badge>}
      >
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            {
              key: "name",
              header: "Vendor Entity",
              render: (v: T.Vendor) => (
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: "var(--ink)" }}>{v.name}</div>
                  <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }}>
                    {v.vendorId}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "category",
              header: "Category",
              render: (v: T.Vendor) => <Badge tone="neutral">{v.authorizedCategory}</Badge>,
            },
            {
              key: "preferredRail",
              header: "Settlement Rail",
              render: (v: T.Vendor) => (
                <Badge tone={v.preferredRail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" ? "gate" : "liquid"}>
                  {v.preferredRail}
                </Badge>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "payoutAddress",
              header: "Verified Payout Address / Bank",
              render: (v: T.Vendor) =>
                v.verifiedPayoutAddress ? (
                  <CopyChip text={v.verifiedPayoutAddress} label={v.verifiedPayoutAddress} />
                ) : (
                  <Badge tone="gate">Linked Traditional Bank</Badge>
                ),
            },
            {
              key: "changeLock",
              header: "Payee Substitution Lock",
              render: (v: T.Vendor) => (
                <Badge tone={v.changeLock ? "liquid" : "danger"}>
                  {v.changeLock ? "Change-Locked (Rule 3)" : "Unlocked"}
                </Badge>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "verifiedBy",
              header: "Verified By",
              render: (v: T.Vendor) => (
                <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
                  {v.verifiedByAdmin || "Auto-Onboarded"}
                </span>
              ),
            },
          ]}
          rows={vendors}
          rowKey={(v) => v.vendorId}
        />
      </Panel>

      {/* Add Vendor Modal */}
      {showAddVendor && (

            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 16px", fontSize: "var(--fs-2)" }}>Register Verified Vendor</h3>
            <form onSubmit={handleAddVendor} style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
              <Field label="Vendor Legal Name">
                {(id) => (
                  <TextInput
                    id={id}
                    value={newVendorName}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewVendorName(e.target.value)}

                )}
              </Field>

              <Field label="Preferred Settlement Rail">

                      { value: "DISBURSAL_VAULT", label: "DisbursalVault (Arc L1 Smart Contract)" },

                    ]}
                  />
                )}
              </Field>

              <Field label="Verified On-Chain Payout Address (Optional if Fiat)">
                {(id) => (
                  <TextInput

                  />

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { LiabilityTable, RailBadge, LiabilityStatusBadge, RAIL_LABEL } from "../domain";
import { Panel, Tabs, Button, TextInput, Select, Banner, EmptyState, Badge, CopyChip, DataTable, type Column } from "../primitives";
import { formatUsdc } from "../money";
import { VENDORS } from "../fixtures";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function LiabilitiesView({
  onOpenLiability,
  onOpenAddBill,
  onOpenDispute,
}: {
  onOpenLiability: (liability: T.Liability) => void;
  onOpenAddBill: () => void;
  onOpenDispute?: (liability?: T.Liability) => void;
}) {
  const { liabilities, payLiability, updateLiabilityStatus } = useTreasury();
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"bills" | "rails" | "vendors">("bills");

  const filteredBills = liabilities.filter(l => {
    const matchesStatus = filterStatus === "ALL" || l.status === filterStatus;
    const matchesSearch =
      searchQuery === "" ||
      l.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      l.vendorId.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      l.category.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchesStatus && matchesSearch;
  });

  const overdueCount = liabilities.filter(l => l.isOverdue && l.status !== "SETTLED").length;

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 24 }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "baseline", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 12 }}>
        <div>
          <h2 style={{ font: "600 var(--fs-4)/1.1 var(--font-figure)", margin: 0 }}>
            Accounts Payable & Payment Rails
          </h2>
          <p className="bz-muted" style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", maxWidth: "75ch" }}>
            Scheduled liabilities, subscriptions, and contractor retainers monitored continuously by the Liability Radar Agent (#102).
          </p>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>
          {onOpenDispute && (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => onOpenDispute()}>
              File Dispute
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={onOpenAddBill}>
            + Add New Bill
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onChange={setActiveTab}
        tabs={[
          { id: "bills", label: "Liabilities Ledger", count: liabilities.length },
          { id: "rails", label: "Disbursal Rails Architecture" },
          { id: "vendors", label: "Vendor Master (Rule 3)", count: VENDORS.length },
        ]}
      />

      {activeTab === "bills" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          {overdueCount > 0 && (
            <Banner tone="danger" title={`${overdueCount} Overdue Liability Flagged`}>
              Datadog Pro usage true-up is currently FROZEN due to an unverified invoice payout address. Radar Agent has halted automated disbursal.
            </Banner>
          )}

          {/* Filter Bar */}
          <div
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              gap: 12,
              flexWrap: "wrap",
              alignItems: "center",
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              padding: 12,
              backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
              border: "1px solid var(--rule)",
              borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center", flex: 1, minWidth: 260 }}>
              <TextInput
                placeholder="Search by vendor, title, or category…"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, alignItems: "center" }}>
              <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-0)", fontWeight: 600 }}>
                Status:
              </span>
              <Select
                value={filterStatus}
                onChange={setFilterStatus}
                options={[
                  { value: "ALL", label: "All Statuses" },
                  { value: "SCHEDULED", label: "Scheduled" },
                  { value: "AWAITING_APPROVAL", label: "Awaiting Approval" },
                  { value: "FROZEN", label: "Frozen" },
                  { value: "DISBURSED", label: "Disbursed" },
                  { value: "SETTLED", label: "Settled" },
                  { value: "CANCELLED", label: "Cancelled" },
                ]}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <Panel>
            <LiabilityTable rows={filteredBills} onOpen={onOpenLiability} />
          </Panel>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeTab === "rails" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          <Panel title="Configured Autonomous Payment Rails">

                    <strong>Disbursal Vault</strong>

                  ),
                },
              ]}
              rows={VENDORS}
              rowKey={v => v.vendorId}
            />
          </Panel>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  AGENTS,

export function OverviewView({
  onOpenLiability,
  onOpenSweepModal,
  onOpenFundModal,
}: {
  onOpenLiability: (liability: any) => void;
  onOpenSweepModal: () => void;
  onOpenFundModal: (account: any) => void;
}) {
  const {
    accounts,
    totalLiquid,
    totalInvested,
    totalEffective,
    safeToInvestTotal,
    liabilities,
    pendingSprs,
    setActiveView,
    circuitBreakerTripped,
    circuitBreakerReason,
  } = useTreasury();

  const nextLiabilities = liabilities
    .filter(l => ["SCHEDULED", "AWAITING_APPROVAL", "FROZEN"].includes(l.status))
    .slice(0, 5);

  const pendingGatesCount = pendingSprs.length;

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 24 }}>
      {/* Emergency Stop Banner if Tripped */}
      {circuitBreakerTripped && (
        <Banner tone="danger" title="EMERGENCY CIRCUIT BREAKER ACTIVATED">

          <TripartiteEquation
            liquid={totalLiquid}
            invested={totalInvested}
            total={totalEffective}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Panel, Button, Badge, DataTable, CopyChip, Banner, Field, TextInput, Select } from "../primitives";
import { MEMBERS, APPROVERS, DEVICE_SESSIONS } from "../fixtures";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function TeamView() {
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<T.Member[]>(MEMBERS);
  const [approvers] = useState<T.ApproverWallet[]>(APPROVERS);
  const [sessions] = useState<T.DeviceSession[]>(DEVICE_SESSIONS);
  const [showInviteModal, setShowInviteModal] = useState(false);
  const [inviteEmail, setInviteEmail] = useState("");
  const [inviteRole, setInviteRole] = useState<T.Member["role"]>("OPERATOR");
  const [inviteName, setInviteName] = useState("");
  const [bannerMsg, setBannerMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleInvite = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!inviteEmail || !inviteName) return;

    const newMember: T.Member = {
      userId: `usr_${Date.now()}`,
      name: inviteName,
      email: inviteEmail,
      role: inviteRole,
      status: "INVITED",
      emailVerified: false,
      mfaEnabled: false,
      lastActiveAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    setMembers([newMember, ...members]);
    setBannerMsg(`Invitation successfully dispatched to ${inviteEmail} as role ${inviteRole}.`);
    setInviteEmail("");
    setInviteName("");
    setShowInviteModal(false);
  };

  const getRoleBadgeTone = (role: string) => {
    switch (role) {
      case "CFO":
      case "ADMIN":
        return "danger";
      case "APPROVER":
        return "gate";
      case "OPERATOR":
        return "liquid";
      default:
        return "neutral";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 24 }}>
      {/* Header bar */}
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <div>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-3)", fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, color: "var(--ink)" }}>
            Team Management & Role-Based Access Control
          </h1>
          <p className="bz-faint" style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>
            Manage organization members, EIP-712 approver signing keys, multi-sig quorum, and active device sessions.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setShowInviteModal(true)}>
          + Invite Member
        </Button>
      </div>

      {bannerMsg && (
        <Banner tone="auto">
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", width: "100%" }}>
            <span>{bannerMsg}</span>
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={() => setBannerMsg(null)} style={{ padding: "2px 8px" }}>
              Dismiss
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Banner>
      )}

      {/* Members Panel */}
      <Panel
        title="Organization Members"
        action={<Badge tone="neutral">{members.length} Members</Badge>}
      >
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            {
              key: "name",
              header: "Member",
              render: (m: T.Member) => (
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: "var(--ink)" }}>{m.name}</div>
                  <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>{m.email}</div>
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "role",
              header: "Role (RBAC)",
              render: (m: T.Member) => <Badge tone={getRoleBadgeTone(m.role)}>{m.role}</Badge>,
            },
            {
              key: "status",
              header: "Status",
              render: (m: T.Member) => (
                <Badge tone={m.status === "ACTIVE" ? "liquid" : m.status === "INVITED" ? "gate" : "danger"}>
                  {m.status}
                </Badge>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "security",
              header: "Security Verification",
              render: (m: T.Member) => (
                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>
                  <Badge tone={m.emailVerified ? "liquid" : "neutral"}>
                    {m.emailVerified ? "Email Verified" : "Unverified"}
                  </Badge>
                  <Badge tone={m.mfaEnabled ? "liquid" : "danger"}>
                    {m.mfaEnabled ? "MFA Active" : "No MFA"}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "wallet",
              header: "Approver Signing Key",
              render: (m: T.Member) =>
                m.approverWallet ? (
                  <CopyChip text={m.approverWallet} label={m.approverWallet.slice(0, 10) + "..."} />
                ) : (
                  <span className="bz-faint">—</span>
                ),
            },
            {
              key: "lastActive",
              header: "Last Active",
              render: (m: T.Member) => (
                <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
                  {m.lastActiveAt ? new Date(m.lastActiveAt).toLocaleDateString() : "Never"}
                </span>
              ),
            },
          ]}
          rows={members}
          rowKey={(m) => m.userId}
        />
      </Panel>

      {/* Approver Wallets & Multi-Sig Quorum */}
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 24 }}>
        <Panel
          title="Authorized EIP-712 Signers"
          action={<Badge tone="gate">{approvers.length} Keys Configured</Badge>}
        >
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 12 }}>
            <p className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", margin: 0 }}>
              Cryptographic keys authorized to co-sign high-value Standardized Permission Requests (SPRS).
            </p>
            {approvers.map((app) => (
              <div
                key={app.address}
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  padding: "10px 12px",
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: "1px solid var(--rule)",
                  backgroundColor: "var(--sunken)",
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>{app.label}</div>
                  <CopyChip text={app.address} label={app.address} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
                  <Badge tone="gate">Weight: {app.weight}</Badge>
                  <Badge tone={app.status === "ACTIVE" ? "auto" : "gate"}>{app.status}</Badge>
                  <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", marginTop: 4 }}>
                    Added {new Date(app.addedAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Panel>

        {/* Active Device Sessions */}
        <Panel
          title="Active Device Sessions"
          action={<Badge tone="neutral">{sessions.length} Active</Badge>}
        >
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 10 }}>
            {sessions.map((s) => (
              <div
                key={s.sessionId}
                style={{
                  padding: "10px 12px",
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: "1px solid var(--rule)",
                  display: "flex",
                  justifyContent: "space-between",
                  alignItems: "center",
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
                    {s.browser} on {s.os}
                    {s.device}
                  </div>
                  <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem" }}>
                    IP: {s.ipAddress} · {s.location}
                    IP: {s.ip} · {s.location}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ textAlign: "right" }}>
                  {s.isCurrent ? <Badge tone="liquid">Current Device</Badge> : <Badge tone="neutral">Active</Badge>}
                  {s.current ? <Badge tone="invested">Current Device</Badge> : <Badge tone="neutral">Active</Badge>}
                  <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {new Date(s.lastSeenAt).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </Panel>
      </div>

      {/* Invite Member Modal */}
      {showInviteModal && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            inset: 0,
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            zIndex: 100,
          }}
          onClick={() => setShowInviteModal(false)}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
              borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
              padding: 24,
              maxWidth: 480,
              width: "100%",
              boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 16px", fontSize: "var(--fs-2)" }}>Invite New Team Member</h3>
            <form onSubmit={handleInvite} style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
              <Field label="Full Name">
                {(id) => (
                  <TextInput
                    id={id}
                    value={inviteName}
                    onChange={(e) => setInviteName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Sarah Connor"
                    required
                  />
                )}
              </Field>

              <Field label="Corporate Email Address">
                {(id) => (
                  <TextInput
                    id={id}
                    type="email"
                    value={inviteEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => setInviteEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="s.connor@halcyon.ai"
                    required
                  />
                )}
              </Field>

              <Field label="Organization Role (RBAC)">
                {(id) => (
                  <Select
                    id={id}
                    value={inviteRole}
                    onChange={(v) => setInviteRole(v as T.Member["role"])}
                    options={[

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Panel, Button, Badge, DataTable, CopyChip, Banner, Field, TextInput } from "../primitives";
import { API_KEYS } from "../fixtures";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function ApiKeysView() {
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<T.ApiKeyRecord[]>(API_KEYS);
  const [showGenerateModal, setShowGenerateModal] = useState(false);
  const [newKeyLabel, setNewKeyLabel] = useState("");
  const [selectedScopes, setSelectedScopes] = useState<string[]>([
    "treasury:read",
    "disbursals:execute",
  ]);
  const [newlyCreatedSecret, setNewlyCreatedSecret] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const availableScopes = [
    { id: "treasury:read", label: "Read Treasury Balances & Safe-to-Invest" },
    { id: "disbursals:execute", label: "Execute Autonomous Disbursals" },
    { id: "sprs:decide", label: "Authorize / Co-Sign Human SPRS" },
    { id: "policies:mutate", label: "Modify Corporate Movement Policies" },
    { id: "integrations:manage", label: "Manage ERP & MCP App Tokens" },
  ];

  const handleToggleScope = (scopeId: string) => {
    setSelectedScopes((prev) =>
      prev.includes(scopeId) ? prev.filter((s) => s !== scopeId) : [...prev, scopeId]
    );
  };

  const handleGenerate = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newKeyLabel) return;

    const secretKey = `bz_live_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2)}${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2)}${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2)}`;
    const prefix = `${secretKey.slice(0, 12)}...`;

    const newKey: T.ApiKeyRecord = {
      keyId: `key_${Date.now()}`,
      label: newKeyLabel,
      prefix,
      scopes: selectedScopes,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      createdBy: "s.connor@halcyon.ai",
      status: "ACTIVE",
    };

    setKeys([newKey, ...keys]);
    setNewlyCreatedSecret(secretKey);
    setNewKeyLabel("");
  };

  const handleRevoke = (keyId: string) => {
    setKeys((prev) =>
      prev.map((k) => (k.keyId === keyId ? { ...k, status: "REVOKED" } : k))
    );
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 24 }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
        <div>
          <h1 style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-3)", fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, color: "var(--ink)" }}>
            Developer API Keys & Machine-to-Machine Credentials
          </h1>
          <p className="bz-faint" style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>
            Provision scoped API keys for automated CI/CD runners, internal billing pipelines, and autonomous agent sidecars.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => { setShowGenerateModal(true); setNewlyCreatedSecret(null); }}>
          + Generate New API Key
        </Button>
      </div>

      {newlyCreatedSecret && (
        <Banner tone="gate" title="API Key Generated Successfully">
          <p style={{ margin: "4px 0 8px", fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
            Make sure to copy your secret API key now. You will not be able to see it again!
          </p>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 8 }}>
            <CopyChip text={newlyCreatedSecret} label={newlyCreatedSecret} />
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={() => setNewlyCreatedSecret(null)} style={{ padding: "4px 8px" }}>
              Dismiss
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Banner>
      )}

      <Panel
        title="Active API Keys"
        action={<Badge tone="neutral">{keys.filter((k) => k.status === "ACTIVE").length} Active</Badge>}
      >
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            {
              key: "label",
              header: "Key Label",
              render: (k: T.ApiKeyRecord) => (
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: "var(--ink)" }}>{k.label}</div>
                  <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.75rem", fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }}>
                    {k.keyId}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "prefix",
              header: "Token Prefix",
              render: (k: T.ApiKeyRecord) => (
                <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)", fontSize: "0.85rem", color: "var(--ink-2)" }}>
                  {k.prefix}
                </span>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "scopes",
              header: "Authorized Scopes",
              render: (k: T.ApiKeyRecord) => (
                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                  {k.scopes.map((s) => (
                    <Badge key={s} tone="gate">
                      {s}
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "status",
              header: "Status",
              render: (k: T.ApiKeyRecord) => (
                <Badge tone={k.status === "ACTIVE" ? "liquid" : "danger"}>{k.status}</Badge>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "lastUsed",
              header: "Last Used",
              render: (k: T.ApiKeyRecord) => (
                <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
                  {k.lastUsedAt ? new Date(k.lastUsedAt).toLocaleDateString() : "Never used"}
                </span>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "actions",
              header: "Action",
              render: (k: T.ApiKeyRecord) =>
                k.status === "ACTIVE" ? (
                  <Button
                    variant="quiet"
                    onClick={() => handleRevoke(k.keyId)}
                    style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", color: "var(--danger)" }}
                  >
                    Revoke Key
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <span className="bz-faint">—</span>
                ),
            },
          ]}
          rows={keys}
          rowKey={(k) => k.keyId}
        />
      </Panel>

      {/* Generate Key Modal */}
      {showGenerateModal && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            inset: 0,
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            zIndex: 100,
          }}
          onClick={() => setShowGenerateModal(false)}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
              borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
              padding: 24,
              maxWidth: 480,
              width: "100%",
              boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 16px", fontSize: "var(--fs-2)" }}>Generate Scoped API Key</h3>
            <form onSubmit={(e) => { handleGenerate(e); setShowGenerateModal(false); }} style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
              <Field label="Key Description / Service Name">
                {(id) => (
                  <TextInput
                    id={id}
                    value={newKeyLabel}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewKeyLabel(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. AWS Lambda Settlement Worker"
                    required
                  />
                )}
              </Field>

              <div>
                <label style={{ display: "block", fontSize: "0.85rem", fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                  Granted Capabilities & Scopes
                </label>
                <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 8 }}>
                  {availableScopes.map((scope) => (
                    <label
                      key={scope.id}
                      style={{
                        display: "flex",
                        alignItems: "center",
                        gap: 8,
                        fontSize: "0.85rem",
                        cursor: "pointer",
                      }}
                    >
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={selectedScopes.includes(scope.id)}
                        onChange={() => handleToggleScope(scope.id)}
                      />
                      <span>
                        <strong>{scope.id}</strong> — {scope.label}
                      </span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", gap: 12, marginTop: 8 }}>
                <Button variant="quiet" onClick={() => setShowGenerateModal(false)}>
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button variant="primary" type="submit">
                  Generate Key
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

  const [connectors, setConnectors] = useState<ConnectorItem[]>(DEFAULT_CONNECTORS);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<"ALL" | "MCP" | "ERP" | "SAAS">("ALL");
  const [connectingProvider, setConnectingProvider] = useState<ConnectorItem | null>(null);
  const [apiKeyInput, setApiKeyInput] = useState("");
  const [syncFeedback, setSyncFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch("/api/integrations/connectors")
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((res) => {
        if (res.success && Array.isArray(res.data) && res.data.length > 0) {
          setConnectors(res.data);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const handleConnectSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!connectingProvider || !apiKeyInput) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const resp = await fetch("/api/integrations/credentials", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          provider: connectingProvider.provider,
          accessToken: apiKeyInput,
        }),
      });
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setConnectors((prev) =>
          prev.map((c) =>
            c.provider === connectingProvider.provider
              ? { ...c, status: "CONNECTED", connectedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
              : c
          )
        );
        setSyncFeedback(`Successfully authorized ${connectingProvider.name}.`);
        setConnectingProvider(null);
        setApiKeyInput("");
      } else {
        setSyncFeedback(`Failed to connect: ${data.error || "Unknown error"}`);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setSyncFeedback(`Network error connecting provider: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDisconnect = async (provider: string) => {
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/integrations/connectors/${provider}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      setConnectors((prev) =>
        prev.map((c) => (c.provider === provider ? { ...c, status: "DISCONNECTED", connectedAt: undefined } : c))
      );
      setSyncFeedback(`Disconnected ${provider}.`);
    } catch {}
  };

  const filteredConnectors =
    selectedCategory === "ALL" ? connectors : connectors.filter((c) => c.category === selectedCategory);

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 24 }}>
      <div>
        <h1 style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-3)", fontWeight: 700, margin: 0, color: "var(--ink)" }}>
          Connected Apps, MCP Servers & ERP Connectors
        </h1>
        <p className="bz-faint" style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>
          Ingest contracts, invoices, and billing schedules via Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and sync vouchers to corporate ERPs.
        </p>
      </div>

      {syncFeedback && (
        <Banner tone="auto">
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", width: "100%" }}>
            <span>{syncFeedback}</span>
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={() => setSyncFeedback(null)} style={{ padding: "2px 8px" }}>
              Dismiss
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Banner>
      )}

      {/* Category Tabs */}
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
        {(["ALL", "MCP", "ERP", "SAAS"] as const).map((cat) => (
          <Button
            key={cat}
            variant={selectedCategory === cat ? "primary" : "secondary"}
            onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(cat)}
            style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", padding: "6px 14px" }}
          >
            {cat === "ALL"
              ? "All Connectors"
              : cat === "MCP"
              ? "Model Context Protocol (MCP)"
              : cat === "ERP"
              ? "Enterprise ERPs"
              : "Top-10 SaaS Billing"}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Connectors Grid */}
      <Panel
        title={`Registered Integrations (${filteredConnectors.length})`}
        action={
          <Badge tone="liquid">
            {filteredConnectors.filter((c) => c.status === "CONNECTED").length} Connected
          </Badge>
        }
      >
        <DataTable
          columns={[
            {
              key: "name",
              header: "Connector / Protocol",
              render: (c: ConnectorItem) => (
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: "var(--ink)" }}>{c.name}</div>
                  <div className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }}>
                    {c.provider}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "category",
              header: "Category",
              render: (c: ConnectorItem) => (
                <Badge tone={c.category === "MCP" ? "gate" : c.category === "ERP" ? "liquid" : "neutral"}>
                  {c.category}
                </Badge>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "status",
              header: "Connection State",
              render: (c: ConnectorItem) => (
                <Badge tone={c.status === "CONNECTED" ? "liquid" : "neutral"}>
                  {c.status === "CONNECTED" ? "CONNECTED" : "DISCONNECTED"}
                </Badge>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "connectedAt",
              header: "Last Synchronized",
              render: (c: ConnectorItem) => (
                <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
                  {c.connectedAt ? new Date(c.connectedAt).toLocaleDateString() : "Never configured"}
                </span>
              ),
            },
            {
              key: "actions",
              header: "Action",
              render: (c: ConnectorItem) => (
                <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
                  {c.status === "CONNECTED" ? (
                    <Button
                      variant="quiet"
                      onClick={() => handleDisconnect(c.provider)}
                      style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", padding: "4px 8px" }}
                    >
                      Disconnect
                    </Button>
                  ) : (
                    <Button
                      variant="secondary"
                      onClick={() => setConnectingProvider(c)}
                      style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", padding: "4px 8px" }}
                    >
                      Connect App
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              ),
            },
          ]}
          rows={filteredConnectors}
          rowKey={(c) => c.provider}
        />
      </Panel>

      {/* Connect Modal */}
      {connectingProvider && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: "fixed",
            inset: 0,
            backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            zIndex: 100,
          }}
          onClick={() => setConnectingProvider(null)}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
              borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
              padding: 24,
              maxWidth: 480,
              width: "100%",
              boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <h3 style={{ margin: "0 0 12px", fontSize: "var(--fs-2)" }}>Connect {connectingProvider.name}</h3>
            <p className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", marginBottom: 16 }}>
              Provide the API secret, OAuth access token, or service account credential to enable autonomous invoice extraction and billing reconciliation.
            </p>

            <form onSubmit={handleConnectSubmit} style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
              <Field label="API Key / OAuth Access Token / Session Secret">
                {(id) => (
                  <TextInput
                    id={id}
                    type="password"
                    value={apiKeyInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setApiKeyInput(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. sk_live_... / Bearer token / App Password"
                    required
                  />
                )}
              </Field>

              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", gap: 12, marginTop: 8 }}>
                <Button variant="quiet" onClick={() => setConnectingProvider(null)} disabled={isSubmitting}>
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button variant="primary" type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>
                  {isSubmitting ? "Verifying..." : "Authorize Connector"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


------------------------------------------------------------
