import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { JournalChain, CircuitBreaker, ReadinessPillars, ActorTag, AgentChip } from "../domain";
import { Panel, Tabs, DataTable, CopyChip, type Column } from "../primitives";
import { READINESS_PILLARS, READINESS, AUDIT_SUMMARY } from "../fixtures";
import { formatUsdc } from "../money";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function LedgerView() {
  const {
    journal,
    isChainTampered,
    toggleChainTamper,
    circuitBreakerTripped,
    circuitBreakerReason,
    tripCircuitBreaker,
    resetCircuitBreaker,
    auditEvents,
  } = useTreasury();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"journal" | "audit" | "readiness">("journal");

  const auditColumns: Column<T.AuditEvent>[] = [
    {
      key: "a",
      header: "Action & Reason",
      render: e => (
        <div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center" }}>
            <strong>{e.actionType.replace(/_/g, " ")}</strong>
            <ActorTag autonomous={e.isAutonomous} />
            {e.actorAgent && <AgentChip persona={e.actorAgent} />}
          </div>
          <p style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", fontSize: "0.85rem", color: "var(--ink-2)" }}>{e.reason}</p>
        </div>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "t",
      header: "Timestamp",
      render: e => (
        <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
          {new Date(e.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      key: "c",
      header: "Cost Center",
      render: e => <span className="bz-muted">{e.accountId.replace("acc_", "")}</span>,
    },
    {
      key: "v",
      header: "Amount (USDC)",
      align: "r",
      render: e => (
        <span className="bz-fig" style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>
          {formatUsdc(e.amountUsdc)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 24 }}>
      <header>
        <h2 style={{ font: "600 var(--fs-4)/1.1 var(--font-figure)", margin: 0 }}>
          Master Journal & Cryptographic Audit
        </h2>
        <p className="bz-muted" style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", maxWidth: "75ch" }}>
          Every cash sweep, yield recall, and disbursement is witnessed and appended by the Ledger Witness Agent (#105) into an immutable SHA-256 hash chain.
        </p>
      </header>

      {/* Emergency Control Breaker */}
      <CircuitBreaker
        tripped={circuitBreakerTripped}
        reason={circuitBreakerReason}
        onTrip={tripCircuitBreaker}
        onReset={resetCircuitBreaker}
      />

      <Tabs
        value={activeTab}
        onChange={setActiveTab}
        tabs={[
          { id: "journal", label: "Cryptographic Journal Chain", count: journal.length },
          { id: "audit", label: "Immutable Audit Trail", count: auditEvents.length },
          { id: "readiness", label: "Production Readiness Verification" },
        ]}
      />

      {activeTab === "journal" && (
        <Panel title="Journal Vouchers & Block Hashes">
          <JournalChain
            vouchers={journal}
            onTamperSimulate={toggleChainTamper}
            tamperedIndex={isChainTampered ? 5 : undefined}
          />
        </Panel>
      )}

      {activeTab === "audit" && (
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              gap: 16,
              padding: "12px 16px",
              backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
              border: "1px solid var(--rule)",
              borderRadius: "var(--r-sm)",
              fontSize: "0.85rem",
              flexWrap: "wrap",
            }}
          >
            <div>
              <span className="bz-faint">Verified Logs: </span>
              <strong>{AUDIT_SUMMARY.totalEventsLogged || auditEvents.length}</strong>
              <span className="bz-faint">Total Vouchers: </span>
              <strong>{AUDIT_SUMMARY.totalVouchers}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="bz-faint">Autonomous Actions: </span>
              <strong>{AUDIT_SUMMARY.autonomousActions}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="bz-faint">Human Approvals: </span>
              <strong>{AUDIT_SUMMARY.humanApprovals}</strong>
              <strong>{AUDIT_SUMMARY.humanActions}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="bz-faint">Head Sequence: </span>
              <strong>#{AUDIT_SUMMARY.headSequence}</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="bz-faint">SHA-256 Anchor: </span>
              <span className="bz-mono">{AUDIT_SUMMARY.merkleRootAnchor?.slice(0, 16)}...</span>
              <span className="bz-mono">{AUDIT_SUMMARY.headHash?.slice(0, 16)}...</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Panel title="Autonomous & Human Audit Stream">
            <DataTable columns={auditColumns} rows={auditEvents} rowKey={e => e.logId || e.createdAt} />
          </Panel>
        </div>
      )}

      {activeTab === "readiness" && (
        <ReadinessPillars pillars={READINESS.pillars || READINESS_PILLARS} overallScore={READINESS.overallScore} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

File: AdHocDisbursalModal.tsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { Button, Banner, Field, Select, UsdcInput, TextInput } from "../primitives";
import { formatUsdc, isUsdc } from "../money";
import { VENDORS } from "../fixtures";
import { treasuryApi } from "../api/treasuryApi";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function AdHocDisbursalModal({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { accounts, refreshData, appendJournalVoucher, circuitBreakerTripped } = useTreasury();

  const [vendorId, setVendorId] = useState<string>(VENDORS[0]?.vendorId || "vendor_anthropic");
  const [sourceAccountId, setSourceAccountId] = useState<string>(
    accounts[0]?.accountId || "acc_treasury"
  );
  const [rail, setRail] = useState<T.DisbursalRail>("DISBURSAL_VAULT");
  const [rail, setRail] = useState<T.PaymentRail>("DISBURSAL_VAULT");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string>("Cloud & AI");
  const [amountUsdc, setAmountUsdc] = useState<string>("2500.000000");
  const [invoiceId, setInvoiceId] = useState<string>(`INV-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`);
  const [poReference, setPoReference] = useState<string>("PO-2026-ADHOC");
  const [rationale, setRationale] = useState<string>("");

  const [routingNumber, setRoutingNumber] = useState<string>("021000021");
  const [accountNumber, setAccountNumber] = useState<string>("123456789012");
  const [fiatMethod, setFiatMethod] = useState<"WIRE" | "ACH">("ACH");

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string>();

  const selectedVendor = VENDORS.find((v) => v.vendorId === vendorId) || VENDORS[0];
  const sourceAccount = accounts.find((a) => a.accountId === sourceAccountId) || accounts[0];

  const sourceLiquid = parseFloat(sourceAccount?.liquidUsdc || "0");
  const sourceFloor = parseFloat(sourceAccount?.protectedReserveUsdc || "0");
  const disbursalAmount = parseFloat(amountUsdc || "0");
  const postBalance = sourceLiquid - disbursalAmount;
  const breachesFloor = postBalance < sourceFloor;

  const handleDisburse = async () => {
    if (circuitBreakerTripped) {
      setErr("Emergency stop is active. Disbursals are blocked.");
      return;
    }
    if (!isUsdc(amountUsdc) || disbursalAmount <= 0) {
      setErr("Enter a valid positive USDC amount with max 6 decimal places.");
      return;
    }
    if (disbursalAmount > sourceLiquid) {
      setErr(
        `Insufficient liquid funds: ${sourceAccount?.name} has only ${formatUsdc(
          sourceAccount?.liquidUsdc || "0",
          { symbol: true }
        )} available.`
      );
      return;
    }
    if (!rationale.trim()) {
      setErr("Please provide a business rationale for this disbursal.");
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    setSuccess(undefined);

    try {
      const payload: any = {
        sourceAccountId,
        vendorId,
        vendorName: selectedVendor.name,
        amountUsdc: disbursalAmount,
        paymentRail: rail,
        category,
        invoiceId,
        poReference,
        declaredReason: rationale,
      };

      if (rail === "FIAT_PAYOUT") {
        payload.fiatDetails = {
          bankName: "Commercial Clearing Bank",
          routingNumber,
          accountNumber,
          subMethod: fiatMethod,
          memo: `Inv ${invoiceId}`,
        };
      }

      const res = await treasuryApi.disburseManual(payload);
      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || "Disbursal rejected by router/policy gate.");
      }

      const txHash = res.data?.txHash || res.data?.payoutReference || `0x${Date.now().toString(16)}`;

      appendJournalVoucher({
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        accountId: sourceAccountId,
        actionType: "DISBURSEMENT",
        debitAccount: `${sourceAccountId}:liquid`,
        creditAccount: selectedVendor.vendorId,
        amountUsdc,
        documentRef: invoiceId,
        txHash,
        memo: `Ad-hoc payment to ${selectedVendor.name}: ${rationale}`,
      });

      setSuccess(`Disbursal executed! Settlement ref: ${txHash.slice(0, 18)}...`);
      await refreshData();
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1500);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || "Failed to execute disbursal.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 600,
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
          overflow: "hidden",
          maxHeight: "92vh",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
        }}
      >
        <header
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--rule)",
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, font: "600 var(--fs-2) var(--font-figure)" }}>
              Pay Vendor Now (Ad-Hoc Disbursal)
            </h3>
            <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
              Multi-Rail Settlement Router with Three-Way Verification
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="bz-btn"
            data-v="quiet"
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ padding: "4px 8px" }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </header>

        <div style={{ padding: 20, display: "grid", gap: 14, overflowY: "auto" }}>
          {err && <Banner tone="danger" title="Disbursal Rejected">{err}</Banner>}
          {success && <Banner tone="auto" title="Settlement Confirmed">{success}</Banner>}

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
            <Field label="Beneficiary Vendor">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={vendorId}
                  onChange={setVendorId}
                  options={VENDORS.map((v) => ({
                    value: v.vendorId,
                    label: `${v.name} (${v.category})`,
                    label: `${v.name} (${v.authorizedCategory})`,
                  }))}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="Debiting Treasury Account">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={sourceAccountId}
                  onChange={setSourceAccountId}
                  options={accounts.map((a) => ({
                    value: a.accountId,
                    label: `${a.name} (${formatUsdc(a.liquidUsdc, { symbol: true })})`,
                  }))}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
            <Field label="Settlement Rail">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={rail}
                  onChange={(val) => setRail(val as T.DisbursalRail)}
                  onChange={(val) => setRail(val as T.PaymentRail)}
                  options={[
                    { value: "DISBURSAL_VAULT", label: "Disbursal Vault (Arc L1 Native)" },
                    { value: "GATEWAY_X402", label: "Gateway x402 Nanopayments" },
                    { value: "MODULAR_SESSION_KEYS", label: "Modular Session Keys (ERC-6900)" },
                    { value: "ERC3009_AUTHORIZATION", label: "ERC-3009 Gasless Transfer" },
                    { value: "FIAT_PAYOUT", label: "Circle Mint Payout (ACH / Wire)" },
                  ]}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="Budget Category">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={category}
                  onChange={setCategory}
                  options={[
                    { value: "Cloud & AI", label: "Cloud & AI Infrastructure" },
                    { value: "Payroll & Talent", label: "Payroll & Engineering Contractors" },
                    { value: "Hardware", label: "Hardware & Lab Equipment" },
                    { value: "Legal", label: "Legal, IP & Corporate Counsel" },
                    { value: "Taxes", label: "Tax Reserves & Statutory Withholding" },
                    { value: "Operations", label: "General Operations & SaaS" },
                  ]}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <Field label="Disbursal Amount (USDC)">
            {() => (
              <div>
                <UsdcInput value={amountUsdc} onChange={setAmountUsdc} />
                <div
                  style={{
                    display: "flex",
                    justifyContent: "space-between",
                    marginTop: 4,
                    fontSize: "0.8rem",
                    color: breachesFloor ? "var(--c-danger)" : "var(--ink-3)",
                  }}
                >
                  <span>
                    Liquid Balance: {formatUsdc(sourceAccount?.liquidUsdc || "0", { symbol: true })}
                  </span>
                  <span>
                    Floor Reserve: {formatUsdc(sourceAccount?.protectedReserveUsdc || "0", { symbol: true })}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {breachesFloor && (
                  <p style={{ margin: "4px 0 0", color: "var(--c-danger)", fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
                    ⚠️ Warning: This payment dips {sourceAccount?.name} below its required operating floor!
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </Field>

          {rail === "FIAT_PAYOUT" && (
            <div
              style={{
                backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
                padding: "12px",
                borderRadius: "var(--r-sm)",
                border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
                display: "grid",
                gap: 10,
              }}
            >
              <strong style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>Circle Mint Banking Details</strong>
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr 1fr", gap: 8 }}>
                <Field label="Method">
                  {(id) => (
                    <Select
                      id={id}
                      value={fiatMethod}
                      onChange={(v) => setFiatMethod(v as "WIRE" | "ACH")}
                      options={[
                        { value: "ACH", label: "FedACH Direct" },
                        { value: "WIRE", label: "Fedwire Same-Day" },
                      ]}
                    />
                  )}
                </Field>
                <Field label="Routing (ABA)">
                  {(id) => (
                    <TextInput
                      id={id}
                      value={routingNumber}
                      onChange={(e) => setRoutingNumber(e.target.value)}
                    />
                  )}
                </Field>
                <Field label="Account #">
                  {(id) => (
                    <TextInput
                      id={id}
                      value={accountNumber}
                      onChange={(e) => setAccountNumber(e.target.value)}
                    />
                  )}
                </Field>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
            <Field label="Invoice Ref #">
              {(id) => (
                <TextInput
                  id={id}
                  value={invoiceId}
                  onChange={(e) => setInvoiceId(e.target.value)}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
            <Field label="PO Reference">
              {(id) => (
                <TextInput
                  id={id}
                  value={poReference}
                  onChange={(e) => setPoReference(e.target.value)}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <Field label="Business Rationale (Mandatory Audit Trail)">
            {(id) => (
              <TextInput
                id={id}
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. Expedited compute cluster renewal for Q4 rollout"
                value={rationale}
                onChange={(e) => setRationale(e.target.value)}
              />
            )}
          </Field>
        </div>

        <footer
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "flex-end",
            gap: 12,
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderTop: "1px solid var(--rule)",
            backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
          }}
        >
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleDisburse}
            disabled={busy || !amountUsdc || disbursalAmount <= 0 || !rationale.trim()}
          >
            {busy ? "Routing Disbursal..." : "Disburse Payment Now"}
          </Button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { Button, Field, UsdcInput, Select, Banner } from "../primitives";
import { formatUsdc, isUsdc } from "../money";

export function SweepModal({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { accounts, sweepExcessLiquidity, recallLiquidity, circuitBreakerTripped } = useTreasury();

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"SWEEP" | "RECALL">("SWEEP");
  const [accountId, setAccountId] = useState("acc_treasury");
  const [amountUsdc, setAmountUsdc] = useState("25000.000000");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string>();

  const selectedAccount = accounts.find(a => a.accountId === accountId) || accounts[0];

  const handleExecute = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    setSuccess(undefined);

    try {
      if (!isUsdc(amountUsdc) || parseFloat(amountUsdc) <= 0) {
        throw new Error("Enter a valid positive USDC amount with max 6 decimals.");
      }

      if (mode === "SWEEP") {
        await sweepExcessLiquidity(accountId, amountUsdc);
        setSuccess(`Successfully swept ${formatUsdc(amountUsdc, { symbol: true })} into tokenized USYC yield vault!`);
      } else {
        await recallLiquidity(accountId, amountUsdc);
        setSuccess(`Successfully recalled ${formatUsdc(amountUsdc, { symbol: true })} from USYC vault back to liquid cash.`);
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1200);
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Operation failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={e => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 520,
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
        }}
      >
        <header
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--rule)",
          }}
        >
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0, font: "600 var(--fs-2) var(--font-figure)" }}>
            Treasury Sentinel: Yield Sweeps & Recalls
          </h3>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="bz-btn"
            data-v="quiet"
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ padding: "4px 8px" }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </header>

        <div style={{ padding: 20, display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          {circuitBreakerTripped && (
            <Banner tone="danger" title="Emergency Stop Active">
              Autonomous and manual yield sweeps are currently locked out by the emergency circuit breaker.
            </Banner>
          )}

          {err && <Banner tone="danger" title="Execution Error">{err}</Banner>}
          {success && <Banner tone="auto" title="Success">{success}</Banner>}

          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, padding: 4, background: "var(--sunken)", borderRadius: 6 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="bz-btn"
              data-v={mode === "SWEEP" ? "primary" : "quiet"}
              style={{ flex: 1, padding: "6px 12px", fontSize: "0.85rem" }}
              onClick={() => {
                setMode("SWEEP");
                setAmountUsdc("25000.000000");
              }}
            >
              Sweep Idle Cash → USYC
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="bz-btn"
              data-v={mode === "RECALL" ? "primary" : "quiet"}
              style={{ flex: 1, padding: "6px 12px", fontSize: "0.85rem" }}
              onClick={() => {
                setMode("RECALL");
                setAmountUsdc("10000.000000");
              }}
            >
              Recall USYC → Liquid Cash
            </button>
          </div>

          <Field label="Cost Center Account">
            {id => (
              <Select
                id={id}
                value={accountId}
                onChange={setAccountId}
                options={accounts.map(a => ({
                  value: a.accountId,
                  label: `${a.name} (Liquid: ${formatUsdc(a.liquidUsdc)}, USYC: ${formatUsdc(a.investedUsyc)})`,
                }))}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          <Field
            label={`Amount to ${mode === "SWEEP" ? "Sweep" : "Recall"} in USDC`}
            hint={
              mode === "SWEEP"
                ? `Safe-to-invest surplus in this account: ${formatUsdc(selectedAccount.safeToInvestUsdc, { symbol: true })}`
                : `Currently earning yield in USYC: ${formatUsdc(selectedAccount.investedUsyc, { symbol: true })}`
            }
          >
            {(id, d) => (
              <UsdcInput
                id={id}
                describedBy={d}
                value={amountUsdc}
                onChange={v => setAmountUsdc(v)}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          <div
            style={{
              padding: 12,
              borderRadius: 6,
              backgroundColor: "var(--sunken)",
              fontSize: "0.85rem",
              display: "grid",
              gap: 4,
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <span className="bz-muted">Target Yield Asset:</span>
              <strong>Hashnote USYC (Tokenized US Treasuries)</strong>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <span className="bz-muted">Autonomous Sweep Cap:</span>
              <strong>$25,000.00 per batch</strong>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <span className="bz-muted">Current Annualized Yield:</span>
              <strong style={{ color: "var(--auto)" }}>5.12% Net APR</strong>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              justifyContent: "flex-end",
              gap: 8,
              paddingTop: 12,
              borderTop: "1px solid var(--rule)",
            }}
          >
            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button loading={busy} disabled={circuitBreakerTripped} onClick={handleExecute}>
              {mode === "SWEEP" ? "Execute Sweep to USYC" : "Execute Recall from USYC"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Banner, Field, TextInput, Badge, Select } from "../primitives";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { MEMBERS } from "../fixtures";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function AuthModal({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { currentUser, switchUser } = useTreasury();
  const [authMethod, setAuthMethod] = useState<"SIWE" | "EMAIL_OTP" | "ROLE_SWITCH">("SIWE");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [otp, setOtp] = useState("");
  const [otpSent, setOtpSent] = useState(false);
  const [isSigning, setIsSigning] = useState(false);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSiweSign = async () => {
    setIsSigning(true);
    setStatusMsg(null);
    try {
      // Real Web3 provider check or fallback
      const ethereum = (window as any).ethereum;
      if (ethereum) {
        const accounts = await ethereum.request({ method: "eth_requestAccounts" });
        const walletAddress = accounts[0];
        const nonceResp = await fetch("/api/auth/siwe/nonce");
        const { nonce } = await nonceResp.json().catch(() => ({ nonce: `nonce_${Date.now()}` }));

        const message = `BizArc Autonomous Treasury Login\nNonce: ${nonce}\nTimestamp: ${new Date().toISOString()}`;
        const signature = await ethereum.request({
          method: "personal_sign",
          params: [message, walletAddress],
        });

        setStatusMsg(`Signed in with Web3 wallet: ${walletAddress.slice(0, 10)}... (Sig: ${signature.slice(0, 12)}...)`);
      } else {
        setStatusMsg("No Web3 browser wallet detected (MetaMask, Coinbase). Simulated session active.");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMsg(`Signing error: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsSigning(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendOtp = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!email) return;
    setOtpSent(true);
    setStatusMsg(`Single-use 6-digit confirmation code dispatched to ${email}.`);
  };

  const handleVerifyOtp = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (otp.length < 6) return;
    setStatusMsg(`Email verified! Authenticated session established for ${email}.`);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
      }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          padding: 24,
          maxWidth: 460,
          width: "100%",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
        }}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "var(--fs-2)" }}>Sign In / Session Auth</h3>
          <Badge tone="liquid">{currentUser ? currentUser.role : "GUEST"}</Badge>
        </div>

        {statusMsg && (
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <Banner tone="auto">{statusMsg}</Banner>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, marginBottom: 20 }}>
          <Button
            variant={authMethod === "SIWE" ? "primary" : "secondary"}
            onClick={() => setAuthMethod("SIWE")}
            style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", flex: 1 }}
          >
            Web3 SIWE
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={authMethod === "EMAIL_OTP" ? "primary" : "secondary"}
            onClick={() => setAuthMethod("EMAIL_OTP")}
            style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", flex: 1 }}
          >
            Email OTP
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={authMethod === "ROLE_SWITCH" ? "primary" : "secondary"}
            onClick={() => setAuthMethod("ROLE_SWITCH")}
            style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", flex: 1 }}
          >
            Switch Role
          </Button>
        </div>

        {authMethod === "SIWE" && (
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
            <p className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", margin: 0 }}>
              Sign In With Ethereum (EIP-4361). Authenticate against Arc L1 with cryptographic message signatures.
            </p>
            <div style={{ padding: 12, backgroundColor: "var(--sunken)", borderRadius: 6, fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
              <div><strong>Network:</strong> Arc L1 (Chain ID: 5042)</div>
              <div><strong>Gas Floor:</strong> 20 Gwei native USDC</div>
            </div>
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSiweSign} disabled={isSigning}>
              {isSigning ? "Requesting Signature..." : "Sign In With Web3 Wallet"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}

        {authMethod === "EMAIL_OTP" && (
          <div>
            {!otpSent ? (
              <form onSubmit={handleSendOtp} style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
                <Field label="Corporate Email Address">
                  {(id) => (
                    <TextInput
                      id={id}
                      type="email"
                      value={email}
                      onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="cfo@halcyon.ai"
                      required
                    />
                  )}
                </Field>
                <Button variant="primary" type="submit">
                  Send One-Time Password
                </Button>
              </form>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleVerifyOtp} style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
                <Field label="Enter 6-Digit Verification Code">
                  {(id) => (
                    <TextInput
                      id={id}
                      value={otp}
                      onChange={(e) => setOtp(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="123456"
                      maxLength={6}
                      required
                    />
                  )}
                </Field>
                <Button variant="primary" type="submit">
                  Verify & Establish Session
                </Button>
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {authMethod === "ROLE_SWITCH" && (
          <div style={{ display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
            <Field label="Active Persona / User Switcher">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={currentUser?.userId || MEMBERS[0].userId}
                  onChange={(uid) => {
                    const found = MEMBERS.find((m) => m.userId === uid);
                    if (found) {
                      switchUser(found);
                      setStatusMsg(`Switched active user to ${found.name} (${found.role}).`);
                    }
                  }}
                  options={MEMBERS.map((m) => ({
                    value: m.userId,
                    label: `${m.name} — ${m.role} (${m.email})`,
                  }))}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
            <p className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", margin: 0 }}>
              Testing & simulation tool: switch between CFO, Admin, Approver, and Viewer roles to test RBAC gates.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", marginTop: 20 }}>
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose}>
            Close
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { RailPicker } from "../domain";
import { Button, Field, TextInput, UsdcInput, Select, Banner } from "../primitives";
import { isUsdc } from "../money";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function AddLiabilityModal({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { accounts, addLiability } = useTreasury();

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [accountId, setAccountId] = useState(accounts[0]?.accountId || "acc_engineering");
  const [vendorId, setVendorId] = useState("vendor_custom");
  const [customVendorName, setCustomVendorName] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<T.LiabilityCategory>("INFRASTRUCTURE");
  const [amountUsdc, setAmountUsdc] = useState("1500.000000");
  const [amountValid, setAmountValid] = useState(true);
  const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState(
    new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  );
  const [rail, setRail] = useState<T.PaymentRail>("DISBURSAL_VAULT");
  const [subMethod, setSubMethod] = useState<T.FiatSubMethod>("FEDWIRE");
  const [payoutAddress, setPayoutAddress] = useState("0x4444555566667777888899990000111122223333");
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErr(undefined);

    if (!title.trim()) {
      setErr("Bill title is required.");
      return;
    }

    if (!isUsdc(amountUsdc) || parseFloat(amountUsdc) <= 0) {
      setErr("Please enter a valid positive USDC amount with at most 6 decimal places.");
      return;
    }

    const finalVendor = vendorId === "vendor_custom" ? `vendor_${customVendorName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "_")}` : vendorId;

    addLiability({
      title: title.trim(),
      accountId,
      vendorId: finalVendor,
      category,
      amountUsdc,
      dueDate: new Date(dueDate).toISOString(),
      status: "SCHEDULED",
      payoutAddress,
      rail,
    });

    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={e => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 620,
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
          maxHeight: "90vh",
          overflowY: "auto",
        }}
      >
        <header
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--rule)",
          }}
        >
          <h3 style={{ margin: 0, font: "600 var(--fs-2) var(--font-figure)" }}>
            Schedule New Recurring or Ad-Hoc Bill
          </h3>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="bz-btn"
            data-v="quiet"
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ padding: "4px 8px" }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </header>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ padding: 20, display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          {err && <Banner tone="danger" title="Validation Error">{err}</Banner>}

          <Field label="Bill Description / Title">
            {id => (
              <TextInput
                id={id}
                placeholder="e.g. Snowflake Data Cloud Quarterly"
                value={title}
                onChange={e => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
            <Field label="Debited Cost Center">
              {id => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={accountId}
                  onChange={setAccountId}
                  options={accounts.map(a => ({ value: a.accountId, label: `${a.name} (${a.role})` }))}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="Category">
              {id => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={category}
                  onChange={v => setCategory(v as T.LiabilityCategory)}
                  options={[
                    { value: "INFRASTRUCTURE", label: "Infrastructure" },
                    { value: "DEVELOPER_TOOLS", label: "Developer Tools" },
                    { value: "SAAS", label: "SaaS / Subscriptions" },
                    { value: "CONTRACTOR", label: "Contractor / Legal" },
                    { value: "MARKETING", label: "Marketing / Growth" },
                    { value: "GENERAL_OPERATIONS", label: "General Operations" },
                  ]}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
            <Field
              label="Amount in USDC"
              hint="Max 6 decimals. Never rounded."
              error={!amountValid ? "Invalid USDC amount: exact 6 decimals max." : undefined}
            >
              {(id, d) => (
                <UsdcInput
                  id={id}
                  describedBy={d}
                  value={amountUsdc}
                  onChange={(v, valid) => {
                    setAmountUsdc(v);
                    setAmountValid(valid);
                  }}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="Due Date">
              {id => (
                <TextInput
                  id={id}
                  type="date"
                  value={dueDate}
                  onChange={e => setDueDate(e.target.value)}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
            <Field label="Vendor Directory">
              {id => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={vendorId}
                  onChange={setVendorId}
                  options={[
                    { value: "vendor_aws", label: "Amazon Web Services" },
                    { value: "vendor_github", label: "GitHub Enterprise" },
                    { value: "vendor_openai", label: "OpenAI API" },
                    { value: "vendor_figma", label: "Figma" },
                    { value: "vendor_mofo", label: "Morrison & Foerster LLP" },
                    { value: "vendor_berlin_gmbh", label: "Büro Berlin Coworking" },
                    { value: "vendor_custom", label: "+ Custom Vendor" },
                  ]}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            {vendorId === "vendor_custom" && (
              <Field label="Custom Vendor Name">
                {id => (
                  <TextInput
                    id={id}
                    placeholder="e.g. Datadog Inc."
                    value={customVendorName}
                    onChange={e => setCustomVendorName(e.target.value)}
                  />
                )}
              </Field>
            )}
          </div>

          <Field label="Payout Destination (Wallet or Bank Memo)">
            {id => (
              <TextInput
                id={id}
                value={payoutAddress}
                onChange={e => setPayoutAddress(e.target.value)}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          <RailPicker
            rail={rail}
            sub={subMethod}
            onChange={(r, s) => {
              setRail(r);
              if (s) setSubMethod(s);
            }}
          />

          <div
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              justifyContent: "flex-end",
              gap: 8,
              paddingTop: 12,
              borderTop: "1px solid var(--rule)",
            }}
          >
            <Button variant="quiet" type="button" onClick={onClose}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit">Schedule Bill</Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { RailBadge, LiabilityStatusBadge } from "../domain";
import { Button, Banner, CopyChip, Field, Select, type Tone } from "../primitives";
import { formatUsdc } from "../money";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function LiabilityDetailModal({
  liability,
  onClose,
}: {
  liability: T.Liability;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { payLiability, updateLiabilityStatus, circuitBreakerTripped, accounts, appendJournalVoucher } = useTreasury();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string>();
  const [showDisputeForm, setShowDisputeForm] = useState(false);
  const [disputeReason, setDisputeReason] = useState("");

  const targetAccount = accounts.find(a => a.accountId === liability.accountId);
  const canSettle = liability.status === "SCHEDULED" || liability.status === "AWAITING_APPROVAL";

  const handlePay = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    try {
      await payLiability(liability.liabilityId);
      setSuccess("Bill successfully disbursed and settled onchain!");
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1200);
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Payment failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFreeze = () => {
    if (liability.status === "FROZEN") {
      updateLiabilityStatus(liability.liabilityId, "SCHEDULED");
    } else {
      updateLiabilityStatus(liability.liabilityId, "FROZEN");
    }
  };

  const handleDispute = async () => {
    if (!disputeReason.trim()) {
      setErr("Please provide a dispute memo detailing the anomaly or overcharge.");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    try {
      updateLiabilityStatus(liability.liabilityId, "FROZEN");
      appendJournalVoucher({
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        accountId: liability.accountId,
        actionType: "INVOICE_DISPUTED",
        debitAccount: liability.vendorId,
        creditAccount: `${liability.accountId}:disputed`,
        amountUsdc: liability.amountUsdc,
        documentRef: `DISPUTE-${liability.liabilityId.slice(-6)}`,
        memo: disputeReason,
      });
      setSuccess("Formal dispute filed. Scheduled payment frozen and audit trail updated.");
      setShowDisputeForm(false);
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Dispute filing failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={e => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 580,
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        <header
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--rule)",
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, font: "600 var(--fs-2) var(--font-figure)" }}>
              {liability.title}
            </h3>
            <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
              ID: {liability.liabilityId}
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="bz-btn"
            data-v="quiet"
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ padding: "4px 8px" }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </header>

        <div style={{ padding: 20, display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "baseline" }}>
            <div>
              <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.8rem", display: "block" }}>
                Total Obligation
              </span>
              <span className="bz-fig bz-total" style={{ fontSize: "var(--fs-4)" }}>
                {formatUsdc(liability.amountUsdc, { symbol: true })}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, alignItems: "center" }}>
              <LiabilityStatusBadge status={liability.status} />
              {liability.rail && <RailBadge rail={liability.rail} />}
            </div>
          </div>

          {liability.isOverdue && liability.status !== "SETTLED" && (
            <Banner tone="danger" title="Overdue Payment">
              Due date was {new Date(liability.dueDate).toLocaleDateString()}. Liability is currently {liability.status}.
            </Banner>
          )}

          {err && <Banner tone="danger" title="Disbursal Error">{err}</Banner>}
          {success && <Banner tone="auto" title="Settlement Confirmed">{success}</Banner>}

          <dl className="bz-kv" style={{ fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>
            <dt>Vendor</dt>
            <dd>
              <strong>{liability.vendorId.replace("vendor_", "").replace(/_/g, " ")}</strong>
            </dd>
            <dt>Paying Account</dt>
            <dd>{targetAccount?.name || liability.accountId}</dd>
            <dt>Category</dt>
            <dd>{liability.category}</dd>
            <dt>Due Date</dt>
            <dd>{new Date(liability.dueDate).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: "short", year: "numeric", month: "short", day: "numeric" })}</dd>
            <dt>Payout Destination</dt>
            <dd>
              <CopyChip value={liability.payoutAddress} label="payout address" />
            </dd>
          </dl>

          {showDisputeForm ? (
            <div style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)", padding: 12, borderRadius: "var(--r-sm)", border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)", display: "grid", gap: 8 }}>
              <strong style={{ fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>Formal Invoice Dispute Memo (Pillar 2)</strong>
              <textarea
                className="bz-input"
                rows={3}
                placeholder="Describe reason for dispute (e.g. rate exceeded PO contract baseline by 12%)..."
                value={disputeReason}
                onChange={e => setDisputeReason(e.target.value)}
                style={{ width: "100%", resize: "vertical", fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)", fontSize: "0.85rem" }}
              />
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, justifyContent: "flex-end" }}>
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShowDisputeForm(false)}>Cancel</Button>
                <Button loading={busy} onClick={handleDispute}>Submit Formal Dispute</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <div
            style={{
              display: "flex",
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              alignItems: "center",
              marginTop: 12,
              paddingTop: 16,
              borderTop: "1px solid var(--rule)",
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              {canSettle && (
                <Button loading={busy} disabled={circuitBreakerTripped} onClick={handlePay}>
                  Settle & Disburse Now
                </Button>
              )}

              {liability.status !== "SETTLED" && (
                <>
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleToggleFreeze}>
                    {liability.status === "FROZEN" ? "Unfreeze Bill" : "Freeze Bill"}
                  </Button>
                  {!showDisputeForm && (
                    <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setShowDisputeForm(true)}>
                      Dispute Invoice
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose}>
              Close
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: DisputeModal.tsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { Button, Banner, Field, Select, TextInput } from "../primitives";
import { formatUsdc } from "../money";
import type * as T from "../types";

export function DisputeModal({
  liability,
  onClose,
}: {
  liability?: T.Liability | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const { liabilities, disputeLiability } = useTreasury();

  const disputableLiabilities = liabilities.filter(
    (l) => l.status !== "SETTLED" && l.status !== "CANCELLED"
  );

  const [selectedLiabilityId, setSelectedLiabilityId] = useState<string>(
    liability?.liabilityId || disputableLiabilities[0]?.liabilityId || ""
  );
  const [disputeCategory, setDisputeCategory] = useState<string>("OVERBILLING");
  const [justification, setJustification] = useState<string>("");
  const [evidenceRef, setEvidenceRef] = useState<string>("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string>();

  const activeLiab =
    liabilities.find((l) => l.liabilityId === selectedLiabilityId) ||
    liability ||
    disputableLiabilities[0];

  const handleDispute = async () => {
    if (!selectedLiabilityId) {
      setErr("Please select a liability to dispute.");
      return;
    }
    if (!justification.trim()) {
      setErr("Please provide a detailed justification for the dispute.");
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    setSuccess(undefined);

    try {
      const fullMemo = `[${disputeCategory}] ${justification}${
        evidenceRef ? ` (Ref: ${evidenceRef})` : ""
      }`;
      await disputeLiability(selectedLiabilityId, fullMemo);
      setSuccess("Formal dispute lodged successfully. Payment frozen and audit trail updated.");
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1200);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || "Failed to submit dispute.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 540,
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        <header
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--rule)",
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, font: "600 var(--fs-2) var(--font-figure)" }}>
              File Formal Liability Dispute
            </h3>
            <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
              Three-Way Matching Exception & Payment Freeze (Pillar 2)
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="bz-btn"
            data-v="quiet"
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ padding: "4px 8px" }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </header>

        <div style={{ padding: 20, display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          {err && <Banner tone="danger" title="Dispute Error">{err}</Banner>}
          {success && <Banner tone="auto" title="Dispute Lodged">{success}</Banner>}

          <Field label="Select Liability / Invoice">
            {(id) => (
              <Select
                id={id}
                value={selectedLiabilityId}
                onChange={(val) => setSelectedLiabilityId(val)}
                options={disputableLiabilities.map((l) => ({
                  value: l.liabilityId,
                  label: `${l.title} (${formatUsdc(l.amountUsdc, { symbol: true })}) - Due ${new Date(
                    l.dueDate
                  ).toLocaleDateString()}`,
                }))}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          {activeLiab && (
            <div
              style={{
                backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
                padding: "10px 14px",
                borderRadius: "var(--r-sm)",
                fontSize: "0.85rem",
                display: "grid",
                gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr",
                gap: 8,
              }}
            >
              <div>
                <span className="bz-faint" style={{ display: "block" }}>Vendor:</span>
                <strong>{activeLiab.vendorId.replace("vendor_", "").replace(/_/g, " ")}</strong>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="bz-faint" style={{ display: "block" }}>Amount:</span>
                <strong className="bz-fig">{formatUsdc(activeLiab.amountUsdc, { symbol: true })}</strong>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="bz-faint" style={{ display: "block" }}>Current Status:</span>
                <span>{activeLiab.status}</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="bz-faint" style={{ display: "block" }}>Target Rail:</span>
                <span>{activeLiab.rail || "Default Vault"}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <Field label="Dispute Reason Category">
            {(id) => (
              <Select
                id={id}
                value={disputeCategory}
                onChange={setDisputeCategory}
                options={[
                  { value: "OVERBILLING", label: "Rate Exceeds Contract Baseline / Overbilled" },
                  { value: "UNRENDERED_SERVICES", label: "Goods / Services Not Received (No GRN)" },
                  { value: "DUPLICATE_CHARGE", label: "Duplicate Billing or Double Charge" },
                  { value: "UNKNOWN_VENDOR", label: "Unverified Vendor / Payee Substitution Risk" },
                  { value: "CONTRACT_BREACH", label: "SLA Failure or Vendor Contract Breach" },
                ]}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          <Field label="Evidence Document / Ticket Ref (Optional)">
            {(id) => (
              <TextInput
                id={id}
                type="text"
                placeholder="e.g. JIRA-4092, PO-2026-081-REV, Zendesk #1102"
                value={evidenceRef}
                onChange={(e) => setEvidenceRef(e.target.value)}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          <Field label="Mandatory Audit Justification">
            {(id) => (
              <textarea
                id={id}
                className="bz-input"
                rows={3}
                placeholder="Detail the discrepancy between invoice and purchase order/receipt..."
                value={justification}
                onChange={(e) => setJustification(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: "100%",
                  resize: "vertical",
                  fontFamily: "var(--font-sans)",
                  fontSize: "0.85rem",
                }}
              />
            )}
          </Field>
        </div>

        <footer
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "flex-end",
            gap: 12,
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderTop: "1px solid var(--rule)",
            backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
          }}
        >
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="danger"
            onClick={handleDispute}
            disabled={busy || !justification.trim() || !selectedLiabilityId}
          >
            {busy ? "Submitting Dispute..." : "Submit Dispute & Freeze"}
          </Button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: TransferModal.tsx
------------------------------------------------------------
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { Button, Field, UsdcInput, Select, Banner, TextInput } from "../primitives";
import { formatUsdc, isUsdc } from "../money";
import { treasuryApi } from "../api/treasuryApi";

export function TransferModal({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { accounts, refreshData } = useTreasury();

  const [fromAccountId, setFromAccountId] = useState(accounts[0]?.accountId || "acc_treasury");
  const [toAccountId, setToAccountId] = useState(accounts[1]?.accountId || "acc_dev");
  const [amountUsdc, setAmountUsdc] = useState("5000.000000");
  const [memo, setMemo] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string>();

  const sourceAccount = accounts.find((a) => a.accountId === fromAccountId) || accounts[0];
  const targetAccount = accounts.find((a) => a.accountId === toAccountId) || accounts[1];

  const sourceLiquid = parseFloat(sourceAccount?.liquidUsdc || "0");
  const sourceFloor = parseFloat(sourceAccount?.protectedReserveUsdc || "0");
  const transferAmount = parseFloat(amountUsdc || "0");
  const postBalance = sourceLiquid - transferAmount;
  const breachesFloor = postBalance < sourceFloor;

  const handleExecute = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    setSuccess(undefined);

    try {
      if (fromAccountId === toAccountId) {
        throw new Error("Source and destination accounts must be different.");
      }
      if (!isUsdc(amountUsdc) || transferAmount <= 0) {
        throw new Error("Enter a valid positive USDC amount with max 6 decimal places (Rule 5).");
      }
      if (transferAmount > sourceLiquid) {
        throw new Error(
          `Insufficient funds: ${sourceAccount?.name} has only ${formatUsdc(sourceAccount?.liquidUsdc || "0", { symbol: true })} available.`
        );
      }

      const res = await treasuryApi.transferFunds({
        fromAccountId,
        toAccountId,
        amountUsdc,
        reason: memo || `Internal reallocation from ${sourceAccount?.name} to ${targetAccount?.name}`,
        memo: memo || `Internal reallocation from ${sourceAccount?.name} to ${targetAccount?.name}`,
      });

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || "Transfer failed");
      }

      await refreshData();
      setSuccess(`Successfully transferred ${formatUsdc(amountUsdc, { symbol: true })} to ${targetAccount?.name}!`);
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1200);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || "Transfer failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const accountOptions = accounts.map((a) => ({
    value: a.accountId,
    label: `${a.name} (${formatUsdc(a.liquidUsdc, { compact: true })})`,
    label: `${a.name} (${formatUsdc(a.liquidUsdc, { symbol: true })})`,
  }));

  const destinationOptions = accounts
    .filter((a) => a.accountId !== fromAccountId)
    .map((a) => ({
      value: a.accountId,
      label: `${a.name} (${formatUsdc(a.liquidUsdc, { compact: true })})`,
      label: `${a.name} (${formatUsdc(a.liquidUsdc, { symbol: true })})`,
    }));

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 540,
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
        }}
      >
        <header
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--rule)",
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "1.1rem", fontFamily: "var(--font-serif)" }}>
              Intra-Account Internal Transfer
            </h2>
            <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "0.8rem", color: "var(--muted)" }}>
              Rule 5 strict 6-decimal USDC precision with double-entry ledger settlement
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              background: "none",
              border: "none",
              cursor: "pointer",
              fontSize: "1.2rem",
              color: "var(--muted)",
            }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </header>

        <div style={{ padding: 20 }}>
          {err && (
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <Banner tone="danger" title="Transfer Blocked">
                {err}
              </Banner>
            </div>
          )}

          {success && (
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <Banner tone="auto" title="Settled on Arc L1">
                {success}
              </Banner>
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <Field label="From Source Account">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={fromAccountId}
                  onChange={(v) => setFromAccountId(v)}
                  options={accountOptions}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="To Destination Account">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={toAccountId}
                  onChange={(v) => setToAccountId(v)}
                  options={destinationOptions}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <Field
            label="Transfer Amount (USDC)"
            hint="Rule 5: Exact string matching ^\d+(\.\d{1,6})?$"
          >
            {(id, d) => (
              <UsdcInput
                id={id}
                value={amountUsdc}
                onChange={(v) => setAmountUsdc(v)}
                describedBy={d}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          {/* Quick Amount Chips */}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8, marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setAmountUsdc(Math.max(0, sourceLiquid - sourceFloor).toFixed(6))}
              style={{
                fontSize: "0.75rem",
                padding: "2px 8px",
                borderRadius: 4,
                border: "1px solid var(--rule)",
                background: "var(--surface-muted)",
                cursor: "pointer",
              }}
            >
              Max Above Floor ({formatUsdc(Math.max(0, sourceLiquid - sourceFloor).toFixed(6))})
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setAmountUsdc(sourceLiquid.toFixed(6))}
              style={{
                fontSize: "0.75rem",
                padding: "2px 8px",
                borderRadius: 4,
                border: "1px solid var(--rule)",
                background: "var(--surface-muted)",
                cursor: "pointer",
              }}
            >
              Max Liquid ({formatUsdc(sourceLiquid.toFixed(6))})
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Solvency & Floor Preview */}
          <div
            style={{
              padding: 12,
              borderRadius: 6,
              backgroundColor: breachesFloor ? "rgba(168, 42, 34, 0.08)" : "var(--surface-muted)",
              border: `1px solid ${breachesFloor ? "var(--c-danger)" : "var(--rule)"}`,
              fontSize: "0.85rem",
              marginBottom: 16,
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <span style={{ color: "var(--muted)" }}>Current Source Balance:</span>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }}>
                {formatUsdc(sourceAccount?.liquidUsdc || "0", { symbol: true })}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: 4 }}>
              <span style={{ color: "var(--muted)" }}>Post-Transfer Balance:</span>
              <span
                style={{
                  fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)",
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  color: breachesFloor ? "var(--c-danger)" : "inherit",
                }}
              >
                {formatUsdc(Math.max(0, postBalance).toFixed(6), { symbol: true })}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
              <span style={{ color: "var(--muted)" }}>Configured Minimum Floor:</span>
              <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)" }}>
                {formatUsdc(sourceAccount?.protectedReserveUsdc || "0", { symbol: true })}
              </span>
            </div>
            {breachesFloor && (
              <p style={{ margin: "8px 0 0", color: "var(--c-danger)", fontSize: "0.8rem" }}>
                ⚠️ Warning: This transfer will dip {sourceAccount?.name} below its required operating floor!
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <Field label="Business Purpose / Memo (Optional)">
            {(id) => (
              <TextInput
                id={id}
                type="text"
                value={memo}
                onChange={(e) => setMemo(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Q4 Compute Budget allocation"
              />
            )}
          </Field>
        </div>

        <footer
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "flex-end",
            gap: 12,
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderTop: "1px solid var(--rule)",
            backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
          }}
        >
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleExecute}
            disabled={busy || !amountUsdc || transferAmount <= 0}
          >
            {busy ? "Settling on Ledger..." : "Execute Transfer"}
          </Button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
