import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Button, Field, UsdcInput, Select, Banner, TextInput } from "../primitives";
import { treasuryApi } from "../api/treasuryApi";
import type * as T from "../types";

interface AccountConfigModalProps {
  account?: T.AccountDistribution | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
}

const ROLE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "OPEX_DEV", label: "OPEX_DEV — Engineering, Infrastructure & Tooling" },
  { value: "OPEX_GROWTH", label: "OPEX_GROWTH — Marketing, Ad Spend & Growth" },
  { value: "OPEX_LEGAL", label: "OPEX_LEGAL — Legal Retainers & Compliance" },
  { value: "PAYROLL", label: "PAYROLL — Personnel Compensation (Protected Shield)" },
  { value: "TAX_ESCROW", label: "TAX_ESCROW — Estimated Taxes & Regulatory Fees" },
  { value: "TREASURY_RESERVE", label: "TREASURY_RESERVE — Master Corporate Pool" },
];

export function AccountConfigModal({ account, onClose, onSaved }: AccountConfigModalProps) {
  const isEditing = Boolean(account);

  const [accountId, setAccountId] = useState(account?.accountId || "");
  const [name, setName] = useState(account?.name || "");
  const [role, setRole] = useState(account?.role || "OPEX_DEV");
  const [minFloorUsdc, setMinFloorUsdc] = useState(account?.protectedReserveUsdc || "1000.000000");
  const [safetyBufferRatio, setSafetyBufferRatio] = useState("1.20");
  const [perTxCapUsdc, setPerTxCapUsdc] = useState("5000.000000");
  const [dailyCapUsdc, setDailyCapUsdc] = useState("20000.000000");
  const [maxSweepLimit, setMaxSweepLimit] = useState(
    account?.excludeFromWaterfall ? "0.000000" : "50000.000000"
  );
  const [excludeFromWaterfall, setExcludeFromWaterfall] = useState(
    Boolean(account?.excludeFromWaterfall)
  );

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);

    try {
      if (!isEditing && !accountId.trim()) {
        throw new Error("Account ID is required (e.g. acc_ai_compute).");
      }
      if (!name.trim()) {
        throw new Error("Display Name is required.");
      }

      const floor = parseFloat(minFloorUsdc);
      const buffer = parseFloat(safetyBufferRatio);

      if (isNaN(floor) || floor < 0) {
        throw new Error("Minimum floor must be non-negative.");
      }
      if (isNaN(buffer) || buffer < 1.0) {
        throw new Error("Safety buffer ratio must be at least 1.0x.");
      }

      if (isEditing && account) {
        const res = await treasuryApi.updateAccount(account.accountId, {
          minOperatingFloorUsdc: floor,
          safetyBufferRatio: buffer,
          perTxCapUsdc: parseFloat(perTxCapUsdc),
          dailyCapUsdc: parseFloat(dailyCapUsdc),
          maxAutonomousSweepUsdc: parseFloat(maxSweepLimit),
          maxAutonomousSweepLimit: parseFloat(maxSweepLimit),
          excludeFromWaterfall,
        });
        if (!res.success) throw new Error(res.error || "Update failed");
      } else {
        const res = await treasuryApi.createAccount({
          accountId: accountId.trim(),
          name: name.trim(),
          role,
          minOperatingFloorUsdc: floor,
          safetyBufferRatio: buffer,
          perTxCapUsdc: parseFloat(perTxCapUsdc),
          dailyCapUsdc: parseFloat(dailyCapUsdc),
          maxAutonomousSweepUsdc: parseFloat(maxSweepLimit),
          maxAutonomousSweepLimit: parseFloat(maxSweepLimit),
          excludeFromWaterfall,
        });
        if (!res.success) throw new Error(res.error || "Creation failed");
      }

      onSaved();
      onClose();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || "Failed to save account");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 580,
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
          maxHeight: "90vh",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
        }}
      >
        <header
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--rule)",
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "1.1rem", fontFamily: "var(--font-serif)" }}>
              {isEditing ? `Configure ${account?.name}` : "Create Operating Account"}
            </h2>
            <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: "0.8rem", color: "var(--muted)" }}>
              Configure departmental reserve floors, spending caps, and corporate shields
            </p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              background: "none",
              border: "none",
              cursor: "pointer",
              fontSize: "1.2rem",
              color: "var(--muted)",
            }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </header>

        <div style={{ padding: 20, overflowY: "auto", flex: 1 }}>
          {err && (
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
              <Banner tone="danger" title="Validation Error">
                {err}
              </Banner>
            </div>
          )}

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <Field label="Account ID" hint={isEditing ? "Immutable" : "e.g. acc_ai_infra"}>
              {(id) => (
                <TextInput
                  id={id}
                  type="text"
                  value={accountId}
                  onChange={(e) => setAccountId(e.target.value.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "_"))}
                  disabled={isEditing}
                  placeholder="acc_cost_center"
                  style={{
                    background: isEditing ? "var(--surface-muted)" : "var(--surface)",
                    fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)",
                  }}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="Display Name">
              {(id) => (
                <TextInput
                  id={id}
                  type="text"
                  value={name}
                  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. AI Cloud Infrastructure"
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <Field label="Standard Account Role">
            {(id) => (
              <Select
                id={id}
                value={role}
                onChange={(v) => setRole(v as any)}
                options={ROLE_OPTIONS}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 16, marginTop: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <Field label="Minimum Operating Floor (USDC)">
              {(id, d) => (
                <UsdcInput
                  id={id}
                  value={minFloorUsdc}
                  onChange={(v) => setMinFloorUsdc(v)}
                  describedBy={d}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="Safety Buffer Ratio" hint="Multiplier over upcoming liabilities">
              {(id) => (
                <TextInput
                  id={id}
                  type="number"
                  step="0.05"
                  min="1.0"
                  max="3.0"
                  value={safetyBufferRatio}
                  onChange={(e) => setSafetyBufferRatio(e.target.value)}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
            <Field label="Per-Transaction Cap (USDC)">
              {(id, d) => (
                <UsdcInput
                  id={id}
                  value={perTxCapUsdc}
                  onChange={(v) => setPerTxCapUsdc(v)}
                  describedBy={d}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="Daily Velocity Cap (USDC)">
              {(id, d) => (
                <UsdcInput
                  id={id}
                  value={dailyCapUsdc}
                  onChange={(v) => setDailyCapUsdc(v)}
                  describedBy={d}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          {/* Corporate Shield & Protection Toggles */}
          <div
            style={{
              padding: 16,
              borderRadius: 6,
              backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
              border: "1px solid var(--rule)",
              marginTop: 8,
            }}
          >
            <h4 style={{ margin: "0 0 8px", fontSize: "0.9rem" }}>Corporate Shielding & Waterfall Rules</h4>

            <label style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: 8, cursor: "pointer", marginBottom: 12 }}>
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={excludeFromWaterfall}
                onChange={(e) => setExcludeFromWaterfall(e.target.checked)}
                style={{ marginTop: 3 }}
              />
              <span style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
                <strong>Exclude from Waterfall Drains:</strong> Inviolable shield preventing other corporate accounts from pulling funds from this wallet during shortfalls.
              </span>
            </label>

            <Field label="Max Autonomous Sweep Limit (USDC)" hint="Set to 0.00 to completely block automated USYC sweeps">
              {(id, d) => (
                <UsdcInput
                  id={id}
                  value={maxSweepLimit}
                  onChange={(v) => setMaxSweepLimit(v)}
                  describedBy={d}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>
        </div>

        <footer
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "flex-end",
            gap: 12,
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderTop: "1px solid var(--rule)",
            backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
          }}
        >
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? "Saving Account..." : isEditing ? "Save Configuration" : "Create Account"}
          </Button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

File: TokenSwapModal.tsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useTreasury } from "../context/TreasuryContext";
import { Button, Banner, Field, Select, UsdcInput, TextInput } from "../primitives";
import { formatUsdc, isUsdc } from "../money";
import { treasuryApi } from "../api/treasuryApi";

export function TokenSwapModal({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { accounts, refreshData, appendJournalVoucher } = useTreasury();

  const [fromAsset, setFromAsset] = useState<string>("USDT");
  const [toAsset, setToAsset] = useState<string>("USDC");
  const [accountId, setAccountId] = useState<string>(accounts[0]?.accountId || "acc_treasury");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState<string>("1000.000000");

  const [quote, setQuote] = useState<{
    estimatedOutputUsdc: string;
    rate: number;
    feeUsdc: string;
    guaranteedDurationSeconds: number;
  } | null>(null);

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string>();
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string>();

  const selectedAccount = accounts.find((a) => a.accountId === accountId) || accounts[0];

  const handleGetQuote = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    setQuote(null);
    try {
      if (!amount || parseFloat(amount) <= 0) {
        throw new Error("Enter a valid swap amount.");
      }
      const res = await treasuryApi.estimateSwap({
        fromToken: fromAsset,
        toToken: toAsset,
        amount: parseFloat(amount),
      });

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || "Failed to obtain swap quote.");
      }

      setQuote({
        estimatedOutputUsdc: res.data?.estimatedOutputUsdc || res.data?.outputAmount || amount,
        rate: res.data?.rate || 1.0,
        feeUsdc: res.data?.feeUsdc || "0.500000",
        guaranteedDurationSeconds: res.data?.guaranteedDurationSeconds || 30,
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || "Pricing estimate failed.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExecuteSwap = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setErr(undefined);
    setSuccess(undefined);
    try {
      const res = await treasuryApi.executeSwap({
        accountId,
        fromToken: fromAsset,
        toToken: toAsset,
        amount: parseFloat(amount),
        quoteId: `quote-${Date.now()}`,
      });

      if (!res.success) {
        throw new Error(res.error || "Swap execution failed.");
      }

      appendJournalVoucher({
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        accountId,
        actionType: "TOKEN_SWAP",
        debitAccount: `${accountId}:liquid`,
        creditAccount: `swap:${fromAsset.toLowerCase()}`,
        amountUsdc: quote?.estimatedOutputUsdc || amount,
        documentRef: `SWAP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`,
        memo: `Swapped ${amount} ${fromAsset} for ${quote?.estimatedOutputUsdc || amount} ${toAsset} via Circle SwapKit`,
      });

      setSuccess(`Successfully swapped ${amount} ${fromAsset} to ${toAsset}!`);
      await refreshData();
      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1400);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setErr(e.message || "Swap execution failed.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: "fixed",
        inset: 0,
        backgroundColor: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        zIndex: 100,
        padding: 16,
      }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose();
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          maxWidth: 500,
          backgroundColor: "var(--surface)",
          border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
          borderRadius: "var(--r-panel)",
          boxShadow: "0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)",
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        <header
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "space-between",
            alignItems: "center",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderBottom: "1px solid var(--rule)",
          }}
        >
          <div>
            <h3 style={{ margin: 0, font: "600 var(--fs-2) var(--font-figure)" }}>
              Atomic Token Swap
            </h3>
            <span className="bz-faint" style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem" }}>
              Circle SwapKit & Arc L1 Liquidity Pool
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="bz-btn"
            data-v="quiet"
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{ padding: "4px 8px" }}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </header>

        <div style={{ padding: 20, display: "grid", gap: 16 }}>
          {err && <Banner tone="danger" title="Swap Error">{err}</Banner>}
          {success && <Banner tone="auto" title="Swap Complete">{success}</Banner>}

          <Field label="Settlement Treasury Account">
            {(id) => (
              <Select
                id={id}
                value={accountId}
                onChange={setAccountId}
                options={accounts.map((a) => ({
                  value: a.accountId,
                  label: `${a.name} (${formatUsdc(a.liquidUsdc, { symbol: true })} liquid)`,
                }))}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 12 }}>
            <Field label="From Asset">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={fromAsset}
                  onChange={setFromAsset}
                  options={[
                    { value: "USDT", label: "USDT (Tether USD)" },
                    { value: "EURC", label: "EURC (Circle Euro)" },
                    { value: "ETH", label: "WETH (Wrapped Ether)" },
                    { value: "SOL", label: "SOL (Solana)" },
                    { value: "USDC", label: "USDC (Native Arc)" },
                  ]}
                />
              )}
            </Field>

            <Field label="To Asset">
              {(id) => (
                <Select
                  id={id}
                  value={toAsset}
                  onChange={setToAsset}
                  options={[
                    { value: "USDC", label: "USDC (Arc Native)" },
                    { value: "USYC", label: "USYC (Yield Token)" },
                    { value: "EURC", label: "EURC (Circle Euro)" },
                  ]}
                />
              )}
            </Field>
          </div>

          <Field label={`Amount (${fromAsset})`}>
            {() => (
              <UsdcInput
                value={amount}
                onChange={(val) => {
                  setAmount(val);
                  setQuote(null);
                }}
              />
            )}
          </Field>

          {quote ? (
            <div
              style={{
                backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
                padding: "12px 14px",
                borderRadius: "var(--r-sm)",
                border: "1px solid var(--rule-strong)",
                display: "grid",
                gap: 6,
                fontSize: "0.85rem",
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                <span className="bz-faint">Estimated Output:</span>
                <strong className="bz-fig" style={{ color: "var(--auto)", fontSize: "1rem" }}>
                  {formatUsdc(quote.estimatedOutputUsdc, { symbol: true })} {toAsset}
                </strong>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                <span className="bz-faint">Indicative Rate:</span>
                <span>1 {fromAsset} ≈ {quote.rate.toFixed(4)} {toAsset}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                <span className="bz-faint">Swap Fee:</span>
                <span>{quote.feeUsdc} USDC</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between" }}>
                <span className="bz-faint">Quote Guaranteed:</span>
                <span>{quote.guaranteedDurationSeconds}s</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleGetQuote} loading={busy}>
              Get Swap Quote
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <footer
          style={{
            display: "flex",
            justifyContent: "flex-end",
            gap: 12,
            padding: "16px 20px",
            borderTop: "1px solid var(--rule)",
            backgroundColor: "var(--surface-muted)",
          }}
        >
          <Button variant="quiet" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            onClick={handleExecuteSwap}
            disabled={busy || !quote || parseFloat(amount) <= 0}
          >
            {busy ? "Executing On-Chain..." : `Execute Swap (${fromAsset} → ${toAsset})`}
          </Button>
        </footer>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useCallback, type ReactNode } from "react";
import * as T from "../types";
import { treasuryApi } from "../api/treasuryApi";
import {
  ACCOUNTS as INITIAL_ACCOUNTS,
  LIABILITIES as INITIAL_LIABILITIES,
  SPR_PENDING_ALL as INITIAL_PENDING_SPRS,
  SPR_DECIDED as INITIAL_DECIDED_SPRS,
  JOURNAL as INITIAL_JOURNAL,
  JOURNAL_BROKEN,
  AUDIT as INITIAL_AUDIT,
  COMPANY,
  ME,
  MEMBERSHIPS,
  NOTIFICATIONS as INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS,
  hex,
} from "../fixtures";
import { toMicro, fromMicro, sumUsdc } from "../money";

interface TreasuryContextType {
  theme: "light" | "dark";
  setTheme: (t: "light" | "dark") => void;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  activeView: string;
  setActiveView: (view: string) => void;

  company: T.Company;
  setCompany: (c: T.Company) => void;
  currentUser: T.Member;
  setCurrentUser: (m: T.Member) => void;
  switchUser: (m: T.Member) => void;
  switchCompany: (companyId: string) => Promise<void>;

  // Accounts & Balances
  accounts: T.AccountDistribution[];
  totalLiquid: string;
  totalInvested: string;
  totalEffective: string;
  safeToInvestTotal: string;

  // Liabilities
  liabilities: T.Liability[];
  addLiability: (liability: Omit<T.Liability, "liabilityId">) => void;
  updateLiabilityStatus: (id: string, status: T.LiabilityStatus) => void;
  payLiability: (id: string) => Promise<void>;
  disputeLiability: (id: string, reason?: string) => Promise<void>;

  // SPRS (Human Approval Gates)
  pendingSprs: T.PermissionRequest[];
  decidedSprs: T.PermissionRequest[];
  decideSpr: (
    requestId: string,
    decision: "APPROVE" | "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS",
    memo?: string,
    adminSignature?: string
  ) => Promise<void>;

  // Journal & Cryptographic Audit
  journal: T.JournalVoucher[];
  isChainTampered: boolean;
  toggleChainTamper: () => void;
  appendJournalVoucher: (voucher: Omit<T.JournalVoucher, "sequenceId" | "previousHash" | "currentHash">) => void;

  // Circuit Breaker
  circuitBreakerTripped: boolean;
  circuitBreakerReason?: string;
  tripCircuitBreaker: (reason: string) => Promise<void>;
  resetCircuitBreaker: () => Promise<void>;

  // Swarm & Yield Operations
  sweepExcessLiquidity: (accountId: string, amountUsdc: string) => Promise<void>;
  recallLiquidity: (accountId: string, amountUsdc: string) => Promise<void>;

  // Notifications & Audit Log
  notifications: T.AppNotification[];
  markNotificationRead: (id: string) => void;
  auditEvents: T.AuditEvent[];

  // Onboarding Wizard Session
  wizardStep: number;
  setWizardStep: (step: number) => void;
  wizardCompleted: number[];
  completeWizardStep: (step: number) => void;

  // Shortfalls & Live Backend Sync
  shortfalls: any[];
  hasShortfalls: boolean;
  isLiveBackend: boolean;
  refreshData: () => Promise<void>;
  runShortfallRebalance: () => Promise<void>;
  createAccount: (data: any) => Promise<void>;
  updateAccountPolicy: (accountId: string, data: any) => Promise<void>;
  fundAccount: (accountId: string, amountUsdc: string, method?: string) => Promise<void>;
}

const TreasuryContext = createContext<TreasuryContextType | null>(null);

export function TreasuryProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<"light" | "dark">("light");
  const [activeView, setActiveView] = useState<string>("overview");

  const [company, setCompany] = useState<T.Company>(COMPANY);
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<T.Member>(ME);

  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState<T.AccountDistribution[]>(INITIAL_ACCOUNTS);
  const [liabilities, setLiabilities] = useState<T.Liability[]>(INITIAL_LIABILITIES);
  const [pendingSprs, setPendingSprs] = useState<T.PermissionRequest[]>(INITIAL_PENDING_SPRS);
  const [decidedSprs, setDecidedSprs] = useState<T.PermissionRequest[]>(INITIAL_DECIDED_SPRS);
  const [journal, setJournal] = useState<T.JournalVoucher[]>(INITIAL_JOURNAL);
  const [isChainTampered, setIsChainTampered] = useState(false);

  const [circuitBreakerTripped, setCircuitBreakerTripped] = useState(false);
  const [circuitBreakerReason, setCircuitBreakerReason] = useState<string>();

  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<T.AppNotification[]>(INITIAL_NOTIFICATIONS);
  const [auditEvents, setAuditEvents] = useState<T.AuditEvent[]>(INITIAL_AUDIT);

  const [wizardStep, setWizardStep] = useState(1);
  const [wizardCompleted, setWizardCompleted] = useState<number[]>([1, 2]);

  const [shortfalls, setShortfalls] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isLiveBackend, setIsLiveBackend] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const refreshData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [distRes, sfRes] = await Promise.all([
        treasuryApi.getDistribution(),
        treasuryApi.getShortfalls(),
      ]);

      if (distRes.success && distRes.data) {
        setIsLiveBackend(true);
        if (Array.isArray(distRes.data.accounts) && distRes.data.accounts.length > 0) {
          setAccounts(distRes.data.accounts);
        }
      }
      if (sfRes.success && Array.isArray(sfRes.data)) {
        setShortfalls(sfRes.data);
      }
    } catch {
      // Keep running smoothly on local fixtures
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshData();
    const unsubscribe = treasuryApi.subscribeToEvents((event) => {
      if (
        event.type === "balance:mutated" ||
        event.type === "yield:swept" ||
        event.type === "yield:recalled"
      ) {
        refreshData();
      } else if (event.type === "circuit_breaker:tripped") {
        setCircuitBreakerTripped(true);
        setCircuitBreakerReason(event.data?.reason || "Autonomous operations halted by system policy.");
      } else if (event.type === "circuit_breaker:disarmed") {
        setCircuitBreakerTripped(false);
        setCircuitBreakerReason(undefined);
      }
    });
    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [refreshData]);

  const runShortfallRebalance = async () => {
    const res = await treasuryApi.runShortfallRebalance();
    if (!res.success) {
      throw new Error(res.error || "Failed to execute shortfall rebalance");
    }
    await refreshData();
  };

  const createAccount = async (data: any) => {
    const res = await treasuryApi.createAccount(data);
    if (!res.success) {
      throw new Error(res.error || "Failed to create account");
    }
    await refreshData();
  };

  const updateAccountPolicy = async (accountId: string, data: any) => {
    const res = await treasuryApi.updateAccount(accountId, data);
    if (!res.success) {
      throw new Error(res.error || "Failed to update account policy");
    }
    await refreshData();
  };

  // Sync theme to root html element
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => setTheme(prev => (prev === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"));

  // Computed totals
  const totalLiquid = sumUsdc(accounts.map(a => a.liquidUsdc));
  const totalInvested = sumUsdc(accounts.map(a => a.investedUsyc));
  const totalEffective = sumUsdc(accounts.map(a => a.totalEffectiveUsdc));
  const safeToInvestTotal = sumUsdc(accounts.map(a => a.safeToInvestUsdc));

  const appendJournalVoucher = (
    voucherData: Omit<T.JournalVoucher, "sequenceId" | "previousHash" | "currentHash">
  ) => {
    setJournal(prev => {
      const last = prev[prev.length - 1];
      const seq = last ? last.sequenceId + 1 : 1;
      const prevHash = last ? last.currentHash : ("0x" + "0".repeat(64));
      const curHash = hex(`journal-${seq}-${prevHash}-${voucherData.documentRef}`);
      const newVoucher: T.JournalVoucher = {
        ...voucherData,
        sequenceId: seq,
        previousHash: prevHash,
        currentHash: curHash,
      };
      return [...prev, newVoucher];
    });
  };

  const addLiability = (liabilityData: Omit<T.Liability, "liabilityId">) => {
    const id = `0b6f1c2e-5a7d-4c1e-9d3b-${String(liabilities.length + 1).padStart(12, "0")}`;
    const newLiab: T.Liability = {
      ...liabilityData,
      liabilityId: id,
    };
    setLiabilities(prev => [newLiab, ...prev]);

    // Recalculate committed liabilities on target account
    setAccounts(prev =>
      prev.map(a => {
        if (a.accountId === liabilityData.accountId) {
          const newCommitted = fromMicro(toMicro(a.committedLiabilities30dUsdc) + toMicro(liabilityData.amountUsdc));
          return {
            ...a,
            committedLiabilities30dUsdc: newCommitted,
          };
        }
        return a;
      })
    );

    // Add notification
    setNotifications(prev => [
      {
        id: `notif-${Date.now()}`,
        kind: "BILL_ADDED",
        tone: "info",
        title: `New Bill Added: ${liabilityData.title}`,
        body: `${liabilityData.amountUsdc} USDC due on ${new Date(liabilityData.dueDate).toLocaleDateString()}`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        read: false,
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
  };

  const switchCompany = async (companyId: string) => {
    treasuryApi.setCompanyId(companyId);
    const m = MEMBERSHIPS.find(mem => mem.companyId === companyId);
    if (m) {
      setCompany(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        companyId: m.companyId,
        name: m.companyName,
        network: m.network,
      }));
    }
    await refreshData();
  };

  const disputeLiability = async (id: string, reason = "Disputed by corporate officer") => {
    try {
      await treasuryApi.disputeLiability(id, reason);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Backend dispute failed, updating local state:", e);
    }
    updateLiabilityStatus(id, "FROZEN");
    const l = liabilities.find(item => item.liabilityId === id);
    appendJournalVoucher({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      accountId: l?.accountId || "acc_primary",
      actionType: "INVOICE_DISPUTED",
      debitAccount: l?.vendorId || "vendor_disputed",
      creditAccount: `${l?.accountId || "acc_primary"}:disputed`,
      amountUsdc: l?.amountUsdc || "0.000000",
      documentRef: `DISPUTE-${id.slice(-6)}`,
      memo: reason,
    });
  };

  const updateLiabilityStatus = (id: string, status: T.LiabilityStatus) => {
    setLiabilities(prev => prev.map(l => (l.liabilityId === id ? { ...l, status } : l)));
  };

  const payLiability = async (id: string) => {
    const l = liabilities.find(x => x.liabilityId === id);
    if (!l) return;

    if (circuitBreakerTripped) {
      throw new Error("Emergency stop is active. Autonomous and scheduled disbursals are halted.");
    }

    const acct = accounts.find(a => a.accountId === l.accountId);
    if (!acct) return;

    const liabMicro = toMicro(l.amountUsdc);
    const liquidMicro = toMicro(acct.liquidUsdc);

    if (liquidMicro < liabMicro) {
      throw new Error(
        `Insufficient liquid cash in ${acct.name}. Required: ${l.amountUsdc} USDC, Available: ${acct.liquidUsdc} USDC.`
      );
    }

    // Deduct cash from account
    const newLiquid = fromMicro(liquidMicro - liabMicro);
    const newTotal = fromMicro(toMicro(newLiquid) + toMicro(acct.investedUsyc));
    const newFree = toMicro(newLiquid) > toMicro(acct.protectedReserveUsdc)
      ? fromMicro(toMicro(newLiquid) - toMicro(acct.protectedReserveUsdc))
      : "0.000000";

    setAccounts(prev =>
      prev.map(a =>
        a.accountId === acct.accountId
          ? {
            ...a,
            liquidUsdc: newLiquid,
            totalEffectiveUsdc: newTotal,
            freeCapitalUsdc: newFree,
            committedLiabilities30dUsdc:
              toMicro(a.committedLiabilities30dUsdc) >= liabMicro
                ? fromMicro(toMicro(a.committedLiabilities30dUsdc) - liabMicro)
                : "0.000000",
          }
          : a
      )
    );

    // Update liability to SETTLED
    setLiabilities(prev => prev.map(item => (item.liabilityId === id ? { ...item, status: "SETTLED" } : item)));

    try {
      await treasuryApi.payLiability(id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("API payLiability notice:", err.message);
    }

    // Record in journal
    const tx = hex(`tx-disburse-${id}`);
    appendJournalVoucher({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      accountId: acct.accountId,
      actionType: "DISBURSEMENT",
      debitAccount: `${acct.accountId}:liquid`,
      creditAccount: l.vendorId,
      amountUsdc: l.amountUsdc,
      documentRef: `SETTLE-${l.title.slice(0, 10)}`,
      txHash: tx,
    });

    // Audit log
    setAuditEvents(prev => [
      {
        logId: String(Date.now()).slice(-4),
        accountId: acct.accountId,
        actionType: "DISBURSEMENT",
        amountUsdc: l.amountUsdc,
        isAutonomous: false,
        txHash: tx,
        reason: `Settled bill "${l.title}" via ${l.rail || "Disbursal Vault"}.`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        actorAgent: "DisbursalRouterAgent",
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
  };



  const decideSpr = async (
    requestId: string,
    decision: "APPROVE" | "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS",
    memo?: string,
    adminSignature?: string
  ) => {
    const spr = pendingSprs.find(s => s.requestId === requestId);
    if (!spr) return;

    if (decision === "APPROVE") {
      // Execute account balance mutations if affected
      if (spr.affectedAccounts.length > 0) {
        setAccounts(prev =>
          prev.map(a => {
            const imp = spr.affectedAccounts.find(x => x.accountId === a.accountId);
            if (imp) {
              const postLiquid = imp.postTxLiquidBalance;
              const postInvested = imp.postTxInvestedUsyc;
              const postTotal = fromMicro(toMicro(postLiquid) + toMicro(postInvested));
              return {
                ...a,
                liquidUsdc: postLiquid,
                investedUsyc: postInvested,
                totalEffectiveUsdc: postTotal,
              };
            }
            return a;
          })
        );
      }

      // Add to decided SPRS
      const updatedSpr: T.PermissionRequest = {
        ...spr,
        status: "APPROVED",
        decidedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        adminInstructions: adminSignature ? `Signed by Amara Okafor (${adminSignature.slice(0, 14)}…)` : undefined,
      };

      setPendingSprs(prev => prev.filter(s => s.requestId !== requestId));
      setDecidedSprs(prev => [updatedSpr, ...prev]);

      // Journal entry
      const tx = hex(`tx-spr-approved-${requestId}`);
      appendJournalVoucher({
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        accountId: spr.affectedAccounts[0]?.accountId || "acc_treasury",
        actionType: spr.action,
        debitAccount: "SPRS_CLEARANCE",
        creditAccount: spr.targetRecipient?.vendorId || "SYSTEM",
        amountUsdc: spr.amountUsdc,
        documentRef: spr.associatedRecords.invoiceDocumentId || spr.requestId,
        txHash: tx,
      });

      // Audit log
      setAuditEvents(prev => [
        {
          logId: String(Date.now()).slice(-4),
          accountId: spr.affectedAccounts[0]?.accountId || "acc_treasury",
          actionType: spr.action,
          amountUsdc: spr.amountUsdc,
          isAutonomous: false,
          txHash: tx,
          reason: `Human approved SPRS #${requestId}: ${spr.reason}. Signed by Amara Okafor.`,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          actorAgent: "PolicyComplianceAgent",
        },
        ...prev,
      ]);
    } else {
      // Cancel with instructions
      const updatedSpr: T.PermissionRequest = {
        ...spr,
        status: "CANCELLED_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS",
        decidedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        adminInstructions: memo,
      };

      setPendingSprs(prev => prev.filter(s => s.requestId !== requestId));
      setDecidedSprs(prev => [updatedSpr, ...prev]);

      // Audit log
      setAuditEvents(prev => [
        {
          logId: String(Date.now()).slice(-4),
          accountId: spr.affectedAccounts[0]?.accountId || "acc_treasury",
          actionType: "SPRS_CANCELLED",
          amountUsdc: spr.amountUsdc,
          isAutonomous: false,
          reason: `Cancelled by human with instructions: "${memo}"`,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          actorAgent: "PolicyComplianceAgent",
        },
        ...prev,
      ]);
    }

    try {
      await treasuryApi.decideSpr(requestId, decision, memo, adminSignature);
    } catch (apiErr: any) {
      console.warn("API decideSpr notice:", apiErr.message);
    }
  };

  const toggleChainTamper = () => {
    setIsChainTampered(prev => {
      const next = !prev;
      if (next) {
        setJournal(JOURNAL_BROKEN);
      } else {
        setJournal(INITIAL_JOURNAL);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const tripCircuitBreaker = async (reason: string) => {
    setCircuitBreakerTripped(true);
    setCircuitBreakerReason(reason);
    treasuryApi.tripCircuitBreaker(reason).catch(() => { });

    setAuditEvents(prev => [
      {
        logId: String(Date.now()).slice(-4),
        accountId: "all",
        actionType: "CIRCUIT_BREAKER_TRIPPED",
        amountUsdc: "0.000000",
        isAutonomous: false,
        reason: `Emergency stop initiated: ${reason}`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        actorAgent: "LedgerWitnessAgent",
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);

    setNotifications(prev => [
      {
        id: `notif-${Date.now()}`,
        kind: "CIRCUIT_BREAKER",
        tone: "danger",
        title: "Emergency Stop Activated",
        body: `All autonomous operations paused: ${reason}`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        read: false,
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
  };



  const resetCircuitBreaker = async () => {
    setCircuitBreakerTripped(false);
    setCircuitBreakerReason(undefined);
    treasuryApi.disarmCircuitBreaker("CLEAR-DISARM-EMERGENCY").catch(() => { });

    setAuditEvents(prev => [
      {
        logId: String(Date.now()).slice(-4),
        accountId: "all",
        actionType: "CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET",
        amountUsdc: "0.000000",
        isAutonomous: false,
        reason: "Emergency stop cleared. Swarm resumed.",
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        actorAgent: "PolicyComplianceAgent",
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
  };



  const sweepExcessLiquidity = async (accountId: string, amountUsdc: string) => {
    if (circuitBreakerTripped) {
      throw new Error("Cannot sweep: Emergency stop is active.");
    }

    const acct = accounts.find(a => a.accountId === accountId);
    if (!acct) return;

    const sweepMicro = toMicro(amountUsdc);
    const liquidMicro = toMicro(acct.liquidUsdc);

    if (liquidMicro < sweepMicro) {
      throw new Error(`Cannot sweep ${amountUsdc}: exceeds liquid cash ${acct.liquidUsdc} USDC.`);
    }

    const newLiquid = fromMicro(liquidMicro - sweepMicro);
    const newInvested = fromMicro(toMicro(acct.investedUsyc) + sweepMicro);
    const newTotal = fromMicro(toMicro(newLiquid) + toMicro(newInvested));
    const newSafe = toMicro(acct.safeToInvestUsdc) > sweepMicro
      ? fromMicro(toMicro(acct.safeToInvestUsdc) - sweepMicro)
      : "0.000000";

    setAccounts(prev =>
      prev.map(a =>
        a.accountId === accountId
          ? {
            ...a,
            liquidUsdc: newLiquid,
            investedUsyc: newInvested,
            totalEffectiveUsdc: newTotal,
            safeToInvestUsdc: newSafe,
          }
          : a
      )
    );

    try {
      await treasuryApi.executeSweep(accountId, amountUsdc);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("API executeSweep notice:", err.message);
    }

    const tx = hex(`tx-sweep-${Date.now()}`);
    appendJournalVoucher({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      accountId,
      actionType: "SWEEP_TO_YIELD",
      debitAccount: `${accountId}:liquid`,
      creditAccount: `${accountId}:invested`,
      amountUsdc,
      documentRef: `SWP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      txHash: tx,
    });

    setAuditEvents(prev => [
      {
        logId: String(Date.now()).slice(-4),
        accountId,
        actionType: "SWEEP_TO_YIELD",
        amountUsdc,
        isAutonomous: true,
        txHash: tx,
        reason: `TreasurySentinel swept ${amountUsdc} USDC idle surplus into tokenized USYC vault.`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        actorAgent: "TreasurySentinelAgent",
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
  };



  const recallLiquidity = async (accountId: string, amountUsdc: string) => {
    const acct = accounts.find(a => a.accountId === accountId);
    if (!acct) return;

    const recallMicro = toMicro(amountUsdc);
    const investedMicro = toMicro(acct.investedUsyc);

    if (investedMicro < recallMicro) {
      throw new Error(`Cannot recall ${amountUsdc}: exceeds invested USYC ${acct.investedUsyc}.`);
    }

    const newInvested = fromMicro(investedMicro - recallMicro);
    const newLiquid = fromMicro(toMicro(acct.liquidUsdc) + recallMicro);
    const newTotal = fromMicro(toMicro(newLiquid) + toMicro(newInvested));

    setAccounts(prev =>
      prev.map(a =>
        a.accountId === accountId
          ? {
            ...a,
            liquidUsdc: newLiquid,
            investedUsyc: newInvested,
            totalEffectiveUsdc: newTotal,
          }
          : a
      )
    );

    try {
      await treasuryApi.executeRecall(accountId, amountUsdc);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("API executeRecall notice:", err.message);
    }

    const tx = hex(`tx-recall-${Date.now()}`);
    appendJournalVoucher({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      accountId,
      actionType: "RECALL_FROM_YIELD",
      debitAccount: `${accountId}:invested`,
      creditAccount: `${accountId}:liquid`,
      amountUsdc,
      documentRef: `RCL-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      txHash: tx,
    });

    setAuditEvents(prev => [
      {
        logId: String(Date.now()).slice(-4),
        accountId,
        actionType: "RECALL_FROM_YIELD",
        amountUsdc,
        isAutonomous: true,
        txHash: tx,
        reason: `Sentinel recalled ${amountUsdc} USDC from USYC vault to cover impending commitments.`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        actorAgent: "TreasurySentinelAgent",
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
  };



  const markNotificationRead = (id: string) => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => (n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n)));
  };

  const completeWizardStep = (step: number) => {
    setWizardCompleted(prev => Array.from(new Set([...prev, step])));
    if (step < 6) {
      setWizardStep(step + 1);
    }
  };

  const fundAccount = async (accountId: string, amountUsdc: string, method = "CRYPTO") => {
    const amtNum = parseFloat(amountUsdc) || 0;
    if (amtNum <= 0) throw new Error("Invalid deposit amount.");

    const acct = accounts.find(a => a.accountId === accountId);
    if (!acct) return;

    try {
      if (method === "WIRE" || method === "ACH") {
        await treasuryApi.reconcileFiatDeposit({
          targetAccountId: accountId,
          amountUsdc: amtNum,
          wireReference: `FIAT-DEP-${Date.now()}`,
          sourceBank: "Commercial Settlement Clearing Bank",
        });
      } else {
        await treasuryApi.fundAccount(accountId, {
          method: "CRYPTO",
          amountUsdc: amtNum,
          sourceChain: "Arc",
          sourceToken: "USDC",
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn("API fundAccount warning:", err.message);
    }

    const depMicro = toMicro(amountUsdc);
    const newLiquid = fromMicro(toMicro(acct.liquidUsdc) + depMicro);
    const newTotal = fromMicro(toMicro(newLiquid) + toMicro(acct.investedUsyc));
    const newSafe = fromMicro(toMicro(acct.safeToInvestUsdc) + depMicro);

    setAccounts(prev =>
      prev.map(a =>
        a.accountId === accountId
          ? {
            ...a,
            liquidUsdc: newLiquid,
            totalEffectiveUsdc: newTotal,
            safeToInvestUsdc: newSafe,
          }
          : a
      )
    );

    const tx = hex(`tx-fund-${Date.now()}`);
    appendJournalVoucher({
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      accountId,
      actionType: "DEPOSIT",
      debitAccount: `${accountId}:liquid`,
      creditAccount: `external:${method.toLowerCase()}`,
      amountUsdc,
      documentRef: `DEP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      txHash: tx,
    });

    setAuditEvents(prev => [
      {
        logId: String(Date.now()).slice(-4),
        accountId,
        actionType: "DEPOSIT",
        amountUsdc,
        isAutonomous: false,
        txHash: tx,
        reason: `Manual treasury deposit of ${amountUsdc} USDC credited via ${method}.`,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        actorAgent: "TreasuryAdmin",
      },
      ...prev,
    ]);
  };



  return (
    <TreasuryContext.Provider
      value={{
        theme,
        setTheme,
        toggleTheme,
        activeView,
        setActiveView,
        company,
        setCompany,
        currentUser,
        setCurrentUser,
        switchUser: setCurrentUser,
        switchCompany,
        accounts,
        totalLiquid,
        totalInvested,
        totalEffective,
        safeToInvestTotal,
        liabilities,
        addLiability,
        updateLiabilityStatus,
        payLiability,
        disputeLiability,
        pendingSprs,
        decidedSprs,
        decideSpr,
        journal,
        isChainTampered,
        toggleChainTamper,
        appendJournalVoucher,
        circuitBreakerTripped,
        circuitBreakerReason,
        tripCircuitBreaker,
        resetCircuitBreaker,
        sweepExcessLiquidity,
        recallLiquidity,
        notifications,
        markNotificationRead,
        auditEvents,
        wizardStep,
        setWizardStep,
        wizardCompleted,
        completeWizardStep,
        shortfalls,
        hasShortfalls: shortfalls.length > 0,
        isLiveBackend,
        refreshData,
        runShortfallRebalance,
        createAccount,
        updateAccountPolicy,
        fundAccount,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </TreasuryContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTreasury() {
  const context = useContext(TreasuryContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useTreasury must be used within a TreasuryProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

/**
 * BizArc Treasury & Liquidity Engine - Live HTTP & SSE Client
 * Connects frontend directly to SystemHttpServer endpoints.
 */

export interface ApiResponse<T = any> {
  success: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
  [key: string]: any;
}

const BASE_URL = ""; // Relies on Vite proxy to http://localhost:3000

class TreasuryApiClient {
  private token: string | null = null;
  private companyId: string | null = "org_bizglobal";

  public setToken(token: string | null) {
    this.token = token;
  }

  public setCompanyId(companyId: string | null) {
    this.companyId = companyId;
  }

  private async fetchJson<T>(
    path: string,
    options: RequestInit = {}
  ): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(options.headers as Record<string, string>),
    };

    if (this.token) {
      headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${this.token}`;
    }

    // Attach tenant companyId in query if GET and present
    let url = `${BASE_URL}${path}`;
    if (this.companyId && !url.includes("companyId=")) {
      const sep = url.includes("?") ? "&" : "?";
      url = `${url}${sep}companyId=${encodeURIComponent(this.companyId)}`;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { ...options, headers });
      const data = await res.json();
      return data;
    } catch (err: any) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: err.message || "Network request failed",
      };
    }
  }

  // --- Treasury Cockpit & Balances ---
  public async getDistribution(companyId?: string) {
    const query = companyId ? `?companyId=${companyId}` : "";
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/treasury/distribution${query}`);
  }

  public async getSafeToInvest(accountId = "acc_primary", companyId?: string) {
    const query = `?accountId=${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}${companyId ? `&companyId=${companyId}` : ""}`;
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/treasury/safe-to-invest${query}`);
  }

  public async getShortfalls(companyId?: string) {
    const query = companyId ? `?companyId=${companyId}` : "";
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/treasury/shortfalls${query}`);
  }

  public async runShortfallRebalance(companyId?: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/treasury/shortfalls/run`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ companyId: companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  // --- Yield Machine & Rebalancing ---
  public async getYieldPerformance(companyId?: string) {
    const query = companyId ? `?companyId=${companyId}` : "";
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/yield/performance${query}`);
  }

  public async getYieldMoves(accountId?: string, limit = 50, companyId?: string) {
    let query = `?limit=${limit}`;
    if (accountId) query += `&accountId=${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}`;
    if (companyId) query += `&companyId=${encodeURIComponent(companyId)}`;
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/treasury/yield/moves${query}`);
  }

  public async executeSweep(accountId = "acc_primary", amountUsdc?: string | number, companyId?: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/yield/sweep`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ accountId, amountUsdc, companyId: companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  public async executeRecall(accountId = "acc_primary", amountUsdc: number | string = 0, companyId?: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/yield/recall`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ accountId, amountUsdc, companyId: companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  // --- Operating Accounts ---
  public async getAccounts(companyId?: string) {
    const query = companyId ? `?companyId=${companyId}` : "";
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/accounts${query}`);
  }

  public async createAccount(payload: {
    accountId: string;
    name: string;
    role: string;
    minOperatingFloorUsdc: number;
    safetyBufferRatio: number;
    perTxCapUsdc?: number;
    dailyCapUsdc?: number;
    maxAutonomousSweepLimit?: number;
    excludeFromWaterfall?: boolean;
    companyId?: string;
  }) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/accounts`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, companyId: payload.companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  public async updateAccount(
    accountId: string,
    payload: {
      minOperatingFloorUsdc?: number;
      safetyBufferRatio?: number;
      perTxCapUsdc?: number;
      dailyCapUsdc?: number;
      maxAutonomousSweepLimit?: number;
      excludeFromWaterfall?: boolean;
      companyId?: string;
    }
  ) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}`, {
      method: "PUT",
      body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, companyId: payload.companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  public async transferFunds(payload: {
    fromAccountId: string;
    toAccountId: string;
    amountUsdc: string;
    memo?: string;
    reason?: string;
    companyId?: string;
  }) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/accounts/transfer`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ...payload,
        reason: payload.reason || payload.memo,
        memo: payload.memo || payload.reason,
        companyId: payload.companyId || this.companyId,
      }),
    });
  }

  // --- Account Funding & Wires ---
  public async getFundingOptions(accountId: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/funding-options`);
  }

  public async fundAccount(
    accountId: string,
    payload: {
      method: "CARD" | "ACH" | "CRYPTO" | "FIAT_CARD_ONRAMP" | "FIAT_FEDWIRE" | "CRYPTO_ARC_NATIVE";
      amountUsdc: number;
      userEmail?: string;
      sourceChain?: string;
      sourceToken?: string;
      companyId?: string;
    }
  ) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}/fund`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, companyId: payload.companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  public async getWireInstructions(accountId = "acc_primary", currency = "USD") {
    return this.fetchJson(
      `/api/funding/fiat/wire-instructions?accountId=${encodeURIComponent(accountId)}&currency=${currency}`
    );
  }

  public async createFiatOnramp(accountId: string, amountUsd: number) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/funding/fiat/onramp`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ accountId, amountUsd, amountUsdc: amountUsd }),
    });
  }

  public async reconcileFiatDeposit(payload: {
    targetAccountId?: string;
    accountId?: string;
    amountUsdc: number;
    wireReference?: string;
    depositReference?: string;
    sourceBank?: string;
  }) {
    const accountId = payload.accountId || payload.targetAccountId || "acc_primary";
    const depositReference = payload.depositReference || payload.wireReference || `FIAT_DEP_${Date.now()}`;
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/funding/fiat/deposit-reconcile`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({
        ...payload,
        accountId,
        targetAccountId: accountId,
        depositReference,
        wireReference: depositReference,
      }),
    });
  }

  // --- Swaps ---
  public async estimateSwap(payload: {
    fromChain: string;
    fromToken: string;
    toChain?: string;
    toToken?: string;
    amount: string;
  }) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/swaps/estimate`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ toChain: "Arc", toToken: "USDC", ...payload }),
    });
  }

  public async executeSwap(payload: any) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/swaps/execute`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
  }

  // --- SPRS, Governance & Onboarding ---
  public async payLiability(liabilityId: string, companyId?: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/disbursal/trigger-due`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ liabilityId, companyId: companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  public async signSpr(requestId: string, adminSignature?: string, memo?: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/sprs/${encodeURIComponent(requestId)}/sign`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ privateKey: adminSignature, memo }),
    });
  }

  public async decideSpr(
    requestId: string,
    decision: "APPROVE" | "CANCEL_WITH_INSTRUCTIONS",
    memo?: string,
    adminSignature?: string
  ) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/sprs/${encodeURIComponent(requestId)}/decision`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ decision, memo, adminSignature }),
    });
  }

  public async tripCircuitBreaker(reason: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/governance/circuit-breaker`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ reason }),
    });
  }

  public async disarmCircuitBreaker(clearanceCode: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/governance/circuit-breaker/disarm`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ clearanceCode }),
    });
  }

  public async disputeLiability(liabilityId: string, reason?: string, accountId?: string, companyId?: string) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/liabilities/dispute`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ liabilityId, reason, accountId, companyId: companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  public async disburseManual(payload: {
    companyId?: string;
    sourceAccountId?: string;
    accountId?: string;
    vendorId: string;
    vendorName?: string;
    amountUsdc: number | string;
    paymentRail: string;
    declaredReason?: string;
    invoiceId?: string;
    poReference?: string;
    category?: string;
    fiatDetails?: any;
    cryptoDetails?: any;
  }) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/disbursals/manual`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, companyId: payload.companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  public async disburseAdHoc(payload: any) {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/payments/ad-hoc`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, companyId: payload.companyId || this.companyId }),
    });
  }

  public async activateOnboarding(sessionId = "default_session") {
    return this.fetchJson(`/api/onboarding/activate`, {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ sessionId }),
    });
  }

  // --- Live Server-Sent Events (SSE) Stream ---
  public subscribeToEvents(
    onEvent: (event: { type: string; data: any }) => void
  ): () => void {
    const sseUrl = `${BASE_URL}/api/events`;
    const eventSource = new EventSource(sseUrl);

    eventSource.onmessage = (e) => {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(e.data);
        onEvent({ type: "message", data: parsed });
      } catch {}
    };

    const registeredEvents = [
      "balance:mutated",
      "yield:swept",
      "yield:recalled",
      "deposit:confirmed",
      "sprs:created",
      "circuit_breaker:tripped",
      "circuit_breaker:disarmed",
      "discovery:completed",
    ];

    registeredEvents.forEach((evType) => {
      eventSource.addEventListener(evType, (e: any) => {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(e.data);
          onEvent({ type: evType, data: parsed });
        } catch {}
      });
    });

    return () => {
      eventSource.close();
    };
  }
}

export const treasuryApi = new TreasuryApiClient();

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol";
import "./interfaces/IERC4626Yield.sol";

/**
 * @title CentralTreasuryYieldVault
 * @notice Production Treasury Yield Engine on Arc L1.
 *         Segregates account shares, interacts with USYC (ERC-4626),
 *         and enforces immutable account-locked recalls (recipient cannot be parameterized).
 */
contract CentralTreasuryYieldVault is AccessControl {
    bytes32 public constant SWEEPER_ROLE = keccak256("SWEEPER_ROLE");
    bytes32 public constant DISBURSAL_ROLE = keccak256("DISBURSAL_ROLE");

    IERC20 public immutable usdc;           // Arc Predeploy 0x3600000000000000000000000000000000000000
    IERC4626Yield public immutable usyc;   // Hashnote USYC or MockUSYCVault

    // Corporate Account ID => Registered Company Wallet Address (Recalls ONLY go here)
    mapping(bytes32 => address) public registeredAccounts;
    // Corporate Account ID => USYC Shares owned
    mapping(bytes32 => uint256) public accountShares;
    uint256 public totalVaultShares;

    event AccountRegistered(bytes32 indexed accountId, address indexed wallet);
    event AccountDeregistered(bytes32 indexed accountId);
    event FundsSweptToYield(
        bytes32 indexed accountId,
        address indexed sourceWallet,
        uint256 usdcAmount,
        uint256 sharesMinted
    );
    event FundsRecalledFromYield(
        bytes32 indexed accountId,
        address indexed recipientWallet,
        uint256 usdcAmount,
        uint256 sharesBurned
    );

    constructor(address _usdc, address _usyc, address admin) {
        require(_usdc != address(0), "Invalid USDC address");
        require(_usyc != address(0), "Invalid USYC address");
        require(admin != address(0), "Invalid admin address");

        usdc = IERC20(_usdc);
        usyc = IERC4626Yield(_usyc);

        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, admin);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Registers or updates an operating account's designated payout wallet
     */
    function registerAccount(bytes32 accountId, address wallet) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(accountId != bytes32(0), "Invalid accountId");
        require(wallet != address(0), "Cannot register zero address");
        registeredAccounts[accountId] = wallet;
        emit AccountRegistered(accountId, wallet);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Deregisters an account once its share balance is zero
     */
    function deregisterAccount(bytes32 accountId) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(accountShares[accountId] == 0, "Account has active yield shares");
        delete registeredAccounts[accountId];
        emit AccountDeregistered(accountId);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Sweeps calculated idle funds from an account wallet into USYC
     * @dev Called exclusively by TreasurySweeperAgent using the account wallet's pre-approved allowance
     */
    function sweepFromAccount(
        bytes32 accountId,
        address accountWallet,
        uint256 usdcAmount
    ) external onlyRole(SWEEPER_ROLE) {
        require(registeredAccounts[accountId] == accountWallet, "Wallet not registered for account");
        require(usdcAmount > 0, "Zero sweep amount");

        // 1. Pull USDC from operating wallet using allowance
        require(usdc.transferFrom(accountWallet, address(this), usdcAmount), "USDC transferFrom failed");

        // 2. Deposit into USYC
        require(usdc.approve(address(usyc), usdcAmount), "USDC approve failed");
        uint256 sharesMinted = usyc.deposit(usdcAmount, address(this));
        require(sharesMinted > 0, "Zero shares minted");

        // 3. Update segregated account ledger
        accountShares[accountId] += sharesMinted;
        totalVaultShares += sharesMinted;

        emit FundsSweptToYield(accountId, accountWallet, usdcAmount, sharesMinted);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Recalls USDC from USYC back to the account's registered wallet
     * @dev Recipient CANNOT be parameterized; strictly enforced to registeredAccounts[accountId]
     */
    function recallForAccount(
        bytes32 accountId,
        uint256 usdcAmount
    ) external onlyRole(DISBURSAL_ROLE) {
        address targetWallet = registeredAccounts[accountId];
        require(targetWallet != address(0), "Account not registered");
        require(usdcAmount > 0, "Zero recall amount");

        uint256 currentAssets = getAccountAssets(accountId);
        require(currentAssets >= usdcAmount, "Insufficient account yield balance");

        // Verify available instant liquidity in USYC
        uint256 maxInstant = usyc.maxWithdraw(address(this));
        require(maxInstant >= usdcAmount, "Instant USYC liquidity limit exceeded");

        // Record balance before to guard against ERC-4626 rounding shortfall
        uint256 balanceBefore = usdc.balanceOf(targetWallet);

        // Execute ERC-4626 withdraw (specifies exact assets desired, rounds shares up in favor of vault)
        uint256 sharesBurned = usyc.withdraw(usdcAmount, targetWallet, address(this));

        // Precision check: verify actual amount received
        uint256 actualReceived = usdc.balanceOf(targetWallet) - balanceBefore;
        require(actualReceived >= usdcAmount, "Redemption precision shortfall");

        require(accountShares[accountId] >= sharesBurned, "Share calculation underflow");
        accountShares[accountId] -= sharesBurned;
        totalVaultShares -= sharesBurned;

        emit FundsRecalledFromYield(accountId, targetWallet, usdcAmount, sharesBurned);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Converts an account's USYC shares into underlying USDC valuation
     */
    function getAccountAssets(bytes32 accountId) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 shares = accountShares[accountId];
        if (shares == 0) return 0;
        return usyc.convertToAssets(shares);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/EIP712.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol";

/**
 * @title DisbursalVault
 * @notice Hardened transient clearinghouse on Arc L1 enforcing on-chain vendor allowlists,
 *         spending caps, idempotency keys, and EIP-712 human approvals.
 *         Holds $0 at rest.
 */
contract DisbursalVault is AccessControl, EIP712 {
    bytes32 public constant EXECUTOR_ROLE = keccak256("EXECUTOR_ROLE");
    bytes32 public constant DISBURSAL_TYPEHASH = keccak256(
        "DisbursalApproval(bytes32 permissionRequestId,address vendor,uint256 amount,bytes32 idempotencyKey,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)"
    );

    IERC20 public immutable usdc;
    address public adminApprover;

    // --- On-Chain Guardrails ---
    mapping(address => bool) public approvedVendors;
    mapping(bytes32 => bool) public executedIdempotencyKeys;
    mapping(uint256 => bool) public usedNonces;

    uint256 public perTxCap;                  // Max per-tx limit without admin EIP-712 signature
    uint256 public dailyCap;                  // Max cumulative daily limit across all transactions
    uint256 public eip712ApprovalThreshold;  // Amount threshold above which EIP-712 signature is mandatory

    uint256 public currentDay;
    uint256 public dailySpent;

    event VendorStatusUpdated(address indexed vendor, bool approved);
    event SpendingCapsUpdated(uint256 perTxCap, uint256 dailyCap, uint256 eip712Threshold);
    event AdminApproverUpdated(address indexed previousAdmin, address indexed newAdmin);
    event DisbursalExecuted(
        bytes32 indexed permissionRequestId,
        address indexed vendor,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes32 idempotencyKey
    );
    event FundsRefunded(address indexed recipient, uint256 amount);

    constructor(
        address _usdc,
        address _admin,
        uint256 _perTxCap,
        uint256 _dailyCap,
        uint256 _eip712Threshold
    ) AccessControl() EIP712("DisbursalVault", "1") {
        require(_usdc != address(0), "Invalid USDC address");
        require(_admin != address(0), "Invalid admin address");
        require(_perTxCap <= _dailyCap, "perTxCap exceeds dailyCap");

        usdc = IERC20(_usdc);
        adminApprover = _admin;
        perTxCap = _perTxCap;
        dailyCap = _dailyCap;
        eip712ApprovalThreshold = _eip712Threshold;

        _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _admin);
    }

    function setVendorApproval(address vendor, bool approved) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(vendor != address(0), "Cannot approve zero address");
        approvedVendors[vendor] = approved;
        emit VendorStatusUpdated(vendor, approved);
    }

    function updateCaps(
        uint256 _perTxCap,
        uint256 _dailyCap,
        uint256 _threshold
    ) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(_perTxCap <= _dailyCap, "perTxCap exceeds dailyCap");
        perTxCap = _perTxCap;
        dailyCap = _dailyCap;
        eip712ApprovalThreshold = _threshold;
        emit SpendingCapsUpdated(_perTxCap, _dailyCap, _threshold);
    }

    function setAdminApprover(address _newAdmin) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(_newAdmin != address(0), "Cannot set zero address approver");
        address previous = adminApprover;
        adminApprover = _newAdmin;
        emit AdminApproverUpdated(previous, _newAdmin);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Executes a payment adhering strictly to on-chain guardrails
     * @param permissionRequestId Standardized permission request ID
     * @param vendor Approved vendor payout address
     * @param amount Payment amount in 6-decimal USDC
     * @param idempotencyKey Deterministic hash(vendor, invoiceId, amount)
     * @param nonce Replay protection nonce for EIP-712 signature
     * @param deadline Expiry timestamp for EIP-712 signature
     * @param adminSignature Cryptographic signature from admin (required if amount > threshold)
     */
    function executePayment(
        bytes32 permissionRequestId,
        address vendor,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes32 idempotencyKey,
        uint256 nonce,
        uint256 deadline,
        bytes calldata adminSignature
    ) external onlyRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE) {
        // 1. On-Chain Allowlist Check
        require(approvedVendors[vendor], "Vendor not on on-chain allowlist");
        require(vendor != address(0), "Cannot pay address(0)");
        require(amount > 0, "Zero disbursal amount");

        // 2. Idempotency Check
        require(!executedIdempotencyKeys[idempotencyKey], "Duplicate transaction blocked (Idempotency Key)");

        // 3. Daily Cap & Spending Roll Check
        uint256 today = block.timestamp / 1 days;
        if (today > currentDay) {
            currentDay = today;
            dailySpent = 0;
        }
        require(dailySpent + amount <= dailyCap, "Daily spending cap exceeded");

        // 4. On-Chain Approval & Per-Tx Guardrail
        if (amount > eip712ApprovalThreshold) {
            require(block.timestamp <= deadline, "EIP-712 signature expired");
            require(!usedNonces[nonce], "Signature nonce already used");
            usedNonces[nonce] = true;

            bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
                abi.encode(
                    DISBURSAL_TYPEHASH,
                    permissionRequestId,
                    vendor,
                    amount,
                    idempotencyKey,
                    nonce,
                    deadline
                )
            );
            bytes32 hash = _hashTypedDataV4(structHash);
            address signer = ECDSA.recover(hash, adminSignature);
            require(signer == adminApprover, "Invalid admin EIP-712 signature");
        } else {
            require(amount <= perTxCap, "Amount exceeds per-tx autonomous cap");
        }

        // 5. Backing and Execution
        require(usdc.balanceOf(address(this)) >= amount, "Disbursal vault unbacked");

        executedIdempotencyKeys[idempotencyKey] = true;
        dailySpent += amount;

        require(usdc.transfer(vendor, amount), "USDC transfer to vendor failed");

        emit DisbursalExecuted(permissionRequestId, vendor, amount, idempotencyKey);
    }

    /**
     * @notice Refunds excess or stranded funds back to corporate accounts
     */
    function refundExcess(address recipient, uint256 amount) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(recipient != address(0), "Invalid recipient");
        require(amount > 0, "Zero amount");
        require(usdc.balanceOf(address(this)) >= amount, "Insufficient vault balance");

        require(usdc.transfer(recipient, amount), "Refund transfer failed");
        emit FundsRefunded(recipient, amount);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "./interfaces/IERC4626Yield.sol";

/**
 * @title MockUSYCVault
 * @notice Realistic ERC-4626 simulation matching Hashnote USYC specification.
 *         Allows testnet deployment, sub-second redemption testing, and yield accrual simulation.
 */
contract MockUSYCVault is ERC20, IERC4626Yield {
    IERC20 public immutable underlyingAsset;
    uint256 public navExchangeRateMultiplier = 1e18; // 1.0 NAV base (18 decimals precision)

    constructor(address _asset) ERC20("Mock Hashnote US Yield Coin", "mUSYC") {
        require(_asset != address(0), "Invalid asset");
        underlyingAsset = IERC20(_asset);
    }

    function asset() external view override returns (address) {
        return address(underlyingAsset);
    }

    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {
        return 6;
    }

    function totalAssets() public view override returns (uint256) {
        return underlyingAsset.balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view override returns (uint256) {
        if (assets == 0) return 0;
        return (assets * 1e18) / navExchangeRateMultiplier;
    }

    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view override returns (uint256) {
        if (shares == 0) return 0;
        return (shares * navExchangeRateMultiplier) / 1e18;
    }

    function maxDeposit(address) external pure override returns (uint256) {
        return type(uint256).max;
    }

    function maxWithdraw(address owner) external view override returns (uint256) {
        uint256 ownerAssets = convertToAssets(balanceOf(owner));
        uint256 vaultTotal = totalAssets();
        return ownerAssets < vaultTotal ? ownerAssets : vaultTotal;
    }

    function maxRedeem(address owner) external view override returns (uint256) {
        return balanceOf(owner);
    }

    function previewDeposit(uint256 assets) external view override returns (uint256) {
        return convertToShares(assets);
    }

    function previewWithdraw(uint256 assets) external view override returns (uint256) {
        uint256 shares = (assets * 1e18 + (navExchangeRateMultiplier - 1)) / navExchangeRateMultiplier; // ceil
        return shares;
    }

    function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) external override returns (uint256 shares) {
        require(assets > 0, "Zero assets");
        require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid receiver");

        shares = convertToShares(assets);
        require(shares > 0, "Zero shares calculated");

        require(underlyingAsset.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), assets), "Asset transfer failed");
        _mint(receiver, shares);

        return shares;
    }

    function withdraw(
        uint256 assets,
        address receiver,
        address owner
    ) external override returns (uint256 shares) {
        require(assets > 0, "Zero assets");
        require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid receiver");

        // Round up shares in favor of the vault
        shares = (assets * 1e18 + (navExchangeRateMultiplier - 1)) / navExchangeRateMultiplier;

        if (msg.sender != owner) {
            _spendAllowance(owner, msg.sender, shares);
        }

        _burn(owner, shares);
        require(underlyingAsset.transfer(receiver, assets), "Asset transfer failed");

        return shares;
    }

    function redeem(
        uint256 shares,
        address receiver,
        address owner
    ) external override returns (uint256 assets) {
        require(shares > 0, "Zero shares");
        require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid receiver");

        // Round down assets in favor of the vault
        assets = (shares * navExchangeRateMultiplier) / 1e18;

        if (msg.sender != owner) {
            _spendAllowance(owner, msg.sender, shares);
        }

        _burn(owner, shares);
        require(underlyingAsset.transfer(receiver, assets), "Asset transfer failed");

        return assets;
    }

    /**
     * @notice Simulates T-Bill daily yield accrual by adjusting NAV exchange rate multiplier
     * @param basisPoints Basis points increase (e.g. 500 = +5.00%)
     */
    function accrueYield(uint256 basisPoints) external {
        navExchangeRateMultiplier = (navExchangeRateMultiplier * (10000 + basisPoints)) / 10000;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

/**
 * @title IERC4626Yield
 * @notice Standard ERC-4626 interface subset utilized for USYC yield vault interactions
 */
interface IERC4626Yield {
    function asset() external view returns (address);
    function totalAssets() external view returns (uint256);
    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) external view returns (uint256);
    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) external view returns (uint256);
    function maxDeposit(address receiver) external view returns (uint256);
    function maxWithdraw(address owner) external view returns (uint256);
    function maxRedeem(address owner) external view returns (uint256);
    function previewDeposit(uint256 assets) external view returns (uint256);
    function previewWithdraw(uint256 assets) external view returns (uint256);

    function deposit(uint256 assets, address receiver) external returns (uint256 shares);
    function withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner) external returns (uint256 shares);
    function redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner) external returns (uint256 assets);
}
